hymns.title: Adoration
hymns.source_file: 001 Adoration lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: verse 1:John S Monsell (1811-1875) verse 2: Ken Bible (b. 1950) ref. Psalm 96 : 9

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness!
Bow down before Him, His glory proclaim.
With gold of obedience and incense of lowliness,
kneel and adore Him– the Lord is His name!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Fear not to enter His presence in poverty,
bearing no gifts to present as your own.
Bring truth in its beauty and love in its purity–
these are the off'rings to lay at His throne.

hymns.title: All creatures of our God and King
hymns.source_file: 002 All creatures of our God and King lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: Francis of Assisi (1182-1226) transl. William H Draper (1855-1933)
metadata.composer: from Geistliche Kirchengesänge, Cologne 1623 arr. Ralph Vaughan Williams (1872-1958)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: All creatures of our God and King,
lift up your voice and with us sing,
Alleluia! Alleluia!
Thou burning sun with golden beam,
thou silver moon with softer gleam:

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O praise Him! (x2)
Alleluia! (x3)

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thou rushing wind that art so strong,
ye clouds that sail in heav'n along,
O praise Him, Alleluia!
Thou rising morn, in praise rejoice;
ye lights of evening, find a voice:

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O praise Him! (x2)
Alleluia! (x3)

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Thou flowing water, pure and clear,
make music for thy Lord to hear,
Alleluia! Alleluia!
Thou fire, so masterful and bright,
thou givest us both warmth and light:
Rerain

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: All ye that are of tender heart,
forgiving others, take your part,
O sing ye! Alleluia!
All ye who pain and sorrow bear,
praise God and on Him cast your care:

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O praise Him! (x2)
Alleluia! (x3)

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Let all things their Creator bless,
and worship Him in humbleness,
O praise Him! Alleluia!
Praise, praise the Father, praise the Son,
and praise the Spirit, Three in One:

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O praise Him! (x2)
Alleluia! (x3)

hymns.title: All things bright and beautiful
hymns.source_file: 003 All things bright and beautiful lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: All things bright and beautiful, all creatures great and small,
all things wise and wonderful, the Lord God made them all.
Each little flow'r that opens, each little bird that sings,
He made their glowing colours,
He made their tiny wings:

sections.label: Refrain
lines: All things bright and beautiful, all creatures great and small,
all things wise and wonderful, the Lord God made them all.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The purpleheaded mountain, the river running by,
the sunset and the morning that brightens up the sky:

sections.label: Refrain
lines: All things bright and beautiful, all creatures great and small,
all things wise and wonderful, the Lord God made them all.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The cold wind in the winter, the pleasant summer sun,
the ripe fruits in the garden, He made them ev-'ry one:

sections.label: Refrain
lines: All things bright and beautiful, all creatures great and small,
all things wise and wonderful, the Lord God made them all.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: He gave us eyes to see them, and lips that we might tell
how great is God almighty, who has made all things well:

sections.label: Refrain
lines: All things bright and beautiful, all creatures great and small,
all things wise and wonderful, the Lord God made them all.

hymns.title: As water to the thirsty
hymns.source_file: 004 As water to the thirsty lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: As water to the thirsty, as beauty to the eyes,
as strength that follows weakness, as truth instead of lies,
as songtime and springtime and summertime to be,
so is my Lord, my living Lord, so is my Lord to me.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Like calm in place of clamour, like peace that follows pain,
like meeting after parting, like sunshine after rain,
like moonlight and starlight and sunlight on the sea,
so is my Lord, my living Lord, so is my Lord to me.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: As sleep that follows fever, as gold instead of grey,
as freedom after bondage, as sunrise to the day,
as home to the trav'ler and all we long to see,
so is my Lord, my living Lord, so is my Lord to me.

hymns.title: Be still, for the presence of the Lord
hymns.source_file: 005 Be still, for the presence of the Lord lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Be still, for the presence of the Lord, the Holy One, is here.
Come, bow before Him now, with rev'rence and with fear.
In Him no sin is found, we stand on holy ground.
Be still, for the presence of the Lord, the Holy One, is here.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Be still, for the glory of the Lord is shining all around;
He burns with holy fire, with splendour He is crowned.
How awesome is the sight, our radiant King of light!
Be still, for the glory of the Lord is shining all around.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Be still, for the power of the Lord is moving in this place,
He comes to cleanse and heal, to minister His grace.
No work too hard for Him; in faith receive from Him.
Be still, for the power of the Lord is moving in this place.
(adm. worldwide by EMI CMG Publishing excluding Europe which is adm. by kingswaysongs. com)

hymns.title: Come, Thou almighty King
hymns.source_file: 006 Come, Thou Almighty King lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come,Thou almighty King, help us Thy name to sing,
Thy name to praise!
Father all glorious, o'er all victorious,
come and reign over us, Ancient of Days!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Come,Thou incarnate Word, gird on Thy mighty sword,
our prayer attend!
Come, and Thy people bless, give to Thy word success;
Spirit of holiness, on us descend!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Come, holy Comforter, Thy sacred witness bear
in this glad hour.
Thou who almighty art, now rule in ev'ry heart,
never from us depart, Spirit of pow'r!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: To Thee, great Trinity, eternal praises be
for evermore.
Thy sov'reign majesty may we in glory see,
there for eternity love and adore!

hymns.title: Father God
hymns.source_file: 007 Father God lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Father God, I give all thanks and praise to Thee;
Father God, my hands I humbly raise to Thee,
for Thy mighty pow'r and love amaze me, amaze me;
and I stand in awe and worship, Father God.

hymns.title: Glorify Thy name
hymns.source_file: 008 Glorify Thy Name lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Father, we love You, we worship and adore You, glorify Thy name in all the earth.
Glorify Thy name, glorify Thy name, glorify Thy name in all the earth.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Jesus, we love You, we worship and adore You, glorify Thy name in all the earth.
Glorify Thy name, glorify Thy name, glorify Thy name in all the earth.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Spirit, we love You, we worship and adore You, glorify Thy name in all the earth.
Glorify Thy name, glorify Thy name, glorify Thy name in all the earth.

hymns.title: God is in our presence
hymns.source_file: 009 God is in our presence lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God is in our presence, come, let us adore Him and in rev'rence bow before Him!
God is here among us, let us without ceasing pray that faith may be increasing.
Him acclaim, hearts aflame and in meekness tender to His will surrender.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thou art allpervading; let Thy Spirit's splendour us a Godly service render.
Like the tender flowers, willingly unfolding, to the sun their petals holding,
let us so ever grow through Thy Spirit's urging, reborn life emerging.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Make us truly humble, free from world's ambition, serving Thee our firm decision.
Make us pure of heart, Lord, that we see Thee clearly, truly seeking Thee sincerely.
Let our hearts earth depart like an eagle soaring; Thee alone adoring.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Lord, make us Thy dwelling, grant a Godly spirit shaped through Thy eternal merit.
Come, dear Lord and Master, clear our eyes to see Thee, love and honour then to bring Thee.
Where we go here below, let us, Thee beholding, blessing find unfolding.

hymns.title: God of mercy, God of grace
hymns.source_file: 010 God of mercy, God of grace lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God of mercy, God of grace,
Show the brightness of Your face; Shine upon us, Saviour, shine.
And Your saving hand extend unto earth's remotest end;
fill our hearts with lightdivine!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Let the people praise You, Lord!
Be by all that live, adored. Let the nations shout and sing,
at Your feet their tribute pay and Your holy will obey;
let the nations shout and sing!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Let the people praise You, Lord!
Earth shall then her fruits afford, God to man His blessings give.
All below and all above, one in joy and light and love,
man to God devoted live.

hymns.title: God, the All-powerful
hymns.source_file: 011 God, the All-powerful lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God, the Allpowerful! King, who ordainest!
Tempest Thy clarion, and lightning Thy sword.
Show forth Thy pity on high where Thou reignest,
give to us peace in our time, O Lord.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: God, the Allmerciful! Earth has forsaken
Thy ways of blessedness, slighted Thy word.
Let now Thy grace in its fullness awaken;
give to us peace in our time, O Lord.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: God, the Allrighteous One! Man has defied Thee,
yet to eternity standeth Thy word.
Falsehood and wrong shall not tarry beside Thee;
give to us peace in our time, O Lord.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: So shall Thy children with thankful devotion
laud Thee who saved them, and life has restored.
Singing in chorus from ocean to ocean:
"Peace to the nations! O praise the Lord!"

hymns.title: Hallelujah! Fairest morning
hymns.source_file: 012 Hallelujah! Fairest morning.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Hallelujah! Fairest morning! Fairer than our words can say!
We lay down the earthly burden of life's toil and care today,
while this morn of joy and love brings fresh vigour from above.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Sunday, full of grace and glory, sweetest rest day of the soul!
Here within a world of darkness do your blessings us console.
Holy, happy, heav'nly day, you can drive our grief away.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: In the glad-ness of Your wor-ship, we will seek our joy to-day.
It is then we taste the full-ness of the grace for which we pray and the word of life is giv'n,
like the man-na once from heav'n.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Let the day with You be end-ed as with You it has be-gun.
And Your bless-ing, Lord, be grant-ed till our days on earth are done.
That at last Your chil-dren may keep e-ter-nal Sab-bath day.

hymns.title: He is exalted
hymns.source_file: 013 He is exalted lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: He  is exalted, the King is exalted on high; I will praise Him.
He is exalted, forever exalted, and I will praise His name!
He is the Lord; forever His truth shall reign.
Heaven and earth rejoice in His holy name.
He is exalted, the King is exalted on high.

hymns.title: Holy, holy, holy
hymns.source_file: 014 Holy, holy, holy lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Holy, holy, holy! Lord God Almighty!
Morning, noon and evening our song shall rise to Thee.
Holy, holy, holy! Merciful and mighty,
God in three persons, blessed Trinity!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Holy, holy, holy! Saints all adore Thee,
with their golden crowns bowing at the glassy sea;
all the hosts of angels falling down before Thee,
which wert and art, and evermore shalt be.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Holy, holy, holy! Though darkness hide Thee,
though the eye of man here Thy glory may not see,
only Thou art holy; there is none beside Thee,
perfect in pow'r, in love and purity.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Holy, holy, holy!Lord God Almighty!
All Thy works shall praise Thee in earth and sky and sea.
Holy, holy, holy! Merciful and mighty,
God in three persons, blessed Trinity.

hymns.title: How great Thou art
hymns.source_file: 015 How great Thou art lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O Lord my God! when I in awesome wonder consider all the works Thy hands have made,
I see the stars, I hear the rolling thunder, Thy pow'r throughout the universe displayed.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Then sings my soul, my Saviour God to Thee; how great Thou art, how great Thou art!
Then sings my soul, my Saviour God to Thee; how great Thou art, how great Thou art!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: When through the woods and forest glades I wander and hear the birds sing sweetly in the trees;
when I look down from lofty mountain grandeur and hear the brook, and feel the gentle breeze:

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Then sings my soul, my Saviour God to Thee; how great Thou art, how great Thou art!
Then sings my soul, my Saviour God to Thee; how great Thou art, how great Thou art!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And when I think that God, His Son not sparing, sent Him to die, I scarce can take it in;
that on the cross, my burden gladly bearing, He bled and died to take away my sin:

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Then sings my soul, my Saviour God to Thee; how great Thou art, how great Thou art!
Then sings my soul, my Saviour God to Thee; how great Thou art, how great Thou art!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: When Christ shall come with shout of acclamation and take me home, what joy shall fill my heart.
Then I shall bow in humble adoration, and there proclaim: my God, how great Thou art!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Then sings my soul, my Saviour God to Thee; how great Thou art, how great Thou art!
Then sings my soul, my Saviour God to Thee; how great Thou art, how great Thou art!

hymns.title: How lovely on the Sabbath day
hymns.source_file: 016 How lovely on the Sabbath day lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: How lovely on the Sabbath day; the heights of faith I climb,
translated from the weekday cares to walk in realms sublime.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: My heart becomes so full of joy, it does to song arouse
and sings in worship of the Lord within my Father's house.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Rekindled by the Spirit's breath my fervour, courage flames
and burns with wonddrous hope and pow'r, my love for God acclaims.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Surrounded by an atmosphere of heav'nly light and grace,
mid Sharon's blossoms' sweetest scent, glad songs my fears displace.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: The heart becomes an altar there; in Christ, God is not far.
I sacrifice myself to Him with thoughts of Golgotha.

hymns.title: How shall I sing that majesty?
hymns.source_file: 017 How shall I sing that majesty lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: How shall I sing that majesty which angels do admire?
Let dust in dust and silence lie; sing, sing, ye heav'nly choir.
Thousands of thousands stand around Thy throne, O God most high;
ten thousand times ten thousand sound Thy praise; but who am I?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thy brightness unto them appears, while I Thy footsteps trace;
a sound of God comes to my ears, but they behold Thy face:
I shall, I fear, be dark and cold, with all my fire and light;
yet when Thou dost accept their gold, Lord, treasure up my mite.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Enlighten with faith's light my heart, inflame it with love's fire,
then shall I sing and take my part with that celestial choir.
They sing because Thou art their Sun; Lord, send a beam on me;
for where heav'n is but once begun, there alleluias be.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: How great a being Lord, is Thine, which doth all beings keep!
Thy knowledge is the only line to sound so vast a deep:
Thou art a Sea without a shore, a Sun without a sphere;
Thy time is now and evermore, Thy place is ev'rywhere.

hymns.title: I  sing the mighty power of God
hymns.source_file: 018 I sing the mighty power of God lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I sing the mighty pow'r of God that made the mountains rise,
that spread the flowing seas abroad, and built the lofty skies.
I sing the wisdom that ordained the sun to rule the day;
the moon shines full at His command and all the stars obey.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I sing the goodness of the Lord that filled the earth with food;
He formed the creatures with His word and then pronounced them good.
Lord, how Thy wonders are displayed where'er I turn my eye:
If I survey the ground I tread or gaze upon the sky!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: There's not a plant or flow'r below but makes Thy glories known;
and clouds arise and tempests blow by order from Thy throne;
while all that borrows life from Thee is ever in Thy care,
and ev'rywhere that man can be, Thou, God, art present there.

hymns.title: I worship You, almighty God
hymns.source_file: 019 I worship You, almighty God lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I worship You, almighty God; there is none like You.
I worship You, O Prince of Peace; that is what I want to do.
I give You praise for You are my righteousness.
I worship You, almighty God; there is none like You.

hymns.title: Joyful, joyful, we adore Thee
hymns.source_file: 020 Joyful, joyful we adore Thee lyrics.txt

metadata.composer: Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) arr. Edward Hodges (1796-1867)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Joyful, joyful, we adore Thee, God of glory, Lord of love;
hearts unfold like flow'rs before Thee, op'ning to the sun above.
Melt the clouds of sin and sadness, drive the dark of doubt away;
Giver of immortal gladness, fill us with the light of day!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: All Thy works with joy surround Thee, earth, and heav'n reflect Thy rays,
stars and angels sing around Thee, centre of unbroken praise.
Field and forest, vale and mountain, flow'ry meadow, flashing sea,
chanting bird and flowing fountain call us to rejoice in Thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Thou art giving and forgiving, ever blessing, ever blest,
wellspring of the joy of living, ocean depth of happy rest!
Thou our Father, Christ our Brother– all who live in love are Thine;
teach us how to love each other, lift us to the joy divine.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Mortals, join the happy chorus which the morning stars began;
love divine is reigning o'er us, joining all within its span.
Ever singing, march we onward, victors in the midst of strife;
joyful music leads us homeward in the triumph song of life.

hymns.title: O God beyond all praising
hymns.source_file: 021 O God beyond all praising lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O God beyond all praising, we worship You today and sing the love amazing that songs cannot repay;
for we can only wonder at ev'ry gift You send, at blessings without number and mercies without end.
We lift our hearts before You and wait upon Your word, we honour and adore You, our great and mighty Lord.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Then hear, O gracious Father, accept the love we bring, that we who know Your favour may serve You as our King;
and whether our tomorrows be filled with good or ill, we'll triumph through our sorrows and rise to bless You still:
to marvel at Your beauty and glory in Your ways, and make a joyful duty our sacrifice of praise.

hymns.title: O God, our help in ages past
hymns.source_file: 022 O God, our help in ages  past lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O God, our help in ages past, our hope for years to come;
our shelter from the stormy blast and our eternal home!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Beneath the shadow of Thy throne, still may we dwell secure.
Sufficient is Thine arm alone, and our defense is sure.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Before the hills in order stood, or earth received her frame,
from everlasting, Thou art God, to endless years the same.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: A thousand ages, in Thy sight, are like an evening gone;
short as the watch that ends the night, before the rising sun.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Time, like an ever rolling stream, bears all who breathe away;
they fly forgotten, as a dream dies at the op'ning day.

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: O God, our help in ages past, our hope for years to come;
be Thou our Guide while life shall last, and our eternal home.

hymns.title: O sanctified Sunday
hymns.source_file: 023 O sanctified Sunday lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O sanctified Sunday, the day of my Lord, what joy does thy coming my spirit afford!
The more when my eye then the dawn of day sees, I find myself blissful, revived and at ease.
Give thanks, sing praise, honour be paid to God who the Sunday for mankind hath made.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Too narrow my dwelling, it urges me rouse, with sons of the Highest to enter His house.
Like heavenly music there bursts forth His laud from many hearts' altars as one in accord.
Give thanks, sing praise, honour be paid to God who the Sunday for mankind hath made.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: An envoy the Sov'reign of Peace has sent forth, to sinners makes known that redemption is brought.
The Spirit wind rusheth; from death now a-wake! And of that peace Je-sus has brought, now par-take!
Give thanks, sing praise, honour be paid to God who the Sunday for mankind hath made.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O Sunday, a glorious taste of that rest we wait for in Eden, the home of the blest.
At last, when by grace all my yearning is stilled, I'll sing with a heavenly happiness filled:
Give thanks, sing praise, honour accord to Jesus, the Saviour of sinners, our Lord!

hymns.title: Open our eyes
hymns.source_file: 024 Open our eyes lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Open our eyes, Lord, we want to see Jesus, to reach out and touch Him and say that we love Him.
Open our ears, Lord, and help us to listen, open our eyes, Lord, we want to see Jesus.

hymns.title: Surely the presence
hymns.source_file: 025 Surely the presence lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Surely the presence of the Lord is in this place; I can feel His mighty power and His grace.
I can hear the brush of angels' wings, I see glory on each face; surely the presence of the Lord is in this place.

hymns.title: This is the glorious day
hymns.source_file: 026 This is the glorious day lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: verses 1 & 2: John Ellerton (1826-1893) verse 3: Nigel Isaacs (b. 1975)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: This is the glorious day of light: Let there be light today.
O Dayspring, rise upon our night and chase its gloom away.
O bless this glorious day of rest; our failing strength renew.
On weary soul and troubled breast shed Thou Thy fresh'ning dew.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: This is the glorious day of prayer: Let earth to heav'n draw near.
Lift up our hearts to seek Thee there, come down to meet us here.
O bless this glorious day of days; send forth Thy quick'ning breath
and wake our souls to love and praise, O Conqueror of death!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: This is the glorious day of thanks: Let all now thank the Lord,
His praise resounding from our ranks– who can such gifts afford?
O bless this glorious day of joy; our hearts to Thee we raise,
in songs of praise our tongues employ until the end of days.

hymns.title: We gather together
hymns.source_file: 027 We gather together lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: Netherlands folk hymn transl. Theodore Baker (1851-1934)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We gather together to ask the Lord's blessing; He chastens and hastens His will to make known.
The wicked oppressing now cease from distressing; sing praises to His name, He forgets not His own.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Beside us to guide us, our God with us joining, ordaining, maintaining His kingdom divine.
So from the beginning the fight we were winning; Thou, Lord, wast at our side and the glory be Thine!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: We all do extol Thee, Thou leader triumphant, and pray that Thou still our Defender wilt be.
Let Thy congregation escape tribulation. Thy name be ever praised! O Lord God, make us free!

hymns.title: We love the place, O God
hymns.source_file: 028 We love the place, O God lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: It is the house of prayer wherein Your children meet; and You, O Lord, are here Your chosen flock to greet.
Here in Your sacred place we feel Your Godly love, receive anew Your grace and blessing from above.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: We love the place, O God, wherein Your honour dwells;
the joy of Your abode all earthly joy excells.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We love Your altar, Lord; O what on earth so dear? For there, in faith adored, we find Your presence near.
We love the word of life, the word that tells of peace, of comfort in the strife and joys that never cease.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: We love the place, O God, wherein Your honour dwells;
the joy of Your abode all earthly joy excells.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: We love to sing below for mercies freely giv'n; but Oh, we long to know the triumph-song of heav'n.
Lord Jesus, give us grace on earth to love You more, in heav'n to see Your face and with Your saints adore.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: We love the place, O God, wherein Your honour dwells;
the joy of Your abode all earthly joy excells.

hymns.title: Worthy of worship
hymns.source_file: 029 Worthy of worship lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Worthy of worship, worthy of praise, worthy of honour and glory;
worthy of all the glad songs we can sing, worthy of all of the off'rings we bring.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: You are worthy, Father, Creator. You are worthy, Saviour, Sustainer.
You are worthy, worthy and wonderful; worthy of worship and praise.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Worthy of rev'rence, worthy of awe, worthy of love and devotion;
worthy of bowing and bending of knees, worthy of all this and added to these...

sections.label: Refrain
lines: You are worthy, Father, Creator. You are worthy, Saviour, Sustainer.
You are worthy, worthy and wonderful; worthy of worship and praise.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Almighty Father, Master and Lord, King of all kings and Redeemer,
wonderful Counselor, Comforter, Friend, Saviour and Source of our life without end;

sections.label: Refrain
lines: You are worthy, Father, Creator. You are worthy, Saviour, Sustainer.
You are worthy, worthy and wonderful; worthy of worship and praise.

hymns.title: All hail the power of Jesus' name
hymns.source_file: 030 All hail the power of Jesus' name lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: All hail the power of Jesus' name! Let angels prostrate fall, let angels prostrate fall;
bring forth the royal diadem and crown Him, crown Him, crown Him, crown Him, and crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Ye chosen seed of ev'ry race, ye ransomed from the fall, ye ransomed from the fall,
hail Him who saves you by His grace and crown Him, crown Him, crown Him, crown Him, and crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Let ev'ry kindred, ev'ry tribe on this terrestial ball, on this terrestial ball,
to Him all majesty ascribe and crown Him, crown Him, crown Him, crown Him, and crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Crown Him, ye martyrs of your God, who from His altar call, who from His altar call;
extol the Stem of Jesse's Rod and crown Him, crown Him, crown Him, crown Him, and crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: O that with yonder sacred throng we at His feet may fall, we at His feet may fall!
We'll join the everlasting song and crown Him, crown Him, crown Him, crown Him, and crown Him Lord of all.

hymns.title: All hail the power of Jesus' name
hymns.source_file: 031 All hail the power of Jesus' name lyrics.txt

lines: All hail the power of Jesus' name! Let angels prostrate fall;
bring forth the royal diadem and crown Him Lord of all,
bring forth the royal diadem and crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: Verse 2

hail Him who saves you by His grace and crown Him Lord of all,
hail Him who saves you by His grace and crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Let ev'ry kindred, ev'ry tribe on this terrestial ball,
to Him all majesty ascribe and crown Him Lord of all,
to Him all majesty ascribe and crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Crown Him, ye martyrs of your God, who from His altar call;

extol the Stem of Jesse's Rod and crown Him Lord of all.

sections.label: Verse 5
