hymns.title: All lands to God
hymns.source_file: 032 All lands to God lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: All lands to God in joyful sounds aloft your voices raise.
All honour bring, exalt His Name and glorious make His praise, and glorious make His praise.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Yes, all the earth shall worship Him, with joy to Him shall sing,
and ever shall their joyful songs with loud hosan nas ring, with loud hosannas ring.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O come, behold the works of God, His mighty doings see.
In dealing with the sons of men most wonderful is He, most wonderful is He.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Both day and night He safely leads His people by the hand.
Rejoice in Him, let loud His praise ring out from ev'ry land, ring out from ev'ry land.

hymns.title: All people that on earth do dwell
hymns.source_file: 033 All people that on earth do dwell lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: All people that on earth do dwell, sing to the Lord with cheerful voice.
Him serve with joy, His praise forth tell. Come ye before Him and rejoice.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The Lord, ye know, is God indeed; without our aid He did us make.
We are His flock; He doth us feed, and for His sheep He doth us take.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O enter then His gates with praise; approach with joy His courts anew.
Praise, laud and bless His name always, for it is seemly so to do.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: For why? The Lord our God is good; His mercy is forever sure.
His truth at all times firmly stood, and shall from age to age endure.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: To Father, Son and Holy Ghost, the God whom heav'n and earth adore,
from earth and from the angel host be praise and glory evermore.

hymns.title: Come, Christians, join to sing
hymns.source_file: 034 Come, Christians, join to sing lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, Christians, join to sing: ''Alleluia! Amen!"
Loud praise to Christ our King: "Alleluia! Amen!"
Let all with heart and voice before His throne rejoice;
praise is His gracious choice. Alleluia! Amen!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Come, lift your hearts on high: Alleluia! Amen!
Let praises fill the sky: "Alleluia! Amen!"
He is our Guide and Friend; to us He'll condescend;
His love shall never end: Alleluia! Amen!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Praise yet the Lord again: "Alleluia! Amen!"
Life shall not end the strain: "Alleluia! Amen!"
On heaven's blissful shore His goodness we'll adore,
singing for evermore: "Alleluia! Amen!"

hymns.title: Come, you thankful people, come
hymns.source_file: 035 Come, you thankful people, come lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: verses 1 & 4: Henry Alford (1810-1871) verses 2 & 3: Anna Barbauld, 18th cent.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, you thankful people, come, raise the song of harvest home;
all is safely gathered in, ere the winter storms begin.
God, our Father does provide for our needs to be supplied;
come to God's own temple, come, raise the song of harvest home.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: All the blessings of the field, all the stores the gardens yield,
all the fruits in full supply, ripened 'neath the summer sky,
all that spring with bounteous hand scatters o'er the smiling land,
all that liberal autumn pours from its rich o'erflowing stores.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: These to Thee, our God, we owe, source whence all our blessings flow;
and for these our souls shall raise grateful vows and solemn praise.
Come, then, thankful people, come, raise the song of harvest home;
come to God's own temple, come, raise the song of harvest home.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Even so, Lord, quickly come to Thy final harvest home.
Gather Thou Thy people in, free from sorrow, free from sin,
there forever glorified in Thy presence to abide.
Come with all Thine angels, come, raise the glorious harvest home.

hymns.title: For the beauty of the earth
hymns.source_file: 036 For the beauty of the earth lyrics.txt

metadata.composer: Conrad Kocher (1786-1872) arr. William H Monk (1823-1889)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: For the beauty of the earth, for the glory of the skies,
for the love which from our birth over and around us lies;
Lord of all, to Thee we raise this our joyful hymn of praise.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: For the beauty of each hour of the day and of the night,
and for mountain, tree and flow'r, sun and moon and stars of light;
Lord of all, to Thee we raise this our joyful hymn of praise.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: For the joy of ear and eye, for the heart and mind's delight,
for the mystic harmony linking sense to sound and sight;
Lord of all, to Thee we raise this our joyful hymn of praise.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: For the joy of human love, brother, sister, parent, child,
friends on earth and friends above, for all gentle thoughts and mild;
Lord of all, to Thee we raise this our joyful hymn of praise.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: For Thy church that evermore lifteth holy hands above,
off'ring up on ev'ry shore her pure sacrifice of love;
Lord of all, to Thee we raise this our joyful hymn of praise.

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: For Thyself, O Gift Divine, to the world so freely giv'n,
for that great, great love of Thine, peace on earth and joy in heav'n;
Lord of all, to Thee we raise this our joyful hymn of praise.

hymns.title: For the fruits of all creation
hymns.source_file: 037 For the fruits of all creation lyrics.txt

metadata.composer: Welsh traditional melody arr. English Hymnal, 1906

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: For the fruits of all creation, thanks be to God.
For His gifts to ev'ry nation, thanks be to God.
For the ploughing, sowing, reaping, silent growth while we are sleeping,
future needs in earth's safe keeping, thanks be to God.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: In the just reward of labour, God's will is done.
In the help we give our neighbour, God's will is done.
In our worldwide task of caring for the hungry and despairing,
in the harvests we are sharing, God's will is done.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: For the harvests of the Spirit, thanks be to God.
For the good we all inherit, thanks be to God.
For the wonders that astound us, for the truths that still confound us,
most of all, that love has found us, thanks be to God.

hymns.title: Give thanks
hymns.source_file: 038 Give thanks lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Give thanks with a grateful heart, give thanks to the Holy One, give thanks because He's given Jesus Christ His Son. (x2)
And now let the weak say: "I am strong," let the poor say: "I am rich," because of what the Lord has done for us. (x2)
Give thanks!
This arrangement © 2008 Integrity's Hosanna!

hymns.title: Give to our God immortal praise
hymns.source_file: 039 Give to our God immortal praise lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Give to our God immortal praise; all truth and mer-cy are His ways:
Wonders of grace to God belong; repeat His mercies in your song.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Give to the Lord of lords renown; the King of kings with glory crown;
His mercies ever shall endure when lords and kings are known no more.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: He built the earth, He spread the sky, and fixed the starry lights on high:
Wonders of grace to God belong; repeat His mercies in your song.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: He fills the sun with morning light; He bids the moon direct the night:
His mercies ev-er shall endure when sun and moon shall shine no more.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: He sent His Son with pow'r to save from guilt and darkness and the grave:
Wonders of grace to God belong; repeat His mercies in your song.

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: Through this vain world He guides our feet and leads us to His heav'nly seat:
His mercies ever shall endure when this vain world shall be no more.

hymns.title: Great is Thy faithfulness
hymns.source_file: 040 Great is Thy faithfulness lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Great is Thy faithfulness, O God my Father; there is no shadow of turning with Thee.
Thou changest not, Thy compassions, they fail not; as Thou hast been, Thou forever wilt be.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Great is Thy faithfulness! Great is Thy faithfulness! Morning by morning new mercies I see.
All I have needed Thy hand hath provided; great is Thy faithfulness, Lord, unto me!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Summer and winter and springtime and harvest, sun, moon, and stars in their courses above
join with all nature in manifold witness to Thy great faithfulness, mercy and love.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Great is Thy faithfulness! Great is Thy faithfulness! Morning by morning new mercies I see.
All I have needed Thy hand hath provided; great is Thy faithfulness, Lord, unto me!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Pardon for sin and a peace that endureth, Thine own dear presence to cheer and to guide;
strength for today and bright hope for tomorrow, blessings all mine, with ten thousand beside!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Great is Thy faithfulness! Great is Thy faithfulness! Morning by morning new mercies I see.
All I have needed Thy hand hath provided; great is Thy faithfulness, Lord, unto me!

hymns.title: How great is God's almighty kindness
hymns.source_file: 041 How great is God's almighty kindness lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: How great is God's almighty kindness! Who by His love would not be moved?
Who in this world could be so mindless to spurn the love that God has proved?
His love so great to keep and measure, my holy duty it shall be.
The Lord gave me a precious treasure; fail not, my soul, to thankful be!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Who will my soul to His will fashion? The Lord, who always cares for me.
Who led with patience and compassion when counsel I declined? 'Twas He!
Who gives me peace when conscience troubles; renews my spirit, sets me right,
and who all joy and pleasure doubles? The arm of God reveals His might!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Behold, my soul, the life eternal which God has planned for you to see.
Surrounded by His heav'nly glory, before His face you, too, shall be!
This joy, by right, you may be sharing which God in goodness grants to you.
The suff'ring which His Son was bearing, wrought that you share His glory too.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Should I not honour God the Father and not His kindness cast away?
Should I not hearken and much rather go there where He directs my way?
His will is in my heart remaining; His word gives strength each day anew.
More love for Him my soul is gaining; may thus I love my neighbour too!

hymns.title: I sing praises
hymns.source_file: 042 I sing praises lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I sing praises to Your name, O Lord, praises to Your name, O Lord,
for Your name is great and greatly to be praised. (x2)

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I give glory to Your name, O Lord, glory to Your name, O Lord,
for Your name is great and greatly to be praised. (x2)

hymns.title: Immortal, invisible, God only wise
hymns.source_file: 043 Immortal, invisible, God only wise lyrics.txt

metadata.composer: Traditional Welsh hymn melody harm. John Roberts, 1839

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Immortal, invisible, God only wise, in light inaccessible hid from our eyes.
Most blessed, most glorious, the Ancient of Days, Almighty, victorious, Thy great name we praise.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Unresting, unhasting, and silent as light, not wanting, nor wasting, Thou rulest in might;
Thy justice, like mountains, high soaring above Thy clouds, which are fountains of goodness and love.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: To all, life Thou givest, to both great and small; in all life Thou livest, the true life of all.
Thy wisdom so boundless, Thy mercy so free, eternal Thy goodness, for naught changeth Thee.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Great Father of glory and Father of light, Thine angels adore Thee in Thy glorious sight.
All praise we would render; O help us to see, for only the splendour of light hideth Thee.

hymns.title: Let all things now living
hymns.source_file: 044 Let all things now living lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Let all things now living a song of thanksgiving to God the Creator triumphantly raise,
who fashioned and made us, protected and stayed us, who guides us and leads to the end of our days.
His banners are o'er us, His light goes before us, a pillar of fire shining forth in the night,
till shadows have vanished and darkness is banished, as forward we travel from light into light.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: His law He enforces; the stars in their courses and sun in its orbit obediently shine.
The hills and the mountains, the rivers and fountains, the deeps of the ocean proclaim Him divine.
We too should be voicing our love and rejoicing; with glad adoration a song let us raise,
till all things now living unite in thanksgiving: To God in the highest, hosanna and praise!

hymns.title: Let us sing with joyful voices
hymns.source_file: 045 Let us sing with joyful voices lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Let us sing with joyful voices, one in faith and one in heart!
Where with festive songs rejoicing, there doth God His peace impart!
The unrighteous have their measure of earth's offers and unrest,
praising God alone brings pleasure, singing psalms of joy with zest!
Blessed when hearts are filled and with Godly joy instilled!
Blessed when hearts are filled and with Godly joy instilled!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Let us sing with joyful voices, one in love for Christ our Lord!
Love alone can drive out envy and dispute that breeds discord.
Let our heartstrings be united, dedicated to the Lord,
open to the Holy Spirit, to harmonious accord!
Stand secure, hold your ground, all the faithful will be crowned!
Stand secure, hold your ground, all the faithful will be crowned!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Let us sing with joyful voices, one in hope, in one accord!
Over all our pain and suff'ring shines the Star of Hope, our Lord!
To our Fa-ther's house we journey; steadfast, for God's strength we pray
that above the world's confusion homeward, heav'nward leads the way!
Till that song to God's praise at the crystal sea we'll raise!
Till that song to God's praise at the crystal sea we'll raise!

hymns.title: Lord, how can I ever praise You?
hymns.source_file: 046 Lord, how can I ever praise You lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord, how can I ever praise You? Mighty God, Lord Sabbaoth!
Give me of Your Spirit's power that alone from You comes forth.
Nothing will I do without You; always seek Your love and virtue.
Thousand times I bring thanks to You, great Lord and King!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Both in good days and in suff'ring, You, O Lord, were ever true.
Here's my soul to form and fashion, I submit my will to You.
This my wish and earnest yearning– to await, Lord, Your returning.
Thousand times I bring thanks to You, great Lord and King!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Father, You to me have rendered so much good each day anew.
In Your sight I have found favour and a Friend in Jesus too.
Guide me with Your gracious Spirit to the goal, by Jesus' merit.
Thousand times I bring thanks to You, great Lord and King!

hymns.title: Majesty
hymns.source_file: 047 Majesty lyrics.txt

metadata.composer: Jack W Hayford (b. 1934) arr. Eugene Thomas (b. 1941)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Majesty, worship His majesty. Unto Jesus be all glory, honour, and praise.
Majesty, kingdom authority flow from His throne unto His own; His anthem raise.
So exalt, lift up on high the name of Jesus. Magnify, come glorify Christ Jesus, the King.
Majesty, worship His majesty, Jesus who died, now glorified, King of all kings.

hymns.title: May Jesus Christ be praised
hymns.source_file: 048 May Jesus Christ be praised lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: When morning gilds the skies, my heart, awaking, cries: "May Jesus Christ be praised, may Jesus Christ be praised!"
Alike at work or prayer, on Him I cast my care: "May Jesus Christ be praised, may Jesus Christ be praised!"

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Does sadness fill my mind? A solace here I find: "May Jesus Christ be praised, may Jesus Christ be praised!"
Or fades my earthly bliss, my comfort still is this: "May Jesus Christ be praised, may Jesus Christ be praised!"

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The night becomes as day when from the heart I say: "May Jesus Christ be praised, may Jesus Christ be praised!"
The pow'rs of darkness fear when these sweet words they hear: "May Jesus Christ be praised, may Jesus Christ be praised!"

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Be this, while life is mine, my song of love divine: "May Jesus Christ be praised, may Jesus Christ be praised!"
Be this th'eternal song through all the ages long: "May Jesus Christ be praised, may Jesus Christ be praised!"

hymns.title: Mighty God, we praise Thy name
hymns.source_file: 049 Mighty God, we praise Thy name lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: based on "Te Deum" of Ignaz Franz, 14th cent.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Mighty God, we praise Thy name! All the earth must bow before Thee.
We bring thanks with loud acclaim, for Thy wondrous works adore Thee.
As in ancient history, shalt Thou be eternally.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Holy Lord, God Sabaoth! Lord of earth, of sea and heaven.
Leader of the heav'nly host, refuge safe and certain haven.
Honour, praise to all make known; all is Thine and Thine alone!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The apostles at Thy throne offer thanks and adoration.
Envoys these, Thy very own, join in hymns of exaltation.
All Thy children Thee adore, laud and praise Thee evermore!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Have compassion, pity, Lord; with Thy blessing bring salvation.
Goodness, love from Thee outpoured, give Thy promise confirmation.
Never leave us, Lord, alone, we would always be Thine own!

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Father, at Thy throne we bow, great and small, our honour bringing.
And Thy congregation now praises to Thy Son is singing;
praises to the Holy Ghost: Comfort, Guide and Royal Host!

hymns.title: Mighty the showers of blessing
hymns.source_file: 050 Mighty the showers of blessing lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: based on Daniel W Whittle (1840-1901) ref. Ezekiel 34 : 26

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: "There shall be showers of blessing." God gave this promise of old.
Now He the showers is sending, showers His word had foretold.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Might the showers! Showers of glorious love,
mercy and goodness abounding, blessing and joy from above!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Mighty the showers of blessing flowing throughout all the earth,
bringing the time of refreshment, water for parched fields of dearth.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Might the showers! Showers of glorious love,
mercy and goodness abounding, blessing and joy from above!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Mighty the showers of blessing! Hark! from afar they resound,
and in the midst of God's children blessing abundant is found.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Might the showers! Showers of glorious love,
mercy and goodness abounding, blessing and joy from above!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Mighty the showers of blessing sent by our Father today,
now, while we faithfully serve Him, now, while we walk in His way.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Might the showers! Showers of glorious love,
mercy and goodness abounding, blessing and joy from above!

hymns.title: My heart overflows
hymns.source_file: 051 My heart overflows lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: My heart overflows with praises unto God, for all of His love and goodness to me.
I cannot conceal the joy that I feel; my Friend He has promised to be.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: My heart overflows, my heart overflows with the love, the love He bestows.
With blessings complete, increasingly sweet, my heart with joy, with joy overflows.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: My heart overflows! My sins He does forgive; new strength He provides through trials and fear.
The peace I have sought, Christ Jesus has brought and heaven is wondrously near.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: My heart overflows, my heart overflows with the love, the love He bestows.
With blessings complete, increasingly sweet, my heart with joy, with joy overflows.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: My heart overflows! The grace that He provides, brings joy to my soul; His goodness I share.
It's all that I ask, whatever the task, whatever the burdens I bear.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: My heart overflows, my heart overflows with the love, the love He bestows.
With blessings complete, increasingly sweet, my heart with joy, with joy overflows.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: My heart overflows, and all who would believe, can come to His holy presence divine.
Just open your heart, and He will impart the glorious joy that is mine.
Rewfrain

hymns.title: Now thank we all our God
hymns.source_file: 052 Now thank we all our God lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Now thank we all our God with heart and hands and voices,
who wondrous things hath done, in whom His world rejoices;
who from our mother's arms hath blessed us on our way
with countless gifts of love, and still is ours today.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O may this bounteous God through all our life be near us,
with ever joyful hearts and blessed peace to cheer us;
and keep us in His grace, and guide us when perplexed,
and free us from all ills in this world and the next.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: All praise and thanks to God the Father now be given,
the Son, and Him who reigns with them in highest heaven,
the one eternal God whom earth and heav'n adore;
for thus it was, is now, and shall be evermore.

hymns.title: O for a thousand tongues to sing
hymns.source_file: 053 O for a thousand tongues to sing lyrics.txt

metadata.composer: Carl G Gläser (1784-1829) arr. Lowell Mason (1792-1872)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O for a thousand tongues to sing my great Redeemer's praise,
the glories of my God and King, the triumphs of His grace!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: My gracious Master and my God, assist me to proclaim,
to spread through all the earth abroad the honours of Thy name.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Lord Jesus, name that charms our fears, that bids our sorrows cease;
'tis music in the sinner's ears, 'tis life and health and peace.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: He breaks the bondage of our sin, He sets the pris'ner free;
His blood has power to redeem, His blood availed for me.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: He speaks, and list'ning to His voice, new life the dead receive;
the mournful, broken hearts rejoice, the humble poor believe.

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: In Christ, your Head, you then shall know your sins have been forgiv'n;
anticipate your heav'n below and know that love is heav'n.

hymns.title: O that I had a thousand voices
hymns.source_file: 054 O that I had a thousand voices lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O that I had a thousand voices, a mouth to speak with thousand tongues.
Then while my heart in Him rejoices, would I proclaim with greatful songs to all,
wherever I might be, what things the Lord has done for me.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Dear Father, endless praise I render with all I have, both heart and mind.
I praise Thee, Guardian, kind and tender for all the love and grace I find,
so freely giv'n whate'er betide, so wisely for my life supplied.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: What equal praises can I offer, dear Jesus, for Thy mercy shown;
what pangs, dear Saviour, didst Thou suffer and thus for all my sins atone.
Thy death alone my soul could free, forever Thine alone to be.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O Holy Ghost, a gift from heaven, revealed to me in light and pow'r,
teach me to see that Christ has given His peace in this and ev'ry hour.
Whate'er of good in me may shine comes only from Thy love divine.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Accept, O Lord, I now implore Thee the humble praise I give Thee now;
in heav'n I better will adore Thee when I in joy before Thee bow.
There would I join the sacred praise and heav'nly hallelujas raise!

hymns.title: O worship the King
hymns.source_file: 055 O worship the King lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O worship the King allglorious above, O gratefully sing His pow'r and His love:
Our Shield and Defender, the Ancient of Days, pavilioned in splendour, and girded with praise.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O tell of His might, O sing of His grace, whose robe is the light, whose canopy space;
His chariots of wrath the deep thunderclouds form, and dark is His path on the wings of the storm.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Thy bountiful care what tongue can recite? It breathes in the air, it shines in the light,
it streams from the hills, it descends to the plain, and sweetly distils in the dew and the rain.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Frail children of dust, and feeble as frail, in Thee do we trust, nor find Thee to fail:
Thy mercies how tender, how firm to the end, our Maker, Defender, Redeemer and Friend.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: O measureless might, ineffable love, while angels delight to hymn Thee above,
Thy humbler creation, though feeble their lays, with true adoration shall sing to Thy praise.

hymns.title: Praise our God with joyful singing
hymns.source_file: 056 Praise our God with joyful singing lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Praise our God with joyful singing, raise to Him a thankful song
so its echo may be ringing, joined in praise with heaven's throng.
God bestows on us His blessing; in His goodness we may trust.
We His name shall be confessing, He, our God, the Wise, the Just,
He, our God, the Wise, the Just.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: In His temple we are dwelling where His word we may receive.
Of His mercy we are telling, and His love which we perceive.
He gives blessing to our labour and He strengthens us anew,
that we all may seek His favour and with joy His will may do,
and with joy His will may do.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Soon shall come the joy unending which through grace He does prepare.
Soon His Son He will be sending and His glory we will share.
For this promise great and glorious we shall daily bring our praise.
With His help we'll be victorious; we shall serve Him all our days,
we shall serve Him all our days.

hymns.title: Praise the Lord who reigns above
hymns.source_file: 057 Praise the Lord who reigns above lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Praise the Lord who reigns above and keeps His court below;
praise the holy God of love, and all His greatness show.
Praise Him for His noble deeds, praise Him for His matchless pow'r;
Him from whom all good proceeds let earth and heav'n adore.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Celebrate th'eternal God with harp and psaltery,
timbrels soft and cymbals loud in highest praise agree.
Praise Him, ev'ry tuneful string; all the reach of heav'nly art,
all the pow'rs of music bring, the music of the heart.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: God, by whom they move and live, let ev'ry creature sing,
glory to their Maker give and homage to their King.
Hallowed be His name beneath, as in heav'n on earth adored;
praise the Lord in ev-'ry breath, let all things praise the Lord.

hymns.title: Praise thou the Lord
hymns.source_file: 058 Praise thou the Lord lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Praise thou the Lord, the omnipotent Monarch of Glory!
Join in, my soul, with the heavenly choir in their story!
Come and partake; rise from thy slumber, awake!
Sing the Creator's great glory!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Praise thou the Lord who e'er ruleth and guideth all surely;
over life's pathway so dang'rous, He leads thee securely.
Ever bestows, mercy and help in our woes;
I from my heart thank Him truly.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Praise thou the Lord who hath graciously, wondrously made thee.
Health has vouchsafed and, when heedless you fell, He hath stayed thee.
Fainting and weak, when not a word thou could speak,
wings of His mercy did shade thee.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Praise thou the Lord who thy life hath so visibly guided.
Streams of free grace through His Son for thy sin hath provided.
Think of it, too, God the almighty and true,
with His dear child has abided.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Praise thou the Lord and forget all His benefits never;
swell the loud chorus, ye chosen, till like a broad river,
upward it streams; soul, O forget not this theme:
Praise Him, O praise Him for ever!

hymns.title: Praise thou the Lord, O my soul
hymns.source_file: 059 Praise thou the Lord, O my soul lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Praise thou the Lord, O my soul, now praise Him! His praise continue until death!
While I the pathways of earth am treading, God shall be praised with ev'ry breath.
My soul and body did He give and waits my praise from morn till eve.
Praise thou the Lord, praise thou the Lord!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Happy, yes happy, are they forever whose help the God of Jacob is,
who hath created the earth and heaven, the sea and all that therein is.
Our God is Ruler of the world, truth's banner He hath e'er unfurled.
Praise thou the Lord, praise thou the Lord!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Praise, O ye people, the name most glorious of Him who reigns, Almighty King!
All should unite in one holy chorus, to God a hymn of joy to bring.
O Zion, with the heav'nly host praise Father, Son and Holy Ghost.
Praise thou the Lord, praise thou the Lord!

hymns.title: Praise, my soul, the King of heaven
hymns.source_file: 060 Praise, my soul, the King of heaven lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Praise, my soul, the King of heaven; to His feet your tribute bring.
Ransomed, healed, restored, forgiven, who like you His praise shall sing?
Alleluia! Alleluia! Praise the everlasting King!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Praise Him for His grace and favour to our fathers in distress;
praise Him, still the same as ever, slow to chide, and swift to bless.
Alleluia! Alleluia! Glorious in His faithfulness.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Fatherlike, He tends and spares us; well our feeble frame He knows.
In His hands He gently bears us, rescues us from all our foes.
Alleluia! Alleluia! Widely yet His mercy flows.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Angels in the heights, adore Him; you behold Him face to face.
Saints triumphant, bow before Him; gathered in from ev'ry race.
Alleluia! Alleluia! Praise with us the God of grace!

hymns.title: Should I not to God be singing?
hymns.source_file: 061 Should I not to God be singing lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Should I not to God be singing,
ever to Him thankful be?
All that He to me is bringing
clearly shows His love for me.
It is naught but lovingkindness
that His gracious heart does move.
Endless, patiently He proves:
Those who follow Him, He blesses.
Earthly things shall pass away,
God's love will forever stay!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: God's own Son, a precious off'ring,
yes, for me too He was sent.
From eternal pain and suff'ring
saved my soul, His blood was spent!
O Thou fount of depth and beauty,
how can I with human mind
fathom why Thou art so kind
though I search with zealous duty?
Earthly things shall pass a-way,
God's love will for-ev-er stay!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Holy Spirit, noble Leader,
granted me, as is His word,
be my constant Guide and Ruler
here and when  to heav'n transferred.
O may Thou my heart be filling
with Thy radiant truth and light;
vanquish death and all its might,
hell and all it's power stilling.
Earthly things shall pass away,
God's love will forever stay!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Lord, Thy endless love I'm praising,
boundless, too, Thy mercy mild.
Thus I plead, to Thee hands raising:
Gracious Father, hear Thy child!
Please extend to me Thy favour,
grant new strength and grace, I pray!
Be Thou near me night and day,
let me dwell with Thee forever.
Praise and honour all are Thine,
now and ever, Lord divine!

hymns.title: Thank ye the Lord
hymns.source_file: 062 Thank ye the Lord lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Thank ye the Lord! We now thank the Lord;
for He is friendly and all His goodness lasts for evermore,
it lasts for evermore, it lasts for evermore.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Praise ye the Lord! Yes, praise ye the Lord!
My soul be thankful, forget not all that He for you hath done,
that He for you hath done, that He for you hath done.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Mighty is He! Almighty is God!
His works are wisdom and ev'ry morning renders grace anew,
He renders grace anew, He renders grace anew.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Great is the Lord! Yes, great is the Lord!
His name is holy and all the world is with His presence filled,
is with His presence filled, is with His presence filled.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Sing to the Lord! Sing praise to the Lord!
In happy chorus, for gladly He doth hear our songs of praise,
doth hear our songs of praise, doth hear our songs of praise.

hymns.title: Thanks be to God
hymns.source_file: 063 Thanks be to God lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: This is the season to count all our blessings, mercies from heaven recall.
Daily outpoured by Jesus, our Lord, but how could we number them all?

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Thanks be to God, thanks be to God, for His blessings full and free.
Sing His praise, the anthems raise! Oh, thanks, thanks be to God.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Wondrous provision, no need was forgotten, graciously all was supplied.
Strength for the way and grace ev'ry day, His presence to cheer and to guide.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Thanks be to God, thanks be to God, for His blessings full and free.
Sing His praise, the anthems raise! Oh, thanks, thanks be to God.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Should not our hearts bow in new dedication unto our Saviour above,
yielding its throne to Jesus alone for all of the gifts of His love?

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Thanks be to God, thanks be to God, for His blessings full and free.
Sing His praise, the anthems raise! Oh, thanks, thanks be to God.

hymns.title: The day Thou gavest
hymns.source_file: 064 The day Thou gavest lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The day Thou gavest, Lord is ended, the darkness falls at Thy behest;
to Thee our morning hymns ascended, Thy praise shall sanctify our rest.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We thank Thee that Thy Church unsleeping, while earth rolls onward into light,
through all the world Her watch is keeping, and rests not now by day or night.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: As o'er each continent and island the dawn leads on another day,
the voice of prayer is never silent, nor dies the strain of praise away.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: The sun that bids us rest is waking our brethren 'neath the western sky,
and hour by hour fresh lips are making Thy wondrous doings heard on high.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: So be it, Lord; Thy throne shall never, like earth's proud empires, pass away;
Thy kingdom stands and grows forever, till all Thy people own Thy sway.

hymns.title: Thus far the Lord God has me brought
hymns.source_file: 065 Thus far the Lord God has me brought lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Thus far the Lord God has me brought through His great godly kindness.
Thus far He night and day has sought to keep my soul from blindness.
Thus far He did me safely guide, thus far has me no joy denied;
thus far has been my Helper.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: To You, my God, be thanks and praise, I am so deeply grateful
that all through life's dark stormy days You were to me so faithful.
Within my heart I do record the great things done by You, O Lord;
thus far You've been my Helper.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Help further, too, my faithful Lord; help me whenever needed
to overcome all that's abhorred and where I should have heeded.
When once the highest goal attained eternally I'll praise Your name:
for mercy, my great Helper!

hymns.title: To God be the glory
hymns.source_file: 066 To God be the glory lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: To God be the glory, great things He has done! So loved He the world that He gave us His Son,
who yielded His life, an atonement for sin, and opened life's portal that all may go in.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Praise the Lord, praise the Lord, let the earth hear His voice!
Praise the Lord, praise the Lord, let the people rejoice!
O come to the Father through Jesus the Son, and give Him the glory, great things He has done!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O perfect redemption, the purchase of blood, to ev'ry believer the promise of God;
the vilest offender who truly believes, and comes with repentance, a pardon receives.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Praise the Lord, praise the Lord, let the earth hear His voice!
Praise the Lord, praise the Lord, let the people rejoice!
O come to the Father through Jesus the Son, and give Him the glory, great things He has done!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Great things He has taught us, great things He has done, and great our rejoicing through Jesus the Son;
but purer, and higher, and greater will be our wonder, our rapture when Jesus we see.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Praise the Lord, praise the Lord, let the earth hear His voice!
Praise the Lord, praise the Lord, let the people rejoice!
O come to the Father through Jesus the Son, and give Him the glory, great things He has done!

hymns.title: To God be the glory
hymns.source_file: 067 To God be the glory lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: To God be the glory, great things He has done! So loved He the world that He gave us His Son,
who yielded His life, an atonement for sin, and opened life's portal that all may go in.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Praise the Lord, praise the Lord, let the earth hear His voice!
Praise the Lord, praise the Lord, let the people rejoice!
O come to the Father through Jesus the Son, and give Him the glory, great things He has done!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O perfect redemption, the purchase of blood, to ev'ry believer the promise of God;
the vilest offender who truly believes, and comes with repentance, a pardon receives.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Praise the Lord, praise the Lord, let the earth hear His voice!
Praise the Lord, praise the Lord, let the people rejoice!
O come to the Father through Jesus the Son, and give Him the glory, great things He has done!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Great things He has taught us, great things He has done, and great our rejoicing through Jesus the Son;
but purer, and higher, and greater will be our wonder, our rapture when Jesus we see.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Praise the Lord, praise the Lord, let the earth hear His voice!
Praise the Lord, praise the Lord, let the people rejoice!
O come to the Father through Jesus the Son, and give Him the glory, great things He has done!

hymns.title: We bring thanks to Jesus
hymns.source_file: 068 We bring thanks to Jesus lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We bring thanks to Jesus with our happy songs,
for His love so precious, praise to Him belongs,
for His love so precious, praise to Him belongs!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Jesus Christ is with us, He lives in our hearts.
Songs of thanks and praises we raise heavenwards,
songs of thanks and praises we raise heavenwards.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: With the blest in heaven, bound in sweet accord,
praises will be given Jesus Christ, our Lord,
praises will be given Jesus Christ, our Lord!

hymns.title: We plough the fields, and scatter
hymns.source_file: 069 We plough the fields, and scatter lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: Matthias Claudius (1740-1815) transl. Jane M Campbell (1817-1878)
metadata.composer: Johann A P Schultz (1747-1800) harm. John B Dykes (1823-1876)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We plough the fields, and scatter the good seed on the land,
but it is fed and watered by God's almighty hand.
He sends the snow in winter, the warmth to swell the grain,
the breezes and the sunshine, the soft refreshing rain.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: All good gifts around us are sent from heav'n above;
then thank the Lord, O thank the Lord for all His love.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He, only, is the Maker of all things near and far;
He paints the wayside flower, He lights the evening star.
The winds and waves obey Him, by Him the birds are fed;
much more to us, His children, He gives our daily bread.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: All good gifts around us are sent from heav'n above;
then thank the Lord, O thank the Lord for all His love.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: We thank Thee, then, O Father, for all things bright and good,
the seedtime and the harvest, our life, our health, our food.
No gifts have we to offer for all Thy love imparts,
but that which Thou desirest: Our humble, thankful hearts.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: All good gifts around us are sent from heav'n above;
then thank the Lord, O thank the Lord for all His love.

hymns.title: We praise Thee, Lord
hymns.source_file: 070 We praise Thee, Lord lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We praise Thee, Lord, who hast to earth descended;
hast sought and found my soul, from death defended.
For me shall life divine in Jesus be,
eternally in Jesus be.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We praise Thee, Lord, whom God has consecrated.
Thou hast Thy life to lost ones dedicated.
For me shall love divine in Jesus be,
eternally in Jesus be.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: We praise Thee, Lord, Thy precious life was given,
as ransom paid for sins to be forgiven.
For me redemption shall in Jesus be,
eternally in Jesus be.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: We praise Thee, Lord, to whom all pow'r is given.
O take my hand upon this way to heaven.
All praise and honour shall to Jesus be,
eternally to Jesus be.

hymns.title: Ah, but one wish
hymns.source_file: 071 Ah, but one wish lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Ah, but one wish and but one longing have I for you, O loving heart:
That you in gladness or in sorrow may from your Saviour never part.
That in His wounds you may find refuge, His love your constant escort too.
That He may guard you ev'ry moment, this is my wish and prayer for you.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Is He your light in ev'ry darkness, your compass on the sea of life?
The consolation of your conscience; your victory in fiercest strife?
Are you in His strong arms now resting and is His yoke an easy task?
Do you enjoy His love and merit? O tell me, what more can you ask?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I have found grace, yes, and salvation in God the Father and the Son.
The wounds of Jesus, they have healed me; God's act of grace the vict'ry won.
I shall by Jesus' hand be guided who by apostles would me lead.
O Throne of Grace, my heart shall praise You and offer thanks in word and deed.

hymns.title: Am I ready?
hymns.source_file: 072 Am I ready lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Am I ready? Am I worthy? Who do I resemble?
When in me these thoughts arise, my soul begins to tremble.
With God's Spirit I was sealed: Has Jesus nature been revealed
in my thoughts and walk of life, even during times of strife?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Am I ready? Am I worthy? Through His love and merit
in this promise, great, I share: His kingdom I'll inherit.
Help me, Lord, each day to strive to keep my faith and hope alive,
and each day anew embrace all the wonders of Your grace.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Am I ready? Am I worthy? Lord, You know the measure
of the zeal in me aflame, in seeking heav'nly treasure.
May the first love never fade, the love that in my heart was laid.
Let my longing now increase till I know eternal peace.

hymns.title: Ask ye what great thing I know
hymns.source_file: 073 Ask ye what great things I know lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: Johann C Schwedler (1672-1730) transl. Benjamin H Kennery (1804-1889)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Ask ye what great thing I know that delights and stirs me so?
What the high reward I win? Whose the name I glory in?
Jesus Christ, the crucified.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Who defeats my fiercest foes? Who consoles my saddest woes?
Who revives my fainting heart, healing all its hidden smart?
Jesus Christ, the crucified.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Who is life in life to me? Who the death of death will be?
Who will place me on His right, with the countless hosts of light?
Jesus Christ, the crucified.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: This is that great thing I know; this delights and stirs me so:
Faith in Him who died to save, Him who triumphed o'er the grave,
Jesus Christ, the crucified.

hymns.title: At the feet of Jesus
hymns.source_file: 074 At the feet of Jesus lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: At the feet of Jesus, list'ning to His word,
I receive new virtue from my loving Lord.
If His strength I thus procure, white shall be my raiment pure.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: At the feet of Jesus is the place for me.
There, His word receiving, would I choose to be.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Through the word of Jesus, cleansed becomes my heart
and the bonds of Satan powerless then part.
God has granted me His grace; made my heart a happy place.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: At the feet of Jesus is the place for me.
There, His word receiving, would I choose to be.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: May no moment ever pass me by in vain,
when my God would bless me, pouring out again
blessings all my ills to cure so through Him I may be pure.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: At the feet of Jesus is the place for me.
There, His word receiving, would I choose to be.

hymns.title: Blessed assurance, Jesus is mine
hymns.source_file: 075 Blessed assurance, Jesus is mine lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Blessed assurance, Jesus is mine! O what a foretaste of glory divine!
Heir of salvation, purchase of God, born of His Spirit, washed in His blood.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: This is my story, this is my song, praising my Saviour all the day long;
this is my story, this is my song, praising my Saviour all the day long.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Perfect submission, perfect delight, visions of rapture now burst on my sight;
angels descending bring from above echoes of mercy, whispers of love.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: This is my story, this is my song, praising my Saviour all the day long;
this is my story, this is my song, praising my Saviour all the day long.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Perfect submission, all is at rest, I in my Saviour am happy and blest,
watching and waiting, looking above, filled with His goodness, lost in His love.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: This is my story, this is my song, praising my Saviour all the day long;
this is my story, this is my song, praising my Saviour all the day long.

hymns.title: Bridegroom,You are mine
hymns.source_file: 076 Bridegroom, You are mine lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Bridegroom, You are mine; Jesus, Lamb divine!
Saved from sin, to You I render thanks for love so pure and tender.
Bridegroom, You are mine, Jesus, Lamb divine!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Your pervading love strengthens from above.
When Your friendly eyes behold me and in love You draw me closely,
Your pervading love strengthens from above.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: May my faith's bright light never turn to night.
With Your Spirit's oil supply me, in Your promise thus abiding.
May my faith's bright light never turn to night.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Faithful unto You I shall be, and true.
Lord, Your love I shall be praising and Your honour I'll be raising.
Faithful unto You I shall be, and true.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: After scorn and frown comes the glorious crown!
Here in hoping and believing, there in seeing and receiving.
After scorn and frown comes the glorious crown!

hymns.title: Christ living in me
hymns.source_file: 077 Christ living in me lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: As lives the flow'r within the seed, as in the cone the tree,
so, praise the God of truth and grace, His Spirit lives in me.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Christ living in me, Christ living in me!
O what salvation I know with Christ living in me!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Once far from God and dead in sin, no light my heart could see;
but in God's word the light I found and Christ now lives in me.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Christ living in me, Christ living in me!
O what salvation I know with Christ living in me!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: As rays of light from yonder sun the flow'rs of earth set free,
so life and light and love came forth from Christ who lives in me.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Christ living in me, Christ living in me!
O what salvation I know with Christ living in me!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: With longing all my heart is filled, that I like Him may be,
as on the wondrous thought I dwell, that Christ now lives in me.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Christ living in me, Christ living in me!
O what salvation I know with Christ living in me!

hymns.title: Come, follow Me
hymns.source_file: 078 Come, follow Me lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, follow Me! Calls Christ, our Lord; dear Christians come and follow!
Deny yourselves, forsaking all which can but lead to sorrow.
Take up your cross and walk My way; I'll guide and bless you day by day,
take up your cross and walk My way; I'll guide and bless you day by day.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I am the Way which guides you home; My precious life was given.
If your draw near and follow Me I'll guide you home to heaven.
I am the Way, I know full well how you should walk in peace to dwell,
I am the Way, I know full well how you should walk in peace to dwell.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I am the Truth– it's standing firm to that which God has given.
Though hard it be, it will remain although from some it's hidden.
I am the Saviour of your soul and you I'll lead to heav'nly goal!
I am the Saviour of your soul and you I'll lead to heav'nly goal!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: With Me you'll find eternal life, this earthly life transcending.
Through Me you will the Father see in joy and love unending!
So follow Me that you may wear the crown of life eternal there!
So follow Me that you may wear the crown of life eternal there!

hymns.title: Dare to be a Daniel
hymns.source_file: 079 Dare to a Daniel lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Standing by a purpose true, heeding God's command,
honour them, the faithful few! All hail to Daniel's band!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Dare to be a Daniel! Dare to stand alone!
Dare to have a purpose firm! Dare to make it known!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Many mighty men are lost, daring not to stand,
who for God had been a host by joining Daniel's band!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Dare to be a Daniel! Dare to stand alone!
Dare to have a purpose firm! Dare to make it known!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Many giants, great and tall, stalking through the land,
headlong to the earth would fall, if met by Daniel's band!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Dare to be a Daniel! Dare to stand alone!
Dare to have a purpose firm! Dare to make it known!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Hold the gospel banner high! On to vict'ry grand!
Satan and his host defy, and shout for Daniel's band!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Dare to be a Daniel! Dare to stand alone!
Dare to have a purpose firm! Dare to make it known!

hymns.title: Glorious things of Thee are spoken
hymns.source_file: 080 Glorious things of Thee are spoken lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Glorious things of Thee are spoken, Zion, city of our God;
He whose word cannot be broken formed thee for His own abode.
On the Rock of Ages founded, what can shake thy sure repose?
With salvation's walls surrounded, thou may'st smile at all thy foes.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: See, the streams of living waters, springing from eternal Love,
well supply Thy sons and daughters, and all fear of want remove.
Who can faint while such a river ever flows their thirst assuage?
Grace which like the Lord, the Giver, never fails from age to age!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Round each habitation hov'ring, see the cloud and fire appear
for a glory and a cov'ring, showing that the Lord is near!
On their way the pillar leading, light by night and shade by day,
daily on the manna feeding which He gives them when they pray.

hymns.title: Heav'nward still our pathway tends
hymns.source_file: 081 Heav'nward still our pathway tends lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Heav'nward still our path ascends, here on earth we are but strangers,
till our road in Canaan ends, safely passed through world of dangers.
Here we but as pilgrims dwell till we bid this earth farewell.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Heav'nward still, my soul ascend! You are one of heav'n's creations;

for a heav'n-enlighted mind ever turns its source to find.

lines: "Heav'nward still!" God calls to me, through His servants clearly speaking.

hymns.title: I am Jesus' little friend
hymns.source_file: 082 I am Jesus' little friend lyrics.txt

lines: I am Jesus' little friend; on His mercy I depend.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Very young in years am I, yet He guides me with His eye.
On a pleasant path He leads me, with a gentle hand He feeds me;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: He is with me all the day, with me in my busy play.
O'er my waking and my sleeping Jesus still a watch is keeping;
I can lay me down to rest, sweetly pillowed on His breast.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I am Jesus' little friend; on His mercy I depend.
Jesus will forsake me never, He will keep me safe forever.

hymns.title: I am the Way

hymns.title: I am Thine, O Lord

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Draw me nearer, nearer, blessed Lord,
to Thy precious bleeding side.

sections.label: Refrain

hymns.title: I do not ask for earthly store
hymns.source_file: 085 I do not ask for earthly store lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I do not ask for earthly store beyond a day's supply.

Then shall my heart keep singing while to the cross I cling;
for rest is sweet at Jesus' feet while homeward faith keeps winging,
while homeward faith keeps winging.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I care not for the empty show that thoughtless worldlings see.

Then shall my heart keep singing while to the cross I cling;
for rest is sweet at Jesus' feet while homeward faith keeps winging,
while homeward faith keeps winging.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Whate'er the crosses mine shall be, I will not dare to shun.
I only ask to live for Thee and that Thy will be done.
Then shall my heart keep singing while to the cross I cling;
for rest is sweet at Jesus' feet while homeward faith keeps winging,
while homeward faith keeps winging.Thy will, O Lord, be mine each day,
while pressing on my homeward way.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: And when at last my labour o'er, I cross the narrow sea.

and learn what here I cannot know: Why Thou hast ever loved me so.
Then shall my heart keep singing while to the cross I cling;
for rest is sweet at Jesus' feet while homeward faith keeps winging,
while homeward faith keeps winging.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I love to tell the story, 'twill be my theme in glory,
to tell the old, old story of Jesus and His love.

lines: I love to tell the story, for those who know it best

'twill be the old, old story that I have loved so long.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I love to tell the story, 'twill be my theme in glory,
to tell the old, old story of Jesus and His love.

hymns.title: I surrender all
hymns.source_file: 087 I surrender all lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1

hymns.title: I want to be like Jesus
hymns.source_file: 089 I want to be like Jesus lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I have one deep, supreme desire: that I may be like Jesus.
To this I fervently aspire, that I may be like Jesus.
I want my heart His throne to be, so that a watching world may see
His likeness shining forth in me. I want to be like Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He spent His life in doing good; I want to be like Jesus.
Always in humble service stood; I want to be like Jesus.
He sympathized with hearts distressed; He spoke the words that cheered and blessed;
He welcomed sinners to His breast. I want to be like Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: A holy, blameless life He led; I want to be like Jesus.
The Father's will, His drink and bread; I want to be like Jesus.
And when at last He came to die, "Father, forgive them," He could cry
for those who taunt and crucify. I want to be like Jesus.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O perfect life of Christ, my Lord! I want to be like Jesus.

my deepest pray'r, my highest goal: that I may be like Jesus.

lines: I will sing of my Redeemer and His wondrous love for me.

hymns.title: In Christ alone
hymns.source_file: 092 In Christ alone lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: In Christ alone my hope is found, He is my light, my strength, my song;

My Comforter, my All in All, here in the love of Christ I stand.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: In Christ alone!– Who took on flesh; fullness of God in helpless Babe!
This gift of love and righteousness, scorned by the ones He came to save:
'Til on that cross as Jesus died, the will of God was satisfied,
for ev'ry sin on Him was laid; here in the death of Christ I live.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: There in the tomb His body lay, Light of the world for sinners slain;
then bursting forth in glorious day, up from the grave He rose again!
And as He stands in victory, sin's curse has lost it's grip on me,
for I am His and He is mine– bought with the precious blood of Christ.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: No guilt in life, no fear in death– this is the pow'r of Christ in me.
From life's first cry to final breath, Jesus commands my destiny.
No pow'r of hell, no scheme of man, can ever pluck me from His hand.
'Til He returns or calls me home, here in the pow'r of Christ I'll stand.

hymns.title: Jesus calls us

O light divine, upon us shine– it is our faith's endeavour
that peace attend as we ascend to be with Christ forever!

hymns.title: Praise, I will praise You, Lord
hymns.source_file: 104 Praise, I will praise You, Lord lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Praise, I will praise You, Lord, with all my heart.
O God, I will tell the wonders of Your ways and glorify Your name.
Praise, I will praise You, Lord, with all my heart.
In You I will find the source of all my joy. Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Love, I will love You, Lord, with all my heart.
O God, I will tell the wonders of Your ways and glorify Your name.
Love, I will love You, Lord, with all my heart.
In You I will find the source of all my joy. Alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Serve, I will love You, Lord, with all my heart.
O God, I will tell the wonders of Your ways and glorify Your name.
Serve, I will love You, Lord, with all my heart.
In You I will find the source of all my joy. Alleluia!

hymns.title: Soul, arise! I must be telling
hymns.source_file: 105 Soul, arise! I must be telling lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Soul, arise! I must be telling that the Lord grace granted me.
I was vile, of sin a dwelling, but the Saviour made me free.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Soul arise! I must be telling that the Lord,grace granted me
and no more my sin remembers; may I His forever be, forever be!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Should my steps e'er be unsteady climbing faith's steep, rocky land,
then I know that He would guide me safely with His mighty hand.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Soul arise! I must be telling that the Lord,grace granted me
and no more my sin remembers; may I His forever be, forever be!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: His abundant gifts and powers are implanted in my soul.
Thus one way before me towers: Forward, upward to the goal!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Soul arise! I must be telling that the Lord,grace granted me
and no more my sin remembers; may I His forever be, forever be!

hymns.title: Take my life and let it be
hymns.source_file: 106 Take my life and let it be lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Take my life and let it be consecrated, Lord, to Thee.
Take my moments and my days, let them flow in ceaseless praise.
Take my eyes and let me see all the good that comes from Thee.
Take my ears and let them hear loving words ring loud and clear.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Take my hands and let them move at the impulse of Thy love.
Take my feet and let them be swift and beautiful for Thee.
Take my voice and let me sing always, only, for my King.
Take my love, my Lord, I pour at Thy feet its treasure store.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Take my wealth and all my gold, not a mite would I withhold.
Take my intellect and use all its pow'r as Thou may choose.
Take my will and make it Thine, it shall be no longer mine.
Take my heart, it is Thine own, it shall be Thy royal throne.
