hymns.title: The Father's house is our delight
hymns.source_file: 108 The Father's house is our delight lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The Father's house is our delight, we there find joy anew.
We  love to hear, both day and night, Christ's teaching pure and true.
There grace and peace from God's throne flows, there Jesus' love with brightness glows.
We learn to pray, we learn to love and trust our Lord above.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Sing and let each voice resound to echo all the world around!
Sing hosanna, sing hosanna, sing hosanna to the Lamb of God.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We thank you, loving shepherds true, for all your tender care;
already in our days of youth our souls for heav'n prepare.
And should we ever seem to stray, from Father's house to move away,
with loving care and deep concern, then help us to return.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Sing and let each voice resound to echo all the world around!
Sing hosanna, sing hosanna, sing hosanna to the Lamb of God.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: How beautiful when we are found to love the word we hear,
like little lambs who gather 'round their loving shepherd dear.
We love to hear their call anew, our Lord through them we do pursue.
How blest to here be firm and true! Lord, take us home to You.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Sing and let each voice resound to echo all the world around!
Sing hosanna, sing hosanna, sing hosanna to the Lamb of God.

hymns.title: The Lord is King
hymns.source_file: 109 The Lord is King lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: How faithfully God's servants go! O hear the Spirit's urging!
We gladly follow for we know God's might and pow'r is surging!
The Lord is King and in His might destroys the bond of sinful night,
lights up the world, the world in splendour!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: The Lord is King and in His might destroys the bond of sinful night;
lights up the world, the world in splendour!
The Lord is King and in His might destroys the bond of sinful night;
lights up the world, the world in splendour!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Accept the message, young and old, that here His servants tender:
Today His grace would you enfold and love to you He'll render!
For us He gave His precious blood, redeemed us in His gracious flood
that we may share, may share His glory!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: The Lord is King and in His might destroys the bond of sinful night;
lights up the world, the world in splendour!
The Lord is King and in His might destroys the bond of sinful night;
lights up the world, the world in splendour!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: How faithfully God's servants go, proclaiming soul salvation.
With blessings filled, we now may know the message of redemption.
Accept with joy and do believe, eternal glory to achieve;
through Him all things, all things are given!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: The Lord is King and in His might destroys the bond of sinful night;
lights up the world, the world in splendour!
The Lord is King and in His might destroys the bond of sinful night;
lights up the world, the world in splendour!

hymns.title: Thee will I love
hymns.source_file: 110 Thee will I love lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Thee will I love, my strength forever; Thee will I love, Thou art my grace!
Thee will I love in all endeavour, through all temptations which I face.
Thee will I love, my light Thou art, with all my yearning heart.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Ah, that so late I came to know Thee, exalted, wondrous beauty, Thou!
That I not sooner did confess Thee and found Thy true rest only now.
This is my deep regret and grief, so late I found relief!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I went astray in deep confusion; I searched, but nowhere could Thee sight.
I turned from Thee in my delusion and loved the garish worldly light.
But now through Thee it's been achieved: Thy love I have percieved!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I give Thee thanks, Thou true Sun given, that light to me Thy splendour brought.
I give Thee thanks, Thou bliss from heaven, who joy for me, and freedom, wrought.
I give Thee thanks, O Word so pure, that Thou my ills doth cure.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Thee will I love, my crown and splendour, Thee will I love, my Lord, my God.
My heart to Thee, Lord, I will render in times of joy or painful lot.
Thee will I love, my crown Thou art, thus beats my yearning heart.

hymns.title: There's a glorious banner
hymns.source_file: 111 There's a glorious banner lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There's a glorious banner borne by ev'ryone who would serve beside our King,
who would bear the standard till the battle's won and in victory then sing!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Marching, marching on, for we are led by Christ the King.
And in glad accord we serve our Lord; faith's banner always raise on high!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Though the foe's rage may to wildest fury swell, bravely hold the banner high!
Singing praise to our great King, Immanuel, for the truth will never die.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Marching, marching on, for we are led by Christ the King.
And in glad accord we serve our Lord; faith's banner always raise on high!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Over land and sea wherever mortals tread, let the banner be unfurled,
that the word of truth which evil forces dread be proclaimed throughout the world.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Marching, marching on, for we are led by Christ the King.
And in glad accord we serve our Lord; faith's banner always raise on high!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: See, the morning dawns, the night is almost spent; shout with joy, O world set free!
Soon the Prince of Peace, for man's redemption sent, will return in victory!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Marching, marching on, for we are led by Christ the King.
And in glad accord we serve our Lord; faith's banner always raise on high!

hymns.title: This be ever my confession
hymns.source_file: 112 This be ever my confession lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: This be ever my confession, my concern, the earnest question:
Does the Lord reign in my heart?
Am I in His grace abiding, is His Holy Spirit guiding, that from Him I may not part?
That from Him I may not part?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Do I truly live in Jesus, on the vine both strong and vig'rous,
drawing life and sap from Him?
Is my love for Him inspiring, cross and sorrow not denying, putting all my trust in Him?
Putting all my trust in Him?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Is He with me when I wander, when I stand or sit and ponder,
till His face I clearly see?
Of my heart has He possession to resist and fight aggression, gaining life and liberty?
Gaining life and liberty?

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Do I love Christ Jesus only? Or has worldly lust grown in me,
tempting me here to transgress?
Of His grace have I partaken, have I worldly things forsaken? Would I Him alone possess?
Would I Him alone possess?

hymns.title: Up, arise, O godly witness
hymns.source_file: 113 Up, arise, O godly witness lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Up, arise, O godly witness and your standard firmly plant,
to the world the splendours showing of our glorious covenant!
In the name of God, our Father, let us spread the gospel word
that the precious seed, now scattered, soon our toiling shall reward.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O beware, ungodly powers threaten here the holy place.
For they threaten rights and justice and the truth try to abase.
Shall then mankind be destroyed here under these dark powers' sway?
No! We'll fight until we conquer, with new courage join the fray.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Though we are but few in number and the foe as legions be,
yet we'll closely follow Jesus where He leads to liberty!
He was humble through all suff'ring and the victory did gain,
so shall we as overcomers then with Him our peace attain!

hymns.title: We cannot but be speaking
hymns.source_file: 114 We cannot but be speaking lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We cannot but be speaking, God's word we must declare.
For this the world may scorn us– with cheer that scorn we bear.
We cannot keep from telling what we believe and know.
Our mouths of that bear witness which sets our hearts aglow.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Love's brooklet must keep flowing and t'ward the ocean wind;
it ripples ever onward and never rest does find.
Though rocks may try to stem it, in foam it breaks below;
its course they cannot alter nor can it backward flow.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Yes, Lord, through Your great merit the world to You must yield.
Supported by Your Spirit we'll hold the battlefield.
We'll clear the way and conquer, what e'er the host may plot;
we cannot but accomplish for God forsakes us not.

hymns.title: We praise Thee, Lord, Thou Lion
hymns.source_file: 115 We praise Thee, Lord, Thou Lion lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We praise Thee, Lord, Thou Lion faithful witness; Thou who apostles sendest forth today.
Oh, that to Thee our hearts may bow in meekness, that, as of old, Thy blessings tend our way.
Thou givest us the fullness of Thy Spirit, through Thy commissioned has us richly blest
and through them dost prepare us by Thy merit that, clothed in white, we soon with Thee may rest.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thou greatest Master, here Thy kingdom finish in which Thou shalt forever reign as King.
Thou arm of God, be strong, make sin to vanish from Thine elect, and all to vict'ry bring.
That Satan may on earth soon lose his power, that Babel's sparkle vanish, be no more;
that Zion may in all its glory tower and homeward we exultantly may soar!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: When shall it be, O Bridegroom, Thy returning? When wilt Thou come to take Thy chosen bride?
When strikes the hour that she, Thy love not spurning, in bridal raiment may with Thee abide?
In Thy apostles, Lord, be as a giver who doth His Bride most beauteously adorn,
that she in glory be like Thee forever when once she meets Thee on that wedding morn!

hymns.title: Windows open toward Jerusalem
hymns.source_file: 116 Windows open toward Jerusalem lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Do you see the Hebrew captive kneeling at morning, noon and night to pray?
In his chamber he remembers Zion though in exile far away.
Are your windows open t'ward Jerusalem though as captives here a little while we stay?
For the coming of the King in His glory are you watching day by day?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Do not fear to tread the fiery furnace, nor shrink the lion's den to share.
For the God of Daniel will deliver; He will send His angel there.
Are your windows open t'ward Jerusalem though as captives here a little while we stay?
For the coming of the King in His glory are you watching day by day?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Children of the living God, take courage, of great deliv'rance sweetly sing.
Set your faces t'ward the hill of Zion, so to hail your coming King.
Are your windows open t'ward Jerusalem though as captives here a little while we stay?
For the coming of the King in His glory are you watching day by day?

hymns.title: Word of Life, Thou purest fountain
hymns.source_file: 117 Word of Life, Thou purest fountain lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Word of Life, Thou purest fountain, which from heaven gently flows,
living pow'rs to all those giving who their hearts to Thee disclose.
All who like a withered flower which the burning sun has bleached,
thirsty from a land of desert, bow down at the spring they've reached.
Thirsty from a land of desert, bow down at the spring they've reached.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Ah, what is the earth without Thee, but a curse-encumbered vale
and without Thee what is heaven? Paradise in guarded dale.
What is life on earth without Thee? A repeated death and gloom
and without Thee what is dying? Gruesome night within the tomb.
And without Thee what is dying? Gruesome night within the tomb.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Word of Life, Thou dost enlighten, warming is Thy light divine.
Unto us Thou showest mys'tries of the heaven that is Thine.
Teach us how we may preserve then Spirit's sword, the living word!
Help us here on earth to conquer, there to gain the crown, O Lord.
Help us here on earth to conquer, there to gain the crown, O Lord!

hymns.title: Your wisdom, Lord, awake in me
hymns.source_file: 118 Your wisdom, Lord, awake in me lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Your wisdom, Lord, awake in me; my heart make truly wise,
that I Your will may always see with pure and noble eyes.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: No earthly mind shall know Your ways, for such it is concealed.
A fervent heart which humbly prays will see Your thoughts revealed.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: May inspiration daily grow, divine my spirit be,
that Godly knowledge strong can flow and Christ may live in me.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: My treasure, then, shall be this gift which grows each holy hour,
when words of life my soul uplift to heights of bliss and pow'r.

hymns.title: Your word, O Lord, is gentle dew
hymns.source_file: 119 Your word, O Lord, is gentle dew lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Your word, O Lord, is gentle dew to suff'ring hearts that want it.
O shed Your heav'nly balm anew, to all may it be granted.
Refreshed by You with heav'nly dew all hearts may then in beauty praise and bear Your fruit in endless days.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Your word is like a flaming sword, a sharp and mighty arrow.
A wedge that cleaves the rock, that word can pierce through heart and marrow.
O send it forth o'er all the earth, the sinful heart to cleanse and win, and shatter all the might of sin.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I comfort sought but found it not in earthly joys and pleasure.
Your blessed word of grace, O God, gives me eternal treasure.
It shows my way, from day to day and keeps my feet from stumbling here while to the goal I'm drawing near.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Your word for us a shining star upon our journey guiding;
it points to Christ and blest we are within His love abiding.
Let heav'nly light e'er give us sight, in ev'ry heart with kindness shine that none may miss the goal divine.

hymns.title: Arise and let us hasten
hymns.source_file: 120 Arise and let us hasten lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Arise and let us hasten, the goal let us attain.
O let us now no longer in idleness remain!
Come, brothers, come! Come, sisters, come!
The hand of Jesus take, which He extends in mercy through the apostolate.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O praise God's works of mercy and His redeeming might,
for leading us from darkness into His marv'lous light!
Come, brothers, come! Come, sisters, come!
Our banner let us wave, remaining in the spirit of Jesus who does save!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O tell the souls in bondage who still by sin are bound:
"There yet is grace and mercy with Jesus to be found!"
Come, brothers, come! Come, sisters, come!
The Father has us sent to gather to His supper the weary and the spent!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: When here our work is ended, how glorious it will be!
United in the Spirit, we'll dwell in Zion, free!
Come, brothers, come! Come, sisters, come!
The time's not far away. O in obedience follow the word of God today!

hymns.title: Awake
hymns.source_file: 121 Awake lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: "Awake, awake," ye weary hearts here yearning! The watchmen call, make sure your lamps are burning.
Do not delay, the hour draws ever nearer; the Bridegroom comes, the cry is ever clearer!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: The King will come in glory bright, beyond compare in pow'r and might.
O Bride of Christ, your joy make known for He will claim you as His own!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: "Awake, awake," God's servants still are calling. As shepherds they still keep the sheep from falling.
The Lord will come, God has the time appointed to gather whom His Spirit has anointed.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: The King will come in glory bright, beyond compare in pow'r and might.
O Bride of Christ, your joy make known for He will claim you as His own!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: "Awake, awake," apostles are exclaiming. The word of God with joy they are proclaiming.
Though Satan tries his best the truth to stifle, God's servants know with him they cannot trifle.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: The King will come in glory bright, beyond compare in pow'r and might.
O Bride of Christ, your joy make known for He will claim you as His own!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: "Awake, awake," the cry becomes yet clearer. The Bridegroom comes, the midnight hour draws nearer!
O Bride of Christ, adorn yourself, preparing to meet the Lord, your love for Him declaring.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: The King will come in glory bright, beyond compare in pow'r and might.
O Bride of Christ, your joy make known for He will claim you as His own!

hymns.title: Brighten every corner
hymns.source_file: 122 Brighten every corner lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Do not wait until some deed of greatness you may do,
Do not wait to shed your light afar,
to the many duties ever near you now be true,
Brighten ev'ry corner where you are.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Brighten ev'ry corner where you are!(x2)
Someone far from harbour you may guide across the bar
if you brighten ev'ry corner where you are!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Just above are clouded skies that you may help to clear;
let not selfish thoughts your way debar;
though into one heart alone may fall your song of cheer,
Brighten ev'ry corner where you are.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Brighten ev'ry corner where you are!(x2)
Someone far from harbour you may guide across the bar
if you brighten ev'ry corner where you are!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Here, for all your talent, you may surely find a need;
here reflect the bright and Morning Star.
Learn from Him who lovingly provides for ev'ry need;
Brighten ev'ry corner where you are.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Brighten ev'ry corner where you are!(x2)
Someone far from harbour you may guide across the bar
if you brighten ev'ry corner where you are!

hymns.title: Brightly beams our Father's mercy
hymns.source_file: 123 Brightly beams our Father's mercy lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Brightly beams our Father's mercy from His lighthouse evermore,
but to us He gives the keeping of the lights along the shore.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Let your beacon light be burning! Send a gleam into the night,
that some ship still lost in darkness may the harbour safely sight!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Dark the night of sin has settled; loud the angry billows roar;
eager eyes are watching, longing for the lights along the shore.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Let your beacon light be burning! Send a gleam into the night,
that some ship still lost in darkness may the harbour safely sight!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Light your lamps, you who are chosen, or some ship that's tempest-tossed,
if no beacon light is burning, near the harbour may be lost.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Let your beacon light be burning! Send a gleam into the night,
that some ship still lost in darkness may the harbour safely sight!

hymns.title: Bringing in the sheaves
hymns.source_file: 124 Bringing in the sheaves lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Sowing in the morning, sowing seeds of kindness, sowing in the noontide and the dewy eve.
Waiting for the harvest and the time of reaping: We shall come rejoicing, bringing in the sheaves.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Bringing in the sheaves, bringing in the sheaves, we shall come rejoicing, bringing in the sheaves.
Bringing in the sheaves, bringing in the sheaves, we shall come rejoicing, bringing in the sheaves.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Sowing in the sunshine, sowing in the shadows, fearing neither clouds nor winter's chilly breeze.
By and by the harvest, and the labour ended: We shall come rejoicing, bringing in the sheaves.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Bringing in the sheaves, bringing in the sheaves, we shall come rejoicing, bringing in the sheaves.
Bringing in the sheaves, bringing in the sheaves, we shall come rejoicing, bringing in the sheaves.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Going forth with weeping, sowing for the Master though the loss sustained our spirit often grieves.
