sections.label: Refrain
lines: Bringing in the sheaves, bringing in the sheaves, we shall come rejoicing, bringing in the sheaves.
Bringing in the sheaves, bringing in the sheaves, we shall come rejoicing, bringing in the sheaves.

hymns.title: Forth in Thy name, O Lord
hymns.source_file: 125 Forth in Thy name, O Lord lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Forth in Thy name, O Lord, I go, my daily labour to pursue;
Thee, only Thee, resolved to know in all I think or speak or do.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The task Thy wisdom hath assigned, O let me cheerfully fulfil;
in all my works Thy presence find and prove Thy good and perfect will.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Thee may I set at my right hand, whose eyes mine inmost substance see,
and labour on at Thy command, and offer all my works to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: May I delightfully employ whate'er Thy bounteous grace hath giv'n;
and run my course with even joy, and closely walk with Thee to heav'n.

hymns.title: Give me courage, Lord
hymns.source_file: 126 Give me courage, Lord lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Give me courage, Lord, to say Your name,
not to quiver when I'm laughed at, nor to hide my face in shame;
when around me there are those who would my faith in You deride,
let me not Your name deny or cast aside.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: So let my praises and my thanks ascend to You
and Your love, O Lord, within my heart be true.
So let me joyfully Your wondrous works proclaim;
give me courage, Lord, to say Your name.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Give me courage, Lord, to say Your name,
let my lips declare Your power and Your holiness acclaim.
Many with their earthly influence Your majesty despise;
let me pray that You would open soon their eyes.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: So let my praises and my thanks ascend to You
and Your love, O Lord, within my heart be true.
So let me joyfully Your wondrous works proclaim;
give me courage, Lord, to say Your name.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Give me courage, Lord, to say Your name,
let me share with pure conviction what through Christ we stand to gain,
telling others how the faithful have a bright new destiny.
Let my walk of life the best example be.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: So let my praises and my thanks ascend to You
and Your love, O Lord, within my heart be true.
So let me joyfully Your wondrous works proclaim;
give me courage, Lord, to say Your name.

hymns.title: Give me joy in my heart
hymns.source_file: 127 Give me joy in my heart.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Give me joy in  my heart, keep me praising,
give me joy in my heart,I pray;
give me joy in my heart, keep me praising,
keep me praising till the break of day:

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Sing hosanna, sing hosanna, sing hosanna to the King of kings!
Sing hosanna, sing hosanna, sing hosanna to the King! (the King!)

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Give me peace in my heart, keep me loving,
give me peace in my heart, I pray;
give me peace in my heart, keep me loving,
keep me loving till the break of day:

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Sing hosanna, sing hosanna, sing hosanna to the King of kings!
Sing hosanna, sing hosanna, sing hosanna to the King! (the King!)

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Give me love in my heart, keep me serving,
give me love in my heart, I pray;
give me love in my heart, keep me serving,
keep me serving till the break of day:

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Sing hosanna, sing hosanna, sing hosanna to the King of kings!
Sing hosanna, sing hosanna, sing hosanna to the King! (the King!)

hymns.title: Give of your best to the Master
hymns.source_file: 128 Give of your best to the Master lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Give of your best to the Master, give of the strength of your youth.
Throw your soul's fresh, glowing ardour into the battle for truth.
Jesus has set the example, dauntless was He, young and brave.
Give Him your loyal devotion, give Him the best that you have.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Give of your best to the Master, give of the strength of your youth.
Clad in salvation's full armour; join in the battle for truth.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Give of your best to the Master, give Him first place in your heart.
Give Him first place in your service, give Him your all, not in part.
Give, for to you has been given: God His beloved Son gave.
Gratefully seeking to serve Him, give Him the best that you have.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Give of your best to the Master, give of the strength of your youth.
Clad in salvation's full armour; join in the battle for truth.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Give of your best to the Master, naught else is worthy His love.
He gave Himself for your ransom, gave up His glory above:
Laid down His life without murmur, you from sin's ruin to save.
Give Him your heart's adoration, give Him the best that you have.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Give of your best to the Master, give of the strength of your youth.
Clad in salvation's full armour; join in the battle for truth.

hymns.title: God of grace and God of glory
hymns.source_file: 129 God of grace and God of glory lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God of grace and God of glory, on Your people pour Your pow'r;
crown Your ancient Church's story, bring its bud to glorious flow'r.
Grant us wisdom, grant us courage for the facing of this hour, for the facing of this hour.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Lo! the hosts of evil round us scorn Your Son, assail His ways!
Lord, where fear and doubt have bound us– free our hearts to work and praise.
Grant us wisdom, grant us courage for the living of these days, for the living of these days.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Heal the human warring madness, bend our pride to Your control;
shame our wanton, selfish gladness, rich in things and poor in soul.
Grant us wisdom, grant us courage lest we miss our heav'nly goal, lest we miss our heav'nly goal.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Save us from weak resignation to the evils we deplore;
let the gift of Your salvation be our glory evermore.
Grant us wisdom, grant us courage, serving You whom we adore, serving You whom we adore.

hymns.title: God wants in His vineyard
hymns.source_file: 130 God wants in His vineyard lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God wants in His vineyard workers, faithful, true,
servants who will gladly toil with zeal anew.
Labour is rewarded, those who work are blest!
Called to serve God's people, what for souls is best.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We are few in number, large the harvest field.
Work is all-important to secure a yield.
Faith will gain the vict'ry, all believers know;
he who overcometh, thanks to God does show!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Many may oppose us, few will understand
that our goal is heaven and the golden strand.
Not by worldly measures do we want reward;
we seek crowns of glory ever with the Lord!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: We'll, despite the scorners, labour while we may.
As God's children sowing seeds of love each day.
Faith and hope united, joined with love and care,
open doors of blessing far beyond compare!

hymns.title: Have you heard the Master calling?
hymns.source_file: 131 Have you heard the Master calling lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Have you heard the Master calling: "Who will go and work today?
Fields are white and harvest waiting, who will bear the sheaves away?"
All who heed the Master's calling, a reward in heav'n shall see.
Who will answer, gladly saying: "Here am I, O Lord, send me!"

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Should you not compare in serving with God's servants of today,
you can still bring to the Master souls who may have gone astray.
If you have not great possessions, you can serve in humble ways,
for whate'er you do for Jesus will bring blessings all your days.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Let your words be filled with fervour born of the apostolate.
Tell how you received God's Spirit and your life did dedicate.
Should your neighbour then not hearken, failing truthfulness to face,
do your best the soul to rescue, leading him to truth and grace.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Now enlist in this endeavour, vow your very best to do
while the souls of men are dying and the Master calls for you!
Give yourself to Him completely, going forth with blessings shared.
Give your word with deep conviction: "Send me, Lord, I am prepared!"

hymns.title: Hear the watchmen in Zion
hymns.source_file: 132 Hear the watchmen in Zion lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Hear the watchmen in Zion! They day and night declare:
"Jesus extends salvation and blessed, heav'nly care!"
With plowing and sowing, with weeding and hoeing, a harvest preparing, the watchmen today,
a harvest preparing, watchmen today.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: God by grace us elected, not like chaff soon rejected.
Redeem the time, amend your ways, redeem the time, amend your ways.
The watchmen, the watchmen, the watchmen are calling today.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Hear the watchmen in Zion proclaim the word of God:
"Hearken, do not stand idle, nor find wrong paths you've trod."
With sickle they're reaping, they haste without sleeping, the ripe wheat to harvest, the watchmen today,
the ripe wheat to harvest, watchmen today.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: God by grace us elected, not like chaff soon rejected.
Redeem the time, amend your ways, redeem the time, amend your ways.
The watchmen, the watchmen, the watchmen are calling today.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Hear the watchmen in Zion: "This is the time of grace!
Wake and arise, all sinners, God's altar now embrace!"
With passion and feeling, their mission revealing, the wild growth removing, the watchmen today,
the wild growth removing, watchmen today.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: God by grace us elected, not like chaff soon rejected.
Redeem the time, amend your ways, redeem the time, amend your ways.
The watchmen, the watchmen, the watchmen are calling today.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Hear the watchmen in Zion who day and night declare:
"Ever be wise and watchful, for Christ's return prepare."
With food they're providing, God's children are guiding, the truth they're declaring, the watchmen today,
the truth they're declaring, watchmen today.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: God by grace us elected, not like chaff soon rejected.
Redeem the time, amend your ways, redeem the time, amend your ways.
The watchmen, the watchmen, the watchmen are calling today.

hymns.title: Here I am, Lord
hymns.source_file: 133 Here I am, Lord lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I, the Lord of sea and sky, I have heard My people cry.
All who dwell in dark and sin My hand will save.
I, who made the stars of night, I will make their darkness bright.
Who will bear My light to them? Whom shall I send?

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Here I am, Lord. Is it I, Lord?
I have heard You calling in the night.
I will go, Lord, if You lead me.
I will hold Your people in my heart.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I, the Lord of snow and rain, I have borne My people's pain.
I have wept for love of them. They turn away.
I will break their hearts of stone, give them hearts for love alone.
I will speak My word to them. Whom shall I send?

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Here I am, Lord. Is it I, Lord?
I have heard You calling in the night.
I will go, Lord, if You lead me.
I will hold Your people in my heart.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I, the Lord of wind and flame, I will tend the poor and lame.
I will set a feast for them. My hand will save.
Finest bread I will provide till their hearts be satisfied.
I will give My life to them. Whom shall I send?

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Here I am, Lord. Is it I, Lord?
I have heard You calling in the night.
I will go, Lord, if You lead me.
I will hold Your people in my heart.

hymns.title: I send you forth
hymns.source_file: 134 I send you forth lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I send you forth, I am your Lord and Master, your Saviour who appointed you to serve.
I send you forth, as He who rules all spirits, I give you charge My teaching to preserve.
I send you forth, take courage on your mission. My word: "I send you," be your sacred shield.
Go forth and bear the consecrated banner, against the host of Satan ne'er to yield.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I send you forth, My word in faith to utter, for I have given you the Holy Ghost;
and by it's pow'r the timid tongue is loosened to teach the poor who nothing have to boast.
I give the heart each day and each new hour the strength to overcome and fears subdue.
Give Spirit's light, a living word and power: "I send you forth,
My blessings go with you!"

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I send you forth,
I yearn for your returning when you shall enter glory and your rest.
When you, enraptured, at My throne are standing, a faithful servant who has done his best.
As King I then will greet My faithful servant who has endured in hardship, need and strife.
A crown of gold to him shall be awarded, a glorious future and eternal life!

hymns.title: Let us turn our faces to the light
hymns.source_file: 135 Let us turn our faces to the light lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: In a world where people walk in darkness, let us turn our faces to the light,
to the light of God revealed in Jesus, to the daystar scattering our night.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: For the light is stronger than the darkness and the day will overcome the night,
though the shadows linger all around us, let us turn our faces to the light.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: In a world where suff'ring of the helpless casts a shadow all along the way,
let us bear the cross of Christ with gladness and proclaim the dawning of the day.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: For the light is stronger than the darkness and the day will overcome the night,
though the shadows linger all around us, let us turn our faces to the light.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Let us light a candle in the darkness, in the face of death a sign of life;
as a sign of hope where all seemed hopeless, as a sign of peace in place of strife.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: For the light is stronger than the darkness and the day will overcome the night,
though the shadows linger all around us, let us turn our faces to the light.

hymns.title: Let your hearts be ever joyful
hymns.source_file: 136 Let your hearts be ever joyful lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Let your hearts be ever joyful and be filled with thanks and cheer,
for the Father kind in heaven calls us all His children dear.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Ever joyful, ever joyful, sunshine ev'ry day we see!
Strewn with pleasure is the path we follow; let us ever joyful be!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: God does lead His children safely, shields us in the daily strife.
He is gracious to us always; gives us hope and strength in life.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Ever joyful, ever joyful, sunshine ev'ry day we see!
Strewn with pleasure is the path we follow; let us ever joyful be!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Darkness soon will gather round us if we turn away from Him.
Soon our steps will be uncertain and our light of joy grow dim.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Ever joyful, ever joyful, sunshine ev'ry day we see!
Strewn with pleasure is the path we follow; let us ever joyful be!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: 'Tis the righteous who are fruitful and their path is always bright.
Let us therefore serve Christ only and in sin have no delight.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Ever joyful, ever joyful, sunshine ev'ry day we see!
Strewn with pleasure is the path we follow; let us ever joyful be!

hymns.title: Lift high the cross
hymns.source_file: 137 Lift high the cross lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: George W Kitchin (1827-1912) revised Michael R Newbolt (1874-1956)

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Lift high the cross, the love of Christ proclaim
till all the world adore His sacred name.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, Christians, follow where our Saviour trod,
our King victorious, Christ, the Son of God.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Lift high the cross, the love of Christ proclaim
till all the world adore His sacred name.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Come, be a servant of the Crucified,
bear on your brow the seal of Christ who died.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Lift high the cross, the love of Christ proclaim
till all the world adore His sacred name.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Our Lord who suffered once for you and me,
His death has brought us life eternally.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Lift high the cross, the love of Christ proclaim
till all the world adore His sacred name.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: So shall our song of triumph ever be:
We praise the Crucified for victory.
Refain

hymns.title: Little drops of water
hymns.source_file: 138 Little drops of water lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Little drops of water, little grains of sand,
make the mighty ocean and the beauteous land.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: And the little moments, humble though they be,
make the mighty ages of eternity.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: So do little errors lead the soul away
from the path of virtue, oft in sin to stray.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Little deeds of kindness, little words of love,
make our earth an Eden, door to heav'n above.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Little seeds of mercy sown by youthful hands,
grow to bless the people throughout all the lands.

hymns.title: Make me a channel of Your peace
hymns.source_file: 139 Make me a channel of Your peace lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: Sebastian Temple (1928-1998) based on Francis of Assisi

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Make me a channel of Your peace. Where there is hatred let me bring Your love.
Where there is injury, Your pardon, Lord, and where there's doubt, true faith in You.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O Master, grant that I may never seek so much to be consoled as to console,
to be understood, as to understand, to be loved, as to love with all my soul.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Make me a channel of Your peace. Where there's despair in life let me bring hope.
Where there is darkness, only light, and where there's sadness, ever joy.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O Master, grant that I may never seek so much to be consoled as to console,
to be understood, as to understand, to be loved, as to love with all my soul.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Make me a channel of Your peace. It is in pardoning that we are pardoned,
in giving of ourselves that we receive, and in dying that we're born to eternal life.

hymns.title: Make me a servant
hymns.source_file: 140 Make me a servant lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Make me a servant, humble and meek,
Lord, let me lift up those who are weak;
and may the prayer of my heart always be: Make me a servant,
make me a servant, make me a servant today.

hymns.title: Must I go all empty-handed?
hymns.source_file: 141 Must I go all empty-handed lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Must I go all empty-handed? Thus my dear Redeemer meet?
Not one day of service give Him? Lay no trophy at His feet?

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Must I go all empty-handed? Must I meet my Saviour so?
Not one soul with which to greet Him? Must I empty-handed go?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Not at death I shrink or falter, for my Saviour saves me now;
but to meet Him empty-handed– thought of that now clouds my brow.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Must I go all empty-handed? Must I meet my Saviour so?
Not one soul with which to greet Him? Must I empty-handed go?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Oh, the time of sinning wasted! Could I but recall it now
I would give it to my Saviour. To His will I gladly bow.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Must I go all empty-handed? Must I meet my Saviour so?
Not one soul with which to greet Him? Must I empty-handed go?

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Oh, ye saints, arise, be earnest! Up and work while yet it's day;
ere the night of death o'ertake you, strive for souls while yet you may.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Must I go all empty-handed? Must I meet my Saviour so?
Not one soul with which to greet Him? Must I empty-handed go?

hymns.title: O blessed house
hymns.source_file: 142 O blessed house lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O blessed house that cheerfully receiveth Thy visits, Jesus Christ, the soul's true Friend!
That, far beyond all other guests, believeth it must to Thee its warmest cheer extend.
Where ev'ry heart to Thee is fondly turning; where ev'ry tongue of Thee with pleasure speaks;
where all to know Thy will are truly yearning and ev'ryone to do it promptly seeks.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O blessed house where man and wife united in Thy true love, have both one heart and mind;
where both to Thy salvation are invited and in Thy doctrine their contentment find.
Where both to Thee, in truth, forever cleaving, in joy, in grief, make Thee their only stay
and firmly trust in Thee, remain believing in both the good and in the evil day.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O blessed house where faithful servants knowing that all their works are done within Thy sight,
in all their work with holy zeal are glowing to do alone what Thou esteemest right.
As Thy true servants in whom Thou delightest, in meekness willing, by that love constrained
which shows in all its works, the least, the brightest, how in these things great faith may be maintained.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O blessed house, the joys of which Thou sharest, and never art forgot in scenes of joy.
O blessed house for whose sad wounds Thou carest, where all the sick Thy healing pow'r employ.
Until at last, the day's work fully ended, we all, as one, in joyful rapture fly
to that blest house to which Thou hast ascended, unto the blessed Father's house on high!

hymns.title: O Master, let me walk with Thee
hymns.source_file: 143 O Master, let me walk with Thee lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O Master, let me walk with Thee in lowly paths of service free.
Tell me Thy secret, help me bear the strain of toil, the fret of care.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Help me the slow of heart to move by some clear, winning word of love.
Teach me the wayward feet to stay and guide them on the homeward way.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Let me in patience stay with Thee in closer, dearer company,
in work that keeps faith sweet and strong, in trust that triumphs over wrong.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: In hope that sends a shining ray far down the future's broad'ning way,
in peace that only Thou canst give, with Thee, O Master, let me live.

hymns.title: Of service be to Jesus
hymns.source_file: 144 Of service be to Jesus lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Of service be to Jesus, a tool within His hand.
On Him your eyes be casting, much closer to Him stand.
For rich and wondrous living did God His own create.
Our lives to Him be given, then joyful is our fate,
our lives to Him be given, then joyful is our fate.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: When Christ, the Lord of Glory, appeared in human guise,
He sought to be of service, to love and empathize.
So move on royal pathways, all those who serve in love:
A life to others given, a blessing from above,
a life to others given, a blessing from above.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: When hands shall cease their labour, when death has brought the end,
our God will grant His blessings, His arms to them extend,
for those He strength has given to serve and loyal be,
He leads from all endeavours as victors home and free,
He leads from all endeavours as victors home and free.

hymns.title: One thing's needful!
hymns.source_file: 145 One thing's needful! lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: One thing's needful, says my Saviour, always of this mindful be,
namely, that my life should focus on the love He shows to me.
Without Him my heart will be restless and seeking
as all here on earth is but transient and fleeting.
The gain of this one thing all loss can repay
and teach me in all things to follow His way.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Sitting at the feet of Jesus list'ning to His loving word,
leaving earthly cares behind me fosters oneness with my Lord.
Where Jesus and mankind in love are united,
with God's perfect fullness the heart is delighted.
I there find the worthiest moments, the best!
My one and my all, both my joy and my rest!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Jesus, Thou art my salvation, Thou my love, my all shall be.
This cannot from me be taken– Thou hast died to set me free.
Whatever I need for my journey to heaven
by Thee, O my Saviour, is lovingly given.
This one thing is needful, all others are vain,
I count all well lost if I Thee may obtain!

hymns.title: Only remembered
hymns.source_file: 146 Only remembered lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Fading away like the stars of the morning, losing their light in the glorious sun–
thus would we pass from the earth and its toiling, only remembered by what we have done.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Only remembered, only remembered, only remembered by what we have done;
thus would we pass from the earth and its toiling, only remembered by what we have done.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Shall we be missed, though by others succeeded, reaping the fields we in springtime have sown?
Yes, but the sowers must pass from their labours, ever remembered by what they have done.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Only remembered, only remembered, only remembered by what we have done;
thus would we pass from the earth and its toiling, only remembered by what we have done.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Only the truth that in life we have spoken, only the seed that on earth we have sown,
these shall pass onward when we are forgotten, fruits of the harvest and what we have done.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Only remembered, only remembered, only remembered by what we have done;
thus would we pass from the earth and its toiling, only remembered by what we have done.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Oh, when the Saviour shall make up His jewels, when the bright crowns of rejoicing are won,
then shall His faithful and zealous disciples all be remembered by what they have done.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Only remembered, only remembered, only remembered by what we have done;
thus would we pass from the earth and its toiling, only remembered by what we have done.

hymns.title: Pass it on
hymns.source_file: 147 Pass it on lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: It only takes a spark to get a fire going,
and soon all those around can warm up in its glowing;
that's how it is with God's love, once you've experienced it:
You spread God's love to ev'ryone, you want to pass it on.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: What a wondrous time is spring when all the trees are budding,
the birds begin to sing, the flowers start their blooming;
that's how it is with God's love, once you've experienced it:
You want to sing, it's fresh like spring, you want to pass it on.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I wish for you, my friend, this happiness that I've found–
on God you can depend, it matters not where you're bound.
I'll shout it from the mountain top, I want my world to know:
The Lord of Love has come to me, I want to pass it on.

hymns.title: Rise, my soul, gird thee with power
hymns.source_file: 148 Rise, my soul, gird thee with pow'r lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Rise, my soul, gird thee with pow'r; watch! To prayer betake thee;
lest the sudden evil hour unawares o'ertake thee.
Satan's prey soon are they who make no endeavour, watch not, pray not ever.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Wake, arouse! And never shirk when the Lord would teach thee.
Wake! And see His holy work shine in splendour round thee.
God demands eyes and hands open for the offers He so richly proffers.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: But first rouse thee and awake from thy sinful slumber,
else will follow in its wake burdens which encumber.
Take thou heed– utmost need! Death in sin might find thee ere thou look behind thee.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: With thy watching mingle prayer; watching, praying, waiting.
Shun all slothfulness of care; work then unabating.
And at length His great strength helps in our endeavour to be His forever.

hymns.title: Seek ye first
hymns.source_file: 149 Seek ye first lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Seek ye first the kingdom of God and its righteousness,
and all these things shall be added unto you; Allelu, alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Ask and it shall be given unto you, seek and ye shall find;
knock, and the door shall be opened unto you; Allelu, alleluia!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: We shall not live by bread alone, but by ev'ry word
that proceeds from the mouth of the Lord. Allelu, alleluia!
Descant: Alleluia (X4)

hymns.title: So much to learn remains
hymns.source_file: 150 So much to learn remains lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: So much to learn remains for ev'ry soul, for we have not attained our chosen goal.
To learn from God will open heart and mind and through His teaching blessing we will find.
A humble heart is open to the Lord; our willingness will bring a great reward.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: So oft in earthly things we find our joy, yet slow are we God's teaching to employ.
And often here in all our earthly woe to grasp the hand of God we are not slow.
We turn to Him in times of need and care, yet always of His love should be aware.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: God's hand of love is offered here today. He sent His Son– for us prepared the way.
His teaching is: To walk the narrow way. Let us take care in childlike mind to stay.
Our joy should be: Our life to give the Lord in gratitude that we are born of God!

hymns.title: So send I you
hymns.source_file: 151 So send I you lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: So send I you- by grace made strong to triumph o'er hosts of hell, o'er darkness, death and sin,
My name to bear and in that name to conquer- so send I you, My victory to win.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: So send I you- to take to souls in bondage the word of truth that sets the captive free,
to break the bonds of sin, to loose death's fetters- so send I you to bring the lost to Me.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: My strength to know in weakness, My joy in grief, My perfect peace in pain,
to prove My pow'r, My grace, My promised presence- so send I you, eternal fruit to gain.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: So send I you- to bear My cross with patience, and then one day with joy to lay it down,
to hear My voice: "Well done, My faithful servant- come, share My throne, My kingdom, and My crown!"
As the Father has sent Me, so send I you.

hymns.title: Stand up for Jesus
hymns.source_file: 152 Stand up for Jesus lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Stand up, stand up for Jesus, you soldiers of the cross.
Lift high His royal banner, it must not suffer loss.
From vict'ry unto vict'ry, His army He shall lead,
till ev'ry foe is vanquished, and He is Lord indeed.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Stand up, stand up for Jesus! Stand in His strength alone.
The arm of flesh will fail you; you dare not trust your own.
Put on the gospel armour, each piece put on with pray'r.
In duty or in danger, be never wanting there.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Stand up, stand up for Jesus! The strife will not be long.
This day the noise of battle, the next the victor's song.
For then the overcomer the crown of life shall see
and with the King of glory shall reign eternally.

hymns.title: Striving onward, pressing forward
hymns.source_file: 153 Striving onward, pressing forward lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Striving onward, pressing forward, life divine to gain;
I will ever make endeavour till I it attain.
What detains, I'll cast aside, by that promise to abide!
Who endureth life secureth and the prize shall gain.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I am hasting, time not wasting, to the Father's throne,
for delaying in obeying can but harm God's own.
He who strives but tires today, God can strengthen on the way.
Worldly pleasure holds no treasure, I wish naught of this.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Jesus guiding all my striving ever to the goal.
Should I waver, then, O Saviour, strengthen Thou my soul!
When temptations come to me and from scorn and taunt I flee,
let then mercy, love uplift me; I'll triumphant be.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Thou must help me, for without Thee I'm not strong enough.
Where I'm failing, I'll be gaining strength from Thee above.
While Thy word brings life to me and Thy Spirit sets me free,
Salem's glories rise before me, may I enter in!

hymns.title: Take time to be holy
hymns.source_file: 154 Take time to be holy lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Take time to be holy, speak oft with your Lord;
abide in Him always and feed on His word.
Make friends of God's children, help those who are weak,
forgetting in nothing His blessing to seek.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Take time to be holy, the world rushes on;
and spend time in secret with Jesus alone.
By following Jesus, like Him you shall be;
your friends in your conduct His likeness shall see.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Take time to be holy, let Him be your guide,
and run not before Him, whatever betide.
In joy or in sorrow, be never deterred
and, looking to Jesus, still trust in His word.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Take time to be holy, be calm in your soul,
each thought and each motive place in His control.
Thus led by His Spirit to fountains of love,
you soon shall be worthy for service above.

hymns.title: Take time to be holy
hymns.source_file: 155 Take time to be holy lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Take time to be holy, speak oft with your Lord;
abide in Him always and feed on His word.
Make friends of God's children, help those who are weak,
forgetting in nothing His blessing to seek.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Take time to be holy, the world rushes on;
and spend time in secret with Jesus alone.
By following Jesus, like Him you will be;
your friends in your conduct His likeness shall see.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Take time to be holy, let Him be your Guide,
and run not before Him, whatever betide.
In joy or in sorrow, be never deterred
and, looking to Jesus, still trust in His word.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Take time to be holy, be calm in your soul,
each thought and each motive place in His control.
Thus led by His Spirit to fountains of love,
you soon shall be worthy for service above.

hymns.title: The Servant King
hymns.source_file: 156 The Servant King lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: From heav'n You came, helpless Babe, entered our world, Your glory veiled;
not to be served, but to serve, and give Your life that we might live.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: This is our Lord, the Servant King, He calls us now to follow Him,
to bring our lives as a daily offering of worship to the Servant King.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: There in the garden of tears, my heavy load He chose to bear;
His heart with sorrow was torn, "Yet not My will but Yours," He said.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: This is our Lord, the Servant King, He calls us now to follow Him,
to bring our lives as a daily offering of worship to the Servant King.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Come see His hands and His feet, the scars that speak of sacrifice,
hands that flung stars into space to cruel nails surrendered.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: This is our Lord, the Servant King, He calls us now to follow Him,
to bring our lives as a daily offering of worship to the Servant King.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: So let us learn how to serve, and in our lives enthrone Him;
each other's needs to prefer, for it is Christ we're serving.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: This is our Lord, the Servant King, He calls us now to follow Him,
to bring our lives as a daily offering of worship to the Servant King.

hymns.title: The servant song
hymns.source_file: 157 The servant song lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Brother, sister, let me serve you, let me be as Christ to you;
pray that I may have the grace to let you be my servant too.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We are pilgrims on a journey; we're together on this road.
We are here to help each other walk the mile and bear the load.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I will hold the Christ-light for you in the night-time of your fear;
I will hold my hand out to you, speak the peace you long to hear.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I will weep when you are weeping; when you laugh, I'll laugh with you.
I will share your joy and sorrow till we've seen this journey through.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: When we sing to God in heaven, we shall find such harmony,
born of all we've known together of Christ's love and agony.

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: Brother, sister, let me serve you, let me be as Christ to you;
pray that I may have the grace to let you be my servant too.

hymns.title: The time of grace redeem today
hymns.source_file: 158 The time of grace redeem today lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The time of grace redeem today and let your heart be true.
Remember on your journey home God's blessings are with you!
O come today!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: If you assume but outward form, God's grace you'll then not know.
His Spirit must your teacher be, His light shine where you go.
O come today!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: From darkness and from passion's bonds can Jesus make you free.
He does provide forgiveness now and makes this loving plea: "O come today!"

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O follow Him in faith secure to God's abode of peace.
All suff'ring then will vanish there, all strife and conflicts cease.
O come today!

hymns.title: The Work is Thine
hymns.source_file: 159 The Work is Thine.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The Work is Thine, our Lord and God, the Work which is our joy,
and since it's Thine, Lord Sabaoth, no foe can it destroy.
Before the wheatcorn can send out to light and life its tender sprout,
it in the bosom of the field must first its former nature yield,
in death must yield, its former nature yield.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Through suff'ring didst Thou ever, Lord, to heaven lift Thine eyes.
O, take all those in one accord with Thee to paradise!
Lord, come and fetch Thy children here, our share of suff'ring we will bear;
through portals of Thy death and pain, we gently through Thy Work attain
eternal gain, Thy Work– eternal gain.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Thou died for us, O godly seed, transcended death and grave,
and would in ample measure feed those whom their souls would save.
Send messengers afar and near; let ev'ryone, all nations, hear
Thy name; O Lord, praise be to Thee. Prepared to work and wait are we,
to work for Thee, to work and wait for Thee!

hymns.title: There are lonely hearts to gladden
hymns.source_file: 160 There are lonely hearts to gladden lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There are lonely hearts to gladden while the days are going by.
For so many hearts are saddened while the days are going by.
If a smile we can renew as our journey we pursue,
Oh, the good we all can do while the days are going by.
Going by, going by, going by, going by, going by, going by, going by, going by;
Oh, the good we all can do while the days are going by.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Do not live for idle pleasure while the days are going by; let us share in bounteous measure while the days are going by.
In this life so filled with need, there are many souls who plead, of their plight let us take heed

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Ev'ry deed in love we render while the days are going by, will a ray of hope engender while the days are going by.
And the seeds of good we sow both in shade and shine will grow and will keep our love aglow

hymns.title: Thy hand, O God, has guided
hymns.source_file: 161 Thy hand, O God, has guided lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Thy hand, O God, has guided Thy flock from age to age;
the wondrous tale is written, full clear, on ev'ry page.
Our fathers owned Thy goodness, and we their deeds record; and both of these bear witness:
One church, one faith, one Lord,  one faith, one  Lord.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thy servants brought glad tidings to greatest, as to least;
they bade souls rise and hasten to share the great King's feast.
And this was all their teaching, in ev'ry deed and word, to all alike proclaiming:
One church, one faith, one Lord,  one faith, one  Lord.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And now, shall we be faithless? Shall hearts fail, hands hang down?
Shall we evade the conflict, and cast away our crown?
Not so: in God's deep counsels some better thing is stored; we will maintain, unflinching:
One church, one faith, one Lord,  one faith, one  Lord.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Thy mercy will not fail us, nor leave Thy work undone;
with Thy right hand to help us, the vict'ry shall be won;
and then, by men and angels, Thy name shall be adored, and this shall be their anthem:
One church, one faith, one Lord,  one faith, one  Lord.

hymns.title: To the work! To the work!
hymns.source_file: 162 To the work! To the work! lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: To the work! To the work! We are servants of God!
Let us follow the path that our Master has trod.
With the balm of His counsel our strength to renew,
let us do with our might what our hands find to do.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Toilng on, toiling on, toiling on, toiling on.
Let us hope, let us watch and labour till the Master comes!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: To the work! To the work! Let the hungry be fed;
to the fountain of life let the weary be led.
In the cross and its banner our glory shall be
while we herald the tidings: "Salvation is free!"

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Toilng on, toiling on, toiling on, toiling on.
Let us hope, let us watch and labour till the Master comes!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: To the work! To the work! There is labour for all!
For the kingdom of darkness and error shall fall
and the name of our Lord then exalted shall be
in the loud, swelling chorus: "Salvation is free!"

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Toilng on, toiling on, toiling on, toiling on.
Let us hope, let us watch and labour till the Master comes!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: To the work! To the work!In the strength of the Lord,
for a robe and a crown shall our labour reward
when the home of the faithful our dwelling shall be
and we shout with the ransomed: "Salvation is free!"

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Toilng on, toiling on, toiling on, toiling on.
Let us hope, let us watch and labour till the Master comes!

hymns.title: To your first love be returning
hymns.source_file: 163 To your first love be returning lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: To your first love be returning as it once glowed in your heart;
filled with Spirit's zeal and yearning as your faith was at the start.
Let your lamp once more burn brightly, let it glow and clearly shine!
And your mouth declare, delighted: "I am Thine, Lord, Thou art mine!"

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Come, return to this true fountain where the living water flows.
Water clear as from a mountain, poured into pure hearts He chose.
Let your lamp once more burn brightly, let it glow and clearly shine!
And your mouth declare, delighted: "I am Thine, Lord, Thou art mine!"

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: With your whole heart be returning, if divided, all is lost!
Your salvation be not spurning, it will pain and anguish cost.
Let your lamp once more burn brightly, let it glow and clearly shine!
And your mouth declare, delighted: "I am Thine, Lord, Thou art mine!"

hymns.title: What shall the harvest be?
hymns.source_file: 164 What shall the harvest be lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Oft you sow seed by the wayside hard, oft you sow seed where the thorns retard,
oft you sow seed upon rock and sand, oft you sow seed upon better land;
O, what shall the harvest be? O, what shall the harvest be?

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Sown in the darkness or sown in the light, sown in our weakness or sown in our might,
gathered in time or eternity, sure, ah, sure will the harvest, the harvest be!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Oft you sow seed when your faith's aflame, oft you sow seed amidst sin and shame,
oft you sow seed amidst threat'ning scorn, oft you sow seed with a heart forlorn;
O, what shall the harvest be? O, what shall the harvest be?

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Sown in the darkness or sown in the light, sown in our weakness or sown in our might,
gathered in time or eternity, sure, ah, sure will the harvest, the harvest be!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Oft you sow seed amidst darkest fears, oft you sow seed weeping burning tears,
oft you sow seed with a hopeful air, trusting that some day it fruit shall bear;
O, what shall the harvest be? O, what shall the harvest be?

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Sown in the darkness or sown in the light, sown in our weakness or sown in our might,
gathered in time or eternity, sure, ah, sure will the harvest, the harvest be!

hymns.title: While the sun for us shines brightly
hymns.source_file: 165 While the sun for us shines brightly lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: While the sun for us shines brightly, happy still in youthful days,
let us weave love's wreaths of kindness, shining forth as beacon rays.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: In the service of the Master let us labour while we may,
lest the sun of life be setting and it is the close of day.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: If we love the name of Jesus, let us prove this by our deeds:
Practise love, do good to others, follow gladly where He leads.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: In the service of the Master let us labour while we may,
lest the sun of life be setting and it is the close of day.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Comfort bringing, souls inviting, ever working for the Lord.
May this be our true endeavour which does grace and joy afford.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: In the service of the Master let us labour while we may,
lest the sun of life be setting and it is the close of day.

hymns.title: Who is on the Lord's side?
hymns.source_file: 166 Who is on the Lord's side lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Who is on the Lord's side? Who will serve the King?
Who will be His helpers, other souls to bring?
Who will spread His name wide? Who will face the foe?
Who is on the Lord's side? Who for Him will go?
By Thy call of mercy, by Thy grace divine,
we are on the Lord's side; Saviour, we are Thine.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Not for weight of glory, not for crown or palm,
do we serve our Master, raise the joyful psalm;
but for love that claimeth those for whom He died.
He whom Jesus nameth must be on His side.
By Thy love constraining, by Thy grace divine,
we are on the Lord's side; Saviour, we are Thine.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Jesus, Thou hast bought us, not with gold or gem,
but with Thine own lifeblood, for Thy diadem.
With Thy blessing filling each who comes to Thee,
Lord, we then are willing in Thy work to be.
By Thy great redemption, by Thy grace divine,
we are on the Lord's side; Saviour, we are Thine.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Fierce may be the conflict, strong may be the foe,
but the work of Jesus none can overthrow.
Round His standard ranging, vict'ry is secure,
for His truth unchanging make the triumph sure.
Joyfully enlisting by Thy grace divine,
we are on the Lord's side; Saviour, we are Thine.

hymns.title: Work, for the night is coming
hymns.source_file: 167 Work, for the night is coming lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Work, for the night is coming; work through the morning hours.
Work while the dew is sparkling; work 'mid springtime flow'rs.
Work when the day grows brighter; work in the glowing sun.
Work, for the night is coming when man's work is done.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Work, for the night is coming; work through the sunny noon.
Fill ev'ry hour with labour, rest comes sure and soon.
Give ev'ry flying minute something to keep in store.
Work, for the night is coming when man works no more.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Work, for the night is coming; under the sunset skies,
while brightest tints are glowing, work, for daylight flies.
Work till the last beam fadeth, fadeth to shine no more.
Work, for the light is fading; soon man's time is o'er.

hymns.title: Yield not to temptation
hymns.source_file: 168 Yield not to temptation lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Yield not to temptation, for yielding is sin.
Each vict'ry will help you some other to win.
Fight manfully onward, dark passions subdue,
look ever to Jesus: He'll carry you through.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Ask the Saviour to help you, comfort, strengthen and keep you.
He is willing to aid you: He'll carry you through.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Shun evil companions, bad language disdain,
God's name hold in rev'rence, don't take it in vain.
Be thoughtful and earnest, kindhearted and true,
look ever to Jesus: He'll carry you through.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Ask the Saviour to help you, comfort, strengthen and keep you.
He is willing to aid you: He'll carry you through.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: To each overcomer God will give a crown.
Through faith we shall conquer, though often cast down.
He who is our Saviour, our strength will renew,
look ever to Jesus: He'll carry you through.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Ask the Saviour to help you, comfort, strengthen and keep you.
He is willing to aid you: He'll carry you through.

hymns.title: You servants of the Lord
hymns.source_file: 169 You servants of the Lord lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: You servants of the Lord, upon your Master wait,
observe His holy, heav'nly word, be watchful at His gate.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Let all your lamps be bright and trim the golden flame;
gird up your loins as in His sight, for mighty is His name.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O hear your Lord's command and know that He is near.
O see the sig nal of His hand, be ready, do not fear.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O happy servant he in such a manner found!
He shall his Lord with rapture see, with honour he'll be crowned.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Your Lord the feast shall spread with His own royal hand,
and raise that faithful servant's head amid the heav'nly band.

hymns.title: A little child feels longing for its mother
hymns.source_file: 170 A little child feels longing for its mother lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: A little child feels longing for its mother; a bridegroom longs to greet his loving bride.
The sick and lonely yearn for loving comfort; the feeble lamb will seek its shepherd's side.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Where then will I find healing for my spirit? Who can restore my sad and burdened soul?
When I have drifted from God's congregation, how can my soul find Him who makes me whole?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O Son of God, my Helper, my Redeemer, anew in You I place my faith and trust.
You are the Healer of my soul, the Saviour, to whom my will and life I would adjust.

hymns.title: A little ship sailed o'er the sea
hymns.source_file: 171 A little ship sailed o'er the sea lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: A little ship sailed o'er the sea, a voyage to begin.
Its sails were white as snow could be, with noble folks within.
But quickly did a storm appear and mighty winds did blow.
The raging sea was wild and drear, the ship tossed to and fro.
The raging sea was wild and drear, the ship tossed to and fro.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: All frightened in the ship were they, save one who slept aside;
it was their Lord that there did lay, to whom they, anxious, cried:
"Lord, save or we shall perish all!" He heard, spoke but a word,
then still became the treach'rous squall; the wind His voice had heard!
Then still became the treach'rous squall; the wind His voice had heard!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O Church of Christ, O noble ship, how perfectly you sail;
though threatened by the tempest's grip, oft high the sea and gale.
God's still with you, be not afraid, He'll guide you by His will
and, even though the storm's severe, at His command it's still;
and, even though the storm's severe, at His command it's still.

hymns.title: A mighty fortress is our God
hymns.source_file: 172 A mighty fortress is our God lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: A mighty fortress is our God, a trusty shield and weapon.
He helps us free in ev'ry need that hath us overtaken.
The ancient bitter foe still seeks to work us woe.
Deep guile and greatest might are his dread arms in fight;
on earth is not his equal.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: With human might can naught be done– our loss would be effected,
but for us fights the Valiant One whom God Himself elected.
Ask ye who this may be? Christ Jesus– it is He,
of Sabaoth the Lord, and there's no other God, He holds the field forever.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Though devils all the world should fill, all watching to devour us,
we tremble not, we fear no ill, they cannot overpow'r us.
Though this world's prince may still scowl fiercely as he will,
his rage we can endure for lo! his doom is sure;
one little word o'erthrows him.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: God's word forever shall remain in spite of all resistance.
His gifts and Spirit us sustain– in battle, our subsistence.
Should they then take our life, goods, honour, child or wife,
and when their worst they've done, they yet have nothing won:
The kingdom ours remaineth.

hymns.title: And Jesus said
hymns.source_file: 173 And Jesus said lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: And Jesus said: "Don't be afraid, I've come to turn your fear to hope,
I've come to take you through the deep, to be your Friend until the end
and give your troubled heart to sleep."

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: And Jesus said: "Don't be afraid, I know your emptiness and grief,
I hear your words of unbelief, but if you will, I'll heal your soul
and give your doubting heart relief."

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And Jesus said: "Don't be afraid, I am the Way, I am the Light,
I am the Truth that holds you tight and in God's home you have a room,
a place of welcome and delight."

hymns.title: Be still, my soul
hymns.source_file: 174 Be still, my soul lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: Katherina von Schlegel, 18th cent. transl. Jane L Borthwick (1813-1897)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Be still, my soul: The Lord is on your side! With patience bear the cross of grief or pain;
leave to your God to order and provide– in ev'ry change He faithful will remain.
Be still, my soul: Your best, your heav'nly Friend through thorny ways leads to a joyful end.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Be still, my soul: Your God will undertake to guide the future as He has the past;
your hope, your confidence let nothing shake– all now mysterious shall be bright at last.
Be still, my soul: The waves and winds still know His voice who ruled them while He dwelt below.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Be still, my soul: The hour is hastening on when we shall be forever with the Lord,
when disappointment, grief, and fear are gone, sorrow forgot, love's purest joys restored.
Be still, my soul: When change and tears are past, all safe and blessed we shall meet at last.

hymns.title: Come, come, ye saints
hymns.source_file: 175 Come, come, ye saints lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: William Clayton (1814-1879) revised Joseph F Green (b. 1924)
metadata.composer: American folk melody adapted from Sacred Harp, 1844

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, come, ye saints, no toil nor labour fear; but with joy wend your way.
Though hard to you the journey may appear, grace shall be as your day.
We have a living Lord to guide, we trust for us He will provide;
Do this, and joy your hearts will swell:
All is well!
All is well!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Care of the world is with us ev'ry day; let it not this obscure:
Here we can serve the Master on the way, and in Him be secure.
Gird up your loins; fresh courage take, our God will never us forsake.
And so our song no fear can quell:
All is well!
All is well!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: We'll find the rest which God for us prepared, when at last He will call.
Where none will come to hurt or make afraid, He will reign over all.
We will make the air with music ring, sing praise to God our Lord and King:
Oh, how we'll make the chorus swell:
All is well!
All is well!

hymns.title: Commit your way, confiding
hymns.source_file: 176 Commit your way, confiding lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Commit your way, confiding, when trials here arise,
to Him whose hand is guiding the tumults of the skies.
There clouds and tempests raging have each their paths assigned;
will God for you engaging no way of safety find?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Trust in the Lord, your Saviour, who for your needs provides.
Build on His grace and favour, your work shall safe abide.
You can make no advances by selfconsuming care,
but He His help dispenses when called upon in prayer.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: His way the only pathway, all pow'r is in His hand.
His gracious works our mainstay, in thankfulness we stand.
His work no man can hinder, His labours  ne'er can rest
until all of His children eternally are blest.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Arise! Forget your sorrow, your troubles, fears and pain.
Be trusting that the morrow will bring eternal gain!
For you are not the ruler who reigns and governs all;
our Lord and heav'nly Master helps us and hears our call.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Let Him then rule and guide you, for He is wise and just.
In all truth He will lead you, so place in Him your trust!
Beyond your wish extended His goodness will appear
when He has fully ended what caused your needless fear.

hymns.title: Count your blessings
hymns.source_file: 177 Count your blessings lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: When upon life's billows you are tempest-tossed,
when you are discouraged, thinking all is lost,
count your many blessings, name them one by one
and you will rejoice at what the Lord has done.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Count your blessings, name them one by one;
count your blessings, see what God has done!
Count your blessings, name them one by one
and you will rejoice at what the Lord has done.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Are you ever burdened with a load of care?
Does the cross seem heavy you are called to bear?
Count your many blessings, never doubt God's love
and with joyful singing give Him praise above.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Count your blessings, name them one by one;
count your blessings, see what God has done!
Count your blessings, name them one by one
and you will rejoice at what the Lord has done.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: When you look at others with their lands and gold,
think that Christ has promised you His wealth untold;
count your many blessings, wealth can never buy
your reward in heaven, nor your home on high.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Count your blessings, name them one by one;
count your blessings, see what God has done!
Count your blessings, name them one by one
and you will rejoice at what the Lord has done.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: So, amid the conflict, whether great or small,
do not be disheartened, God is over all;
count your many blessings, angels will attend,
help and comfort give you to your journey's end.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Count your blessings, name them one by one;
count your blessings, see what God has done!
Count your blessings, name them one by one
and you will rejoice at what the Lord has done.

hymns.title: Forever with the Lord
hymns.source_file: 178 Forever with the Lord lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Forever with the Lord! My lot shall always be;
my star at night shall be that word to heaven guiding me.
Here on the earth I'm pent, can but a stranger be,
yet nightly pitch my moving tent, Lord, always nearer Thee.
Nearer Thee, nearer Thee; Lord, always nearer Thee!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Though oft I cannot see, my sight begins to wane;
I'm blinded by the mists of care, perplexed by grief and pain.
The clouds once more decrease and when the storms depart,
to bring me cheer, the light of peace brings comfort to my heart.
Light of peace, light of peace; what comfort to my heart!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I raise to heav'n my eyes. There home does beckon me
and, guided on the path of faith, that home I here can see.
Then for this home above I yearn, there long to rest,
to share in that great wondrous love in realms of blessedness.
Wondrous love, wondrous love in realms of blessedness.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: And when my pulse is still, my soul from bondage free,
pass out of death to life I will, triumphant shall I be.
I'll see in beauty there what earth could not afford;
and I shall be, how wonderful, forever with the Lord!
Wonderful, wonderful, forever with the Lord!

hymns.title: God is our strength and refuge
hymns.source_file: 179 God is our strength and refuge lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God is our strength and refuge, our present help in trouble;
and we therefore will not fear, though the earth should change!
Though mountains shake and tremble, though swirling floods are raging,
God the Lord of Hosts is with us evermore!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: There is a flowing river within God's holy city;
God is in the midst of her, she shall not be moved!
God's help is swiftly given, thrones vanish at His presence,
God the Lord of Hosts is with us evermore!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Come, see the works of our Maker, learn of His deeds allpow'rful:
Wars will cease across the world when He breaks the spear!
Be still, know your Creator, uplift Him in the nations,
God the Lord of Hosts is with us evermore!
Words © 1982 The Jubilate Group (Administered by Hope Publishing Company,
Carol Stream IL 60188).

hymns.title: God moves in a mysterious way
hymns.source_file: 180 God moves in a mysterious way lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God moves in a mysterious way His wonders to perform;
He plants His footsteps in the sea, and rides upon the storm.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: You fearful saints, fresh courage take; the clouds you so much dread
are filled with mercy and shall break in blessings on your head.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: His purposes will ripen fast, unfolding ev'ry hour;
the bud may have a bitter taste, but sweet will be the flow'r.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Blind unbelief is sure to err and scan His work in vain:
God is His own interpreter and He will make it plain.

hymns.title: God of our fathers
hymns.source_file: 181 God of our fathers lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God of our fathers, whose almighty hand
leads forth in beauty all the starry band
of shining worlds in splendour through the skies,
our grateful songs before Thy throne arise.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thy love divine hath led us in the past,
in this our land by Thee our lot is cast;
be Thou our Ruler, Guardian, Guide, and Stay,
Thy word our law, Thy paths our chosen way.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: From war's alarms, from deadly pestilence,
be Thy strong arm our ever sure defense;
Thy true religion in our hearts increase,
Thy bounteous goodness nourish us in peace.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Strengthen Thy people on their toilsome way;
lead us from night to neverending day.
Fill all our lives with love and grace divine
and glory, laud and praise be ever Thine!
(Amen, Amen.)

hymns.title: God will take care of you
hymns.source_file: 182 God will take care of you lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Be not dismayed whate'er betide, God will take care of you.
Under His wings of love abide, God will take care of you.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: God will take care of you, through ev'ry day, all of the way.
He will take care of you, God will take care of you.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: In days of toil, should courage fail, God will take care of you.
When dangers fierce your faith assail, God will take care of you.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: God will take care of you, through ev'ry day, all of the way.
He will take care of you, God will take care of you.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: All you may need He will provide, God will take care of you.
All by His grace will be supplied, God will take care of you.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: God will take care of you, through ev'ry day, all of the way.
He will take care of you, God will take care of you.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: No matter what may be the test, God will take care of you.
Lean, weary one, upon His breast, God will take care of you.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: God will take care of you, through ev'ry day, all of the way.
He will take care of you, God will take care of you.

hymns.title: Hiding in Thee
hymns.source_file: 183 Hiding in Thee lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Oh, safe to the Rock that is higher than I,
my soul in its conflicts and sorrows would fly.
So sinful, so weary, Lord,Thine would I be.
Thou blest Rock of Ages, I'm hiding in Thee.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Hiding in Thee, hiding in Thee;
Thou blest Rock of Ages, I'm hiding in Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: In calmness of noontide, in sorrow's lone hour,
in times when temptation casts o'er me its pow'r;
in tempests of life, on its wide, heaving sea,
Thou blest Rock of Ages, I'm hiding in Thee.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Hiding in Thee, hiding in Thee;
Thou blest Rock of Ages, I'm hiding in Thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: How oft in the conflict, when pressed by the foe,
I've fled to my Refuge and breathed out my woe!
How often, when trials like seabillows roll,
I've hidden in Thee, O Thou Rock of my soul.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Hiding in Thee, hiding in Thee;
Thou blest Rock of Ages, I'm hiding in Thee.

hymns.title: Hold the fort
hymns.source_file: 184 Hold the fort lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Ho! my comrades, see the signal waving in the sky!
Reinforcements now appearing, victory is nigh!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: "Hold the fort, for I am coming," Jesus signals still.
Wave the answer back to heaven: "By Thy grace we will."

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: See the mighty host advancing, Satan leading on:
Many are around us falling, courage almost gone.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: "Hold the fort, for I am coming," Jesus signals still.
Wave the answer back to heaven: "By Thy grace we will."

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: See the glorious banner waving, hear the bugle blow.
In our Leader's name we'll triumph over ev'ry foe.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: "Hold the fort, for I am coming," Jesus signals still.
Wave the answer back to heaven: "By Thy grace we will."

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Fierce and long the battle rages, but our Help is near.
Onward comes our great Commander; trust Him, do not fear.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: "Hold the fort, for I am coming," Jesus signals still.
Wave the answer back to heaven: "By Thy grace we will."

hymns.title: How firm a foundation
hymns.source_file: 185 How firm a foundation lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: Rippon's Selection of Hymns, 1787 vss. 2-5 ref. Isaiah 43 : 1-5

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: How firm a foundation, you saints of the Lord,
is laid for your faith in His excellent Word!
What more can He say than to you He has said,
to you who for refuge to Jesus have fled?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: "Fear not, I am with you, O be not dismayed,
for I am your God, and will still give you aid;
I'll strengthen you, help you, and cause you to stand,
upheld by My righteous, omnipotent hand.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: "When through the deep waters I call you to go,
the rivers of sorrow shall not overflow;
for I will be with you in trouble to bless,
and sanctify you in your deepest distress.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: "When through fiery trials your pathway shall lie,
My grace, all sufficient, shall be your supply;
the flame shall not hurt you, I only design
your dross to consume, and your gold to refine.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: "The soul that on Jesus still leans for repose,
I promise I will not desert to its foes;
that soul, though all hell should endeavour to shake,
I'll ever remember and never forsake!"

hymns.title: I know whom I have believed
hymns.source_file: 186 I know whom I have believed lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I know not why God's wondrous grace to me He hath made known,
nor why, with mercy, Christ in love redeemed me for His own.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: But I know whom I have believed and am persuaded that He is able
to keep that which I've committed unto Him until that day.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I know not how this saving faith to me He did impart,
nor how believing in His word wrought peace within my heart.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: But I know whom I have believed and am persuaded that He is able
to keep that which I've committed unto Him until that day.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I know not how the Spirit moves, diverting us from sin,
revealing Jesus through the word, creating faith within.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: But I know whom I have believed and am persuaded that He is able
to keep that which I've committed unto Him until that day.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I know not when my Lord may come, at night or noonday fair,
nor if I'll walk the vale with Him, or meet Him in the air.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: But I know whom I have believed and am persuaded that He is able
to keep that which I've committed unto Him until that day.

hymns.title: I will guide thee
hymns.source_file: 187 I will guide thee lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: based on Nathaniel Niles (1835-?) ref. Psalm 32 : 6-8

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Precious the promise that God has given, cheering the pilgrims while they pass by
on the journey traveling homeward: "I will guide thee with Mine eye.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I will guide thee, I will guide thee, I will guide thee with Mine eye;
on the journey traveling homeward, I will guide thee with Mine eye."

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Fear not the surging waters of Babel, neither the tempter should he draw nigh,
but remember, God gave the promise: "I will guide thee with Mine eye.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I will guide thee, I will guide thee, I will guide thee with Mine eye;
on the journey traveling homeward, I will guide thee with Mine eye."

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Wonderful love and glorious mercy– God the Almighty heareth my cry.
Of this promise I am unworthy: "I will guide thee with Mine eye.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I will guide thee, I will guide thee, I will guide thee with Mine eye;
on the journey traveling homeward, I will guide thee with Mine eye."

hymns.title: If God Himself is for me
hymns.source_file: 188 If God Himself is for me lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: If God Himself is for me, I shall a host defy.
For when I pray, before me my foes confounded fly.
If Christ, the Head, befriends me, if God is my support,
the mischief they intend me shall quickly come to naught.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: 'Tis my belief, conviction, and I am not afraid
to say that by election God's child I have been made.
That in life's joy and sadness He's ever at my side
to aid me, oft so helpless, when evil here betides.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I build on this foundation that Jesus and His blood
alone are my salvation, the true, eternal good.
The joy from heaven pleases like nothing here on earth;
the gifts I owe to Jesus alone my love are worth.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: His Holy Spirit dwelleth within my willing heart,
to tame when it rebelleth and sooth the keenest smart.
He crowns His work with blessing and helpeth me to cry:
"My Father!" without ceasing, to Him who reigns on high.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: My heart is light and joyful; how could I saddened be?
For happy and not woeful a child of God should be.
The Sun so brightly beaming is my Lord, Jesus Christ;
the songs which I am singing tell of His paradise!

hymns.title: I'm the child of a King
hymns.source_file: 189 I'm the child of a King lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: My Father is rich in houses and lands,
He holdeth the wealth of the world in His hands.
Of rubies and diamonds, of silver and gold,
His coffers are full, He hath riches untold!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I'm the child of a King! The child of a King!
With Jesus my Saviour, I'm the child of a King!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: My Father's own Son, the Saviour of men,
once travelled on earth as the poorest of them;
but now He is reigning forever on high,
in heav'n He will give me a home by and by.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I'm the child of a King! The child of a King!
With Jesus my Saviour, I'm the child of a King!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I once was an outcast stranger on earth,
a sinner by choice and an alien by birth;
but I've been adopted, my name's written down–
an heir to the mansion, a robe and a crown!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I'm the child of a King! The child of a King!
With Jesus my Saviour, I'm the child of a King!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: A tent or a cottage, why should I care?
God's building a palace for me over there.
A home now awaits me, in joy will I sing:
"All glory to God, I'm the child of a King!"

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I'm the child of a King! The child of a King!
With Jesus my Saviour, I'm the child of a King!

hymns.title: In times like these
hymns.source_file: 190 In times like these lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: In times like these you need a Saviour, in times like these you need an anchor.
Be very sure your anchor holds and grips the solid Rock.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: This Rock is Jesus, He is the One: God gave His own begotten Son.
This Rock is Jesus, He is the One. This Rock is Jesus, the only One.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: In times like these you need a Bible, in times like these do not be idle.
Be very sure your anchor holds and grips the solid Rock.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: This Rock is Jesus, He is the One: God gave His own begotten Son.
This Rock is Jesus, He is the One. This Rock is Jesus, the only One.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: In times like these I have a Saviour, in times like these I have an anchor.
I'm very sure my anchor holds and grips the solid Rock.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: This Rock is Jesus, He is the One: God gave His own begotten Son.
This Rock is Jesus, He is the One. This Rock is Jesus, the only One.

hymns.title: It is no secret
hymns.source_file: 191 It is no secret lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The chimes of time ring out the news; another day is through.
Someone slipped and fell; was that someone you?
You may have longed for added strength, your courage to renew.
Do not be disheartened, for I bring hope to you.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: It is no secret what God can do. What He's done for others, He'll do for you.
With arms wide open He'll pardon you; it is no secret what God can do.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: There is no night, for in His light you'll never walk alone.
He will lead you home; never from Him roam.
There is no pow'r can conquer you while God is on your side.
Take Him at His promise and in His love abide.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: It is no secret what God can do. What He's done for others, He'll do for you.
With arms wide open He'll pardon you; it is no secret what God can do.

hymns.title: I've found a joy in sorrow
hymns.source_file: 192 I've found a joy in sorrow.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I've found a joy in sorrow, a precious balm for pain; a beautiful tomorrow of sunshine after rain.
I've found a branch of healing near ev'ry bitter spring; for ev'ry anxious feeling the Lord does comfort bring,
for ev'ry anxious feeling the Lord does comfort bring.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I've found a glad hosanna for ev'ry woe and wail.
A handful of sweet manna when grapes of Eshcol fail.
I've found a Rock of Ages when desert wells are dry and after weary stages I've found an Elim nigh,
and after weary stages I've found an Elim nigh.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: This E-lim with its cool-ness, its foun-tains and its shade,
a bless-ing is in full-ness when buds of prom-ise fade. Oft through my tears return-ing I see the sun a-gain;
it sa-tis-fies my yearn-ing and soothes my great-est pain,
it sa-tis-fies my yearn-ing and soothes my great-est pain.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: My Sav-iour, You pos-sess-ing, I have the joy, the balm, the heal-ing and the bless-ing,
the sun-shine and the calm.
The prom-ise for the fear-ful, the E-lim for the faint; the rain-bow for the tear-ful, the glo-ry for the saint,
the rain-bow for the tear-ful, the glo-ry for the saint!

hymns.title: Jesus never fails
hymns.source_file: 193 Jesus never fails lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Earthly friends may prove untrue, doubts and fears assail;
One still loves and cares for you: Jesus never fails.
Jesus never fails, Jesus never fails, Jesus never fails.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Though the sky be dark and drear, fierce and strong the gale,
just remember He is near and He will not fail.
Jesus never fails, Jesus never fails, Jesus never fails.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: In life's dark and bitter hour, Love will still prevail;
trust His everlasting pow'r, Jesus will not fail.
Jesus never fails, Jesus never fails, Jesus never fails.

hymns.title: Jesus, Lover of my soul
hymns.source_file: 194 Jesus, Lover of my soul_parry lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus, Lover of my soul, let me to Thy bosom fly
while the nearer waters roll, while the tempest still is high.
Hide me, O my Saviour, hide, till the storm of life is past;
safe into the haven guide, O receive my soul at last.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Other refuge have I none, hangs my helpless soul on Thee;
leave, Oh, leave me not alone, still support and comfort me.
All my trust on Thee is stayed, all my help from Thee I bring;
cover my defenceless head with the shadow of Thy wing.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Plenteous grace with Thee is found, grace to cover all my sin;
let the healing streams abound, make and keep me pure within.
Thou of life the Fountain art, freely let me take of Thee;
spring Thou up within my heart; rise to all eternity.

lines: Jesus, Lover of my soul, let me to Thy bossom fly
