hymns.title: Jesus, Saviour, pilot me
hymns.source_file: 196 Jesus, Saviour, pilot me lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus, Saviour, pilot me over life's tempestous sea.
Unknown waves before me roll, hiding rocks and treach'rous shoal.
Chart and compass come from Thee; Jesus, Saviour, pilot me.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: As a mother stills her child, Thou can'st hush the ocean wild.
Boist'rous waves obey Thy will when Thou say'st to them: "Be still!"
Wondrous Sov'reign of the sea, Jesus, Saviour, pilot me.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: When at last I near the shore and the fearful breakers roar
'twixt me and the peaceful rest, then, while leaning on Thy breast,
may I hear Thee say to me: "Fear not, I will pilot thee."

hymns.title: Lead on, O King eternal
hymns.source_file: 197 Lead on, O King eternal lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lead on, O King eternal, the day of march has come;
henceforth in fields of conquest Thy tents shall be our home.
Through days of preparation Thy grace has made us strong,
and now, O King eternal, we lift our battle song.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Lead on, O King eternal, till sin's fierce war shall cease
and holiness shall whisper the sweet amen of peace.
For not with swords, loud clashing, nor roll of stirring drums,
but deeds of love and mercy, the heav'nly kingdom comes.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Lead on, O King eternal,we follow, not with fears,
for gladness breaks like morning where'er Thy face appears.
Thy cross is lifted o'er us; we journey in its light;
the crown awaits the conquest; lead on, O God of might.

hymns.title: Light after darkness
hymns.source_file: 198 Light after darkness lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Light after darkness, gain after loss,
strength after weakness, crown after cross,
sweet after bitter, hope after fears,
home after wand'ring, praise after tears!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Sheaves after sowing, sun after rain,
sight after mystery, peace after pain,
joy after sorrow, calm after blast,
rest after weariness, sweet rest at last!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Health after sickness, death it does foil,
wealth after poverty, ease after toil;
after all trials, comfort of heart,
with Christ united, never to part!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Near after distant, gleam after gloom,
love after loneliness, life after tomb;
after much patience, rapture and bliss;
right was the pathway leading to this.

hymns.title: Lord, Thou camest in compassion
hymns.source_file: 199 Lord, Thou camest in compassion lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord, Thou camest in compassion like a shepherd to his sheep.
Rich in blessing Thou dost fashion, Lord, if near Thy staff we keep.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: How could mortal tongue be telling what to Thy flock Thou art worth?
Nothing here is Thee excelling, nothing greater on this earth!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: How could need and danger frighten when we hold Thy mighty arm?
No! Thy word and staff enlighten, shelter us anew from harm.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Should the tempter make us fearful, who provides new strength and peace?
Who can lift up, help and carry, who has power to release?

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Lord, in grace Thy flock Thou takest unto Thee in love today.
Through Thy messengers completing Thy great plan without delay.

hymns.title: Make no plans without the Lord
hymns.source_file: 200 Make no plans without the Lord lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Make no plans without the Lord!
Childlike trust in Him applying,
not on your own strength relying,
vain conceit brings no reward.
Make no plans without the Lord!
Make no plans without the Lord!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Make no plans without the Lord!
All who heed His indication
cannot miss their destination,
safely He will them escort.
Make no plans without the Lord!
Make no plans without the Lord!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Make no plans without the Lord!
Courage will the Lord be sending,
grant each task a happy ending,
if with Him in one accord.
Make no plans without the Lord!
Make no plans without the Lord!

hymns.title: Master, the tempest is raging
hymns.source_file: 201 Master, the tempest is raging lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Master, the tempest is raging! The billows are tossing high!
The sky is o'ershadowed with blackness, no shelter or help is nigh.
Carest Thou not that we perish? How canst Thou lie asleep
when each moment so madly is threat'ning a grave in the angry deep?

sections.label: Refrain
lines: "The winds and the waves shall obey My will, peace, be still!
Whether the wrath of the storm-tossed sea, or demons, or men, or whatever it be,
no water can swallow the ship where lies the Master of ocean and earth and skies.
They all shall sweetly obey My will; peace, be still! Peace, be still!
They all shall sweetly obey My will; peace, peace, be still!"

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Master, with anguish of spirit, I call in my fear today.
The depths of my sad heart are troubled; Oh, waken and save, I pray!
Torrents of sin and of anguish sweep o'er my sinking soul
and I perish, I perish, dear Master; Oh, hasten and take control!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: "The winds and the waves shall obey My will, peace, be still!
Whether the wrath of the storm-tossed sea, or demons, or men, or whatever it be,
no water can swallow the ship where lies the Master of ocean and earth and skies.
They all shall sweetly obey My will; peace, be still! Peace, be still!
They all shall sweetly obey My will; peace, peace, be still!"

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Master, the terror is over, the elements calmly rest.
Earth's sun in the calm lake is mirrored and heaven's within my breast.
Linger, O blessed Redeemer, leave me alone no more.
Thus with joy I shall make the blest harbour and rest on the blissful shore.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: "The winds and the waves shall obey My will, peace, be still!
Whether the wrath of the storm-tossed sea, or demons, or men, or whatever it be,
no water can swallow the ship where lies the Master of ocean and earth and skies.

hymns.title: My Jesus is my dearest Friend
hymns.source_file: 202 My Jesus is my dearest Friend lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: My Jesus is my dearest Friend, in Him my heart finds rest.
His love, so true, does me attend. He makes my life most blest.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: That's why I always can depend on Jesus as my dearest Friend;
that's why I always can depend on Jesus as my dearest Friend.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: My Jesus is my dearest Friend, what joy this does convey!
He does me grace and mercy send, His Spirit lights my way!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: That's why I always can depend on Jesus as my dearest Friend;
that's why I always can depend on Jesus as my dearest Friend.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: My Jesus is my dearest Friend, no other friend like He.
Though Satan's host may strong contend, my Jesus stays with me.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: That's why I always can depend on Jesus as my dearest Friend;
that's why I always can depend on Jesus as my dearest Friend.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: My Jesus is my dearest Friend, He always has loved me.
He calls me His, I am His friend, no greater joy could be!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: That's why I always can depend on Jesus as my dearest Friend;
that's why I always can depend on Jesus as my dearest Friend.

hymns.title: Not human advice
hymns.source_file: 203 Not human advice lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Not human advice nor man's wisdom known can help you to reach the heavenly home.
In doubt must a pilgrim discouraged abide if fails the assurance:
The Lord will provide, the Lord will provide!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: If burdened you are and needing God's care, then turn to the Saviour– do not despair!
In humbleness therefore in Him do confide; accept His assurance:
The Lord will provide, the Lord will provide!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Your heart He knows well– to Him all is known.
Believe then and grasp the love He has shown.
What's good for His children, the Lord shall decide, so therefore we trust Him:
The Lord will provide, the Lord will provide!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: We walk on the way that Jesus has shown– a way which is found in Jesus alone.
Through hardship or joy then, whatever betide, we have the assurance:
The Lord will provide, the Lord will provide!

hymns.title: On eagle's wings
hymns.source_file: 204 On eagle's wings lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: You who dwell in the shelter of the Lord, who abide in His shadow for life,
say to the Lord, "My refuge, my Rock in whom I trust."

sections.label: Refrain
lines: And He will raise you up on eagle's wings, bear you on the breath of dawn,
make you to shine like the sun, and hold you in the palm of His hand.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The snare of the fowler will never capture you, and famine will bring you no fear,
under His wings your refuge, His faithfulness your shield.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: And He will raise you up on eagle's wings, bear you on the breath of dawn,
make you to shine like the sun, and hold you in the palm of His hand.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: You need not fear the terror of the night, nor the arrow that flies by day;
though thousands fall about you, near you it shall not come.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: And He will raise you up on eagle's wings, bear you on the breath of dawn,
make you to shine like the sun, and hold you in the palm of His hand.

hymns.title: On Zion's mount of radiant light
hymns.source_file: 205 On Zion's mount of radiant light lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: On Zion's mount of radiant light, ye faithful heroes, rise.
Go forth to fight before the night creeps o'er the fading skies.
Against the foe that lurks below our forces let be hurled;
faith leads to victory, we know, that overcomes the world!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Faith leads to victory! Faith leads to victory!
To glorious victory that overcomes the world!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The Prince of Life goes on before, His word is our defence.
We tread the path the saints of yore once trod with confidence.
The living word, like sunshine bright, lights up this darkened world;
gives strength of faith to win the fight, love's banner keeps unfurled.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Faith leads to victory! Faith leads to victory!
To glorious victory that overcomes the world!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Then onward from the mount of light, our hearts with love aflame,
we'll vanquish all the hosts of night in Jesus' conqu'ring name!
The victor wears the crown adored, white raiment of the Son.
The faithful servant's great reward is rest from battles won.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Faith leads to victory! Faith leads to victory!
To glorious victory that overcomes the world!

hymns.title: Our God is true
hymns.source_file: 206 Our God is true lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Our God is true! Those He will ne'er forsake who through His love He knows.
Our God is true! We shall His care partake in all our joys and woes.
His wings will spread their shelter o'er us though mountains quake, earth yawns before us:
Our God is true! Our God is true!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Our God is true! He is a faithful Friend, we from experience know;
and rest assured, He will our souls defend from ev'ry threat'ning foe.
His promised help bears no denial to childlike faith in hours of trial:
Our God is true! Our God is true!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Our God is true! He keeps His promise giv'n. His light on us does shine.
It shows the way to life with Him in heav'n; for us it is divine.
Not like the word of man on earth here, God's word of truth we ever hold dear:
Our God is true! Our God is true!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Our God is true! Do not forget, dear soul, how kind and true He is.
Be true to God! Let this your life control and be devoutly His.
From loving Him let nothing keep you and of His help let none deprive you:
Our God is true! Our God is true!

hymns.title: Safely faith through life will guide us
hymns.source_file: 207 Safely faith through life doth guide us lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Safely faith through life will guide us, keep us in the Saviour's hand.
Help us onward, upward, heav'nward by the strength of love's command.
Help us onward, upward, heav'nward by the strength of love's command.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Love will cover ev'ry weakness which in others I may see,
for the Saviour, with compassion, also covers faults in me;
for the Saviour, with compassion, also covers faults in me.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Hope will never that discredit which the future holds concealed;
gives us comfort in all suff'ring till by God all is revealed;
gives us comfort in all suff'ring till by God all is revealed.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Practise faith, hope, love and patience, just as Jesus also taught.
By our noble deeds and conduct honour is to God's name brought.
By our noble deeds and conduct honour is to God's Work brought.

hymns.title: Should my pathway lead through tempest
hymns.source_file: 208 Should my pathway lead lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Should my pathway lead through tempest, yes, o'er barren desert land,
Christ will still remain my refuge, safely lead me by His hand.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: He will shield me, He will guide me, never leave His child behind,
till at last in Salem's meadows lasting peace and rest I'll find,
till at last in Salem's meadows lasting peace and rest I'll find.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: With much patience I must struggle if I would the goal attain.
Here on earth we hear the story, there we'll sing the sweet refrain.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: He will shield me, He will guide me, never leave His child behind,
till at last in Salem's meadows lasting peace and rest I'll find,
till at last in Salem's meadows lasting peace and rest I'll find.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: If the cunningness of Satan should with fear my heart oppress,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: He will shield me, He will guide me, never leave His child behind,
till at last in Salem's meadows lasting peace and rest I'll find,
till at last in Salem's meadows lasting peace and rest I'll find.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O then let us practise meekness, faithful, follow His command;
then at last, free from transgressions, we before His throne shall stand.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: He will shield me, He will guide me, never leave His child behind,
till at last in Salem's meadows lasting peace and rest I'll find,
till at last in Salem's meadows lasting peace and rest I'll find.

hymns.title: Someday there will be peace
hymns.source_file: 209 Someday there will be peace lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Are there troubles that surround you on your way to heaven's door?
Look then up and pray to Jesus, He will comfort all the more:

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Someday there will be peace, someday there will be peace,
someday there will be peace; all our crying and our sighing then shall cease.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Sadness often gathers round you and your joy grows dim and weak;
find in Him the strength to go with joy, to all of this to speak:

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Someday there will be peace, someday there will be peace,
someday there will be peace; all our crying and our sighing then shall cease.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Who has peace on earth to offer? Where can joy be found today?
Only from the love of Jesus comes this comfort on your way:

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Someday there will be peace, someday there will be peace,
someday there will be peace; all our crying and our sighing then shall cease.

hymns.title: Star, to which I'm looking
hymns.source_file: 210 Star, to which I'm looking.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Star, to which I'm looking, Rock, on which I stand,
Leader, whom I'm trusting, Staff, that's in my hand,
Bread, by which I'm living, Spring, at which I bow,
Goal, for which I'm striving: All,O Lord, art Thou!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: How could I without Thee strength and courage share?
Who, but Thee, could help me all my burdens bear?
Lacking Thee I'd wither like a severed bough.
Faith, hope, love together: All, O Lord, art Thou!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: With what Thou hast given I'll pursue my way
till the bells of heaven guide me home some day.
Then, anew rejoicing, whisper to Thee low:
"I can bring Thee nothing: All, O Lord, art Thou!"

hymns.title: Strong is my Lord Jesus' hand
hymns.source_file: 211 Strong is my Lord Jesus' hand lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Strong is my Lord Jesus' hand; He will hold my hand and guide me.
No one can His pow'r withstand; He will always be beside me.
My Redeemer, my Defence: In Him I have confidence.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Though by Satan still accused, Christ for me has interceded.
Even though by sin abused, Jesus' love for me has pleaded.
Christ is now my sure Defence: In Him I have confidence.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: If my Lord with stern approach seeks to form me in His image,
I shall not avoid reproach but His help I will acknowledge.
He, the Judge, will grace dispense: In Him I have confidence.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Nothing me from Thee will part, none can take this consolation.
Great assurance fills my heart through His word– a firm foundation.
Jesus is my sure Defence: In Him I have confidence.

hymns.title: Take Jesus in your ship of life
hymns.source_file: 212 Take Jesus in your ship of life lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Take Jesus in your ship of life; let faith and trust possess you!
In love a source of strength is He, no danger need distress you.
Fear not though billows loudly roar and high the waves that wash the shore.
O fear no ill, He's with you still, your Lord and Master, Jesus.
Take Jesus in your ship of life that He may safely guide you!
His own He pilots safe through strife, no evil can betide you.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He holds the helm secure and fast, you will not be forsaken.
Just trust in Him until the last with childlike faith unshaken.
The winds and waves obey His will, at His command they all are still.
O fear no ill, He's with you still, your Lord and Master, Jesus.
Take Jesus in your ship of life that He may safely guide you!
His own He pilots safe through strife, no evil can betide you.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Be always watchful and prepared; in faith be valiant ever,
then Satan, though the fight be fierce, will fail in his endeavour.
Christ calms the sea with mighty hand, so follow gladly His command.
O fear no ill, He's with you still, your Lord and Master, Jesus.
Take Jesus in your ship of life that He may safely guide you!
His own He pilots safe through strife, no evil can betide you.

hymns.title: Take the name of Jesus with you
hymns.source_file: 213 Take the name of Jesus with you lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Take the name of Jesus with you, child of sorrow and of woe;
it will joy and comfort give you– take it then where'er you go.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Precious name, O how sweet! Hope of earth and joy of heav'n.
Precious name, O how sweet! Hope of earth and joy of heav'n.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Take the name of Jesus ever as a shield from ev'ry snare;

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Precious name, O how sweet! Hope of earth and joy of heav'n.
Precious name, O how sweet! Hope of earth and joy of heav'n.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Oh, the precious name of Jesus! How it thrills our souls with joy

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Precious name, O how sweet! Hope of earth and joy of heav'n.
Precious name, O how sweet! Hope of earth and joy of heav'n.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Mighty is the name of Jesus! All there bowing at His feet,
King of kings in heav'n He'll crown us when our journey is complete.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Precious name, O how sweet! Hope of earth and joy of heav'n.
Precious name, O how sweet! Hope of earth and joy of heav'n.

hymns.title: The King of love my Shepherd is
hymns.source_file: 214 The King of love my Shepherd is lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: Henry W Baker (1821-1877) based on Psalm 23

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The King of love my Shepherd is, whose goodness faileth never;
I nothing lack if I am His, and He is mine forever.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Where streams of living water flow my ransomed soul He leadeth,
and where the verdant pastures grow, with food celestial feedeth.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Perverse and foolish oft I strayed, but yet in love He sought me
and on His shoulder gently laid, and home, rejoicing, brought me.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: In death's dark vale I fear no ill with Thee, dear Lord, beside me;
Thy rod and staff my comfort still, Thy cross before to guide me.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Thou spread'st a table in my sight; Thou boundless grace bestoweth;
and oh, what fullness of delight from Thy pure chalice floweth!

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: And so through all the length of days Thy goodness faileth never:
Good Shepherd, may I sing Thy praise within Thy house forever.

hymns.title: The Lord knows all his people
hymns.source_file: 215 The Lord knows all His people lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The Lord knows all His people as in the days of yore.
The mighty and the humble on ev'ry land and shore.
He'll save them from destruction; they never are alone.
In living and in dying they will remain His own.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The Lord knows all His children, their faith casts out all doubt.
Not seeing yet believing, they trust and hope throughout.
All born of God's own Spirit are nourished by His word.
Before this word they're bowing; they keep it, undeterred.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: He knows their loving nature, the fruits of Godly love.
They seek with honest longing to please their Lord above.
Who do so unto others as God has moved their heart,
receive as they have given, for God will grace impart.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: He knows them as His chosen, their courage, hope and zest.
In happiness united, they find in Him true rest.
The truth of God has brilliance that shines both free and pure
upon a fold most blessed which always will endure.

hymns.title: The Lord's my Shepherd
hymns.source_file: 216 The Lord's my Shepherd_irvine lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The Lord's my Shepherd, I'll not want;
He makes me down to lie in pastures green;
He leadeth me the quiet waters by.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: My soul He doth restore again,
and me to walk doth make within the paths of righteousness,
e'en for His own name's sake.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Yea, though I walk through death's dark vale,
yet will I fear no ill; for Thou art with me,
and Thy rod and staff me comfort still.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: My table Thou hast furnished in presence of my foes;
my head Thou dost with oil anoint,
and my cup overflows.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Goodness and mercy all my life shall surely follow me;
and in God's house forevermore
my dwellingplace shall be.

hymns.title: Through every land they journey
hymns.source_file: 218 Through every land they journey lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Through ev'ry land they journey, the blest and ransomed fold
and from their happy voices a wondrous song unfolds.
It rings in lands of sorrow as from a happy throng
who sing with deepest yearning, with praise, the Victor's song.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: It is the song of Jesus, that new song they have found.
From Calv'ry's cross its echo all over will resound.
The song of Christ the Victor, of how His life He gave
by which He earned the ransom for all, from death to save.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Wherever souls are gathered, with joy they all do sing
the song of praise eternal, their thanks to Him they bring.
And others join the singing, no words need they express,
their joy is seen on faces that beam with happiness.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O blessed song of Jesus! When will we sing above?
When will You come, dear Saviour, in Your great  wondrous love?
Come gather soon Your chosen and now our souls prepare
so we at last in glory may sing Your praises there!

hymns.title: Toiling bravely onward
hymns.source_file: 219 Toiling bravely onward lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Toiling bravely onward, come whatever may;
in the love of Jesus onward ev'ry day.
Though we may not battle pleasing to man's will,
yet the truth of Jesus human tongues can still.
Though the foe may threaten, stormy winds may blow,
with the love of Jesus let us onward go!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Toiling bravely onward, to the goal away,
even when derided as in Noah's day.
Though the foe may threaten, fear shall have no place;
Christ has us forgiven by His word of grace.
Though the foe may threaten, stormy winds may blow,
with the love of Jesus let us onward go!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Toiling bravely onward, we today behold
what was once the yearning of the prophets old.
In the works of Jesus see our mighty God.
Jesus leads us ever onward to our God.
Though the foe may threaten, stormy winds may blow,
with the love of Jesus let us onward go!

hymns.title: Trust and obey
hymns.source_file: 220 Trust and obey lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: When we walk with the Lord in the light of His word, what a glory He sheds on our way!
While we do His good will, He abides with us still, and with all who will trust and obey.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Trust and obey, for there's no other way to be happy in Jesus, but to trust and obey.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Not a shadow can rise, not a cloud in the skies, but His smile quickly drives it away;
not a doubt nor a fear, not a sigh nor a tear, can abide while we trust and obey.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Trust and obey, for there's no other way to be happy in Jesus, but to trust and obey.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Not a burden we bear, not a sorrow we share, but our toil He doth richly repay;
not a grief nor a loss, not a frown nor a cross, but is blest if we trust and obey.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Trust and obey, for there's no other way to be happy in Jesus, but to trust and obey.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: But we never can prove the delights of His love until all on the altar we lay;

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Trust and obey, for there's no other way to be happy in Jesus, but to trust and obey.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Then in fellowship sweet we will sit at His feet, or we'll walk by His side in the way;
what He says we will do, where He sends we will go– never fear, only trust and obey.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Trust and obey, for there's no other way to be happy in Jesus, but to trust and obey.

hymns.title: Trusting each and every day
hymns.source_file: 221 Trusting each and every day lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Trusting each and ev'ry day, trusting through a stormy way;
trusting more when high the sea. Jesus tells me: "Trusting be!"

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Trusting You, my Lord and God; trusting all the way I've trod.
Trusting still in Zion free; Jesus tells me: "Trusting be!"

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Brightly beams His Spirit clear; to my  humble heart draws near.
Him I trust to make me free.Jesus tells me: "Trusting be!"

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Trusting You, my Lord and God; trusting all the way I've trod.
Trusting still in Zion free; Jesus tells me: "Trusting be!"

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Happy when the sun does shine, happy, for the Lord is mine.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Trusting You, my Lord and God; trusting all the way I've trod.
Trusting still in Zion free; Jesus tells me: "Trusting be!"

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Trusting on through life I go, trusting both in joy and woe.
