sections.label: Refrain
lines: Trusting You, my Lord and God; trusting all the way I've trod.
Trusting still in Zion free; Jesus tells me: "Trusting be!"

hymns.title: Victory through grace
hymns.source_file: 222 Victory through grace lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Conquering now and still to conquer, rideth a King in His might,
leading the host of all the faithful into the midst of the fight.
See them with courage advancing, clad in their brilliant array,
shouting the name of their Leader, hear them exultingly say:

sections.label: Refrain
lines: "Not to the strong is the battle, not to the swift is the race,
but to the true and the faithful, vict'ry is promised through grace."

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Conquering now and still to conquer; who is this wonderful King?
Who is the army which He leadeth, while of His glory they sing?
He is our Lord and Redeemer, Saviour and Monarch divine,
they are the stars that forever bright in His kingdom will shine.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: "Not to the strong is the battle, not to the swift is the race,
but to the true and the faithful, vict'ry is promised through grace."

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Conquering now and still to conquer: Jesus, Thou Ruler of all.
Thrones and their scepters all shall perish, crowns and their splendour shall fall,
yet shall the army Thou leadest, faithful and true to the last,
find in Thy kingdom eternal, rest when their warfare is past.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: "Not to the strong is the battle, not to the swift is the race,
but to the true and the faithful, vict'ry is promised through grace."

hymns.title: Wait, my soul, and tarry
hymns.source_file: 223 Wait, my soul, and tarry lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Wait, my soul, and tarry, tarry with God!
He will help you carry ev'ry grievous load.
Why fret and fear when the morn is near?
With the passing winter spring will reappear.
When storms distress you, in ev'ry ill,
God will surely bless you, my soul, be still.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Wait, my soul, and tarry, tarry with God!
He will help you carry ev'ry grievous load.
When others fail, God will still prevail;
greater than the Helper nothing can assail!
Lord, God eternal, lead to the goal!
Christ, forever faithful, save now my soul!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Wait, my soul, and tarry, tarry with God!
He will help you carry ev'ry grievous load.
Soon all shall cease, pilgrims know release,
no more fearful pleading: Jesus, grant me peace!
When through affliction His way I've trod,
follows joy eternal: O faithful God!

hymns.title: We are in need of patience
hymns.source_file: 224 We are in need of patience lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We are in need of patience when trials come our way,
when many great temptations could cause our heart to stray.
O come, selected fold, now follow Godly teaching,
with heart and soul beseeching: "Your promise, Lord, uphold!"

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: A Godly gift is patience, the Holy Spirit's fruit,
for here we need endurance to walk the Godly route.
A blessing from above in all our cares and worries;
it helps us bear and carry what here we must, in love.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Our faith is born through longing to hear and keep God's word.
In this let us be watchful, assured and undeterred.
Our faith will stay alive when patiently we're guided
by servants here provided and heavenward we strive!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Though patience is a virtue not easy to attain,
with Godly help and courage we may this gift obtain.
O Lord, for help I pray! To Thee this plea I tender
and ask that Thou will render great patience on my way!

hymns.title: We would our Saviour see
hymns.source_file: 225 We would our Saviour see lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We would our Saviour see, who died on Calvary,
who has the curse of sin borne in our stead.
For us His blood He shed that we may blessed be;
He, through His love for us, death's way did tread.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O Lord, we plead: Show us Thy holy will;
with us abide and all our longings still.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We would our Saviour see, ev'n in extremity;
in joy or sorrow, in need, when distressed;
firmly abiding in faith and in modesty,
trusting His counsel while knowing it's best.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O Lord, we plead: Show us Thy holy will;
with us abide and all our longings still.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: We would our Saviour see, when shadows dark appear,
spreading the gloom of night over life's way;
and when our feet become weary, when night is near,
and from the pathway they then go astray.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O Lord, we plead: Show us Thy holy will;
with us abide and all our longings still.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: We would our Saviour see, make this a certainty;
we strive, with love, to appear as His bride.
His Holy Spirit provides our security;
He builds His kingdom for those glorified.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O Lord, we plead: Show us Thy holy will;
with us abide and all our longings still.

hymns.title: What a Friend we have in Jesus
hymns.source_file: 226 What a Friend we have in Jesus lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: What a Friend we have in Jesus, all our sins and griefs to bear.
What a privilege to carry ev'rything to God in prayer!
Oh, what peace we often forfeit; Oh, what needless pain we bear!
All because we do not carry ev'rything to God in prayer.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Have we trials and temptations? Is there trouble anywhere?
We should never be discouraged; take it to the Lord in prayer.
Can we find a Friend so faithful who will all our sorrows share?
Jesus knows our ev'ry weakness; take it to the Lord in prayer.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Are we weak and heavy laden, cumbered with a load of care?
Precious Saviour, still our refuge; take it to the Lord in prayer.
Do our friends despise, forsake us? Take it to the Lord in prayer.
In His arms He'll take and shield us; we will find sweet solace there.

hymns.title: When Jesus lives in me
hymns.source_file: 227 When Jesus lives in me lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: When  Jesus lives in me, His truth shall make me free.
Fear, sorrow must from me depart, His love is in my heart!
Fear, sorrow must from me depart, His love is in my heart!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He is my Shepherd true, with care He guides me to
His pastures ever green and fair, gives heav'nly water there;
His pastures ever green and fair, gives heav'nly water there.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Though sunshine is no more and lions 'round me roar,
I shall not fear the gloomy night for Jesus is my light!
I shall not fear the gloomy night for Jesus is my light!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: If I should go astray, depart the narrow way,
I find that in my Saviour's heart is balsam for all smart.
I find that in my Saviour's heart is balsam for all smart.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: I therefore look to Him, His blessings rich to win.
With Jesus ever close and dear, my paradise is near!
With Jesus ever close and dear, my paradise is near!

hymns.title: When the storms of life are raging
hymns.source_file: 228 When the storms of life are raging lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: When the storms of life are raging, I with Jesus safely stand,
feel myself securely hidden in the shadow of His hand.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: He doth hide me, He doth hide me where no storms can e'er betide me;
He doth hide me, doth hide me in the shadow of His hand.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Though I may be sore afflicted, I to Him for comfort turn;
sore affliction does but try me, and to trust Him more I learn.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: He doth hide me, He doth hide me where no storms can e'er betide me;
He doth hide me, doth hide me in the shadow of His hand.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: When temptations lurk around me and the foe would me destroy,
Jesus leads me out of danger, gives me greater strength and joy.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: He doth hide me, He doth hide me where no storms can e'er betide me;
He doth hide me, doth hide me in the shadow of His hand.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Though the storms of life are raging and the billows rising high,
I shall never be discouraged for on Jesus I rely.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: He doth hide me, He doth hide me where no storms can e'er betide me;
He doth hide me, doth hide me in the shadow of His hand.

hymns.title: With a golden staff in hand
hymns.source_file: 229 With a golden staff in hand lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: With a golden staff in hand, I shall journey through the land.
My redemption it will be, back to heaven leading me.
Staff of faith, give me assurance, keep me steadfast in endurance
and should soul and body part, you are built into my heart!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Now a Saviour kind and mild in the form of God's own child
comes my heart with joy to fill, teaches me our Lord's true will.
Love is God's great gift from heaven, part not from this first love given.
Once as brethren we shall be with our God eternally.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: There from heaven clear and bright shines a Star with glorious light.
Beckons me with joyfulness, fills my heart with happiness!
In this Star I'm ever hoping, from afar see heaven op'ning.
Leading those who Him would trust into heav'n from mortal dust.

hymns.title: With You, O Lord, united
hymns.source_file: 230 With You, O Lord, united lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: With You, O Lord, united, I never feel alone.
In You I am delighted; Your love to me is shown.
In happy, joyous hours I come to You in prayer.
My path is strewn with flowers, my life with me You share!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: When wounds are sorely burning, on thorns I tread in pain,
then will my soul be learning that true You will remain.
The wounds that hurt my being none other can perceive,
but You who are all-seeing can ev'ry pain relieve.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Compassion moves me truly when others suffer need.
When griefs weighs down unduly, for others then I plead.
I come to You appealing, to others unaware,
for You all wounds are healing, You hear the silent prayer.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: How could I then be lonely when You with me abide?
In joy and grief I only would have You at my side.
What You I'd not be telling, should not live in my heart;
I should, my faith compelling, all things to You impart.

hymns.title: Zion's sheltered by God's mountains
hymns.source_file: 231 Zion's sheltered by God's mountains lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Zion's sheltered by God's mountains, safely neath His mighty hand.
That my faith He may yet strengthen, looking up to Him, I stand, looking up to Him, I stand.
Be the sky o'ercast with darkness and I see no hopeful star,
still I know that God is loving, from His own is never far, from His own is never far.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Did not He create the heavens and the earth at His command?
And to save me from destruction, out of love He took my hand, out of love He took my hand.
To redeem me, humble sinner, sent His Son unto my aid
and to loose me from my fetters He the ransom fully paid, He the ransom fully paid.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Should I, then, not love and trust Him who so dearly first love me?
Should I not to Him be faithful though there trouble round me be, though there trouble round me be?
No, I will not be lamenting in this world of grief and pain;
after these few years of suff'ring, heaven's glory I shall gain, heaven's glory I shall gain.

hymns.title: Abide with me
hymns.source_file: 232 Abide with me lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Abide with me; fast falls the eventide; the darkness deepens; Lord, with me abide.
When other helpers fail and comforts flee, Help of the helpless, O abide with me.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Swift to its close ebbs out life's little day; earth's joys grow dim, its glories pass away.
Change and decay in all around I see; O Thou who changest not, abide with me.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I need Thy presence ev'ry passing hour; what but Thy grace can foil the tempter's pow'r?
Who, like Thyself, my guide and stay can be? Thro' cloud and sunshine, O abide with me.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I fear no foe, with Thee at hand to bless; ills have no weight, and tears no bitterness.
Where is death's sting? Where, grave, thy victory? I triumph still if Thou abide with me.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Hold Thou Thy cross before my closing eyes; shine through the gloom and draw me to the skies.
Heav'n's morning breaks and earth's vain shadows flee; in life, in death, O Lord, abide with me.

hymns.title: Abide with us, Lord Jesus
hymns.source_file: 233 Abide with us, Lord Jesus lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Abide with us, Lord Jesus! Thy grace sustain our hearts
that Satan may not harm us with his malignant arts.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Abide with the assurance of Thy redeeming word,
that peace, now and hereafter, be ours through Thee, O Lord.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Abide and with Thy radiance cheer us, Resplendent Light;
Thy truth direct and keep us from error's gloomy night.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Abide and let Thy blessing, Lord, rest on us each day.
All needful strength and graces grant Thou us, Lord, we pray.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Abide then with us, Saviour! Our constant, faithful Friend;
grant steadfastness and patience and vict'ry at the end!

hymns.title: As the deer
hymns.source_file: 234 As the deer lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: As the deer pants for the water, so my soul longs after You.
You alone are my heart's desire and I long to worship You.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: You alone are my strength, my shield; to You alone may my spirit yield.
You alone are my heart's desire and I long to worship You.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: You're my friend and You are my brother, even though You are a King.
I love You more than any other, so much more than anything.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: You alone are my strength, my shield; to You alone may my spirit yield.
You alone are my heart's desire and I long to worship You.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I want You more than gold or silver, only You can satisfy.
You alone are the real joy giver and the apple of my eye.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: You alone are my strength, my shield; to You alone may my spirit yield.
You alone are my heart's desire and I long to worship You.

hymns.title: Be Thou my Vision
hymns.source_file: 235 Be Thou my Vision lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: Irish poem, 8th cent. transl. Mary E Byrne (1880-1931)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Be Thou my Vision, O Lord of my heart;
naught be all else to me save that Thou art.
Thou my best thought by day or by night,
waking or sleeping, Thy presence my light.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Be Thou my Wisdom, be Thou my true Word;
I ever with Thee, and Thou with me,Lord.
Thou my great Father, I ever Thine;
Thou in me dwelling, Thy will ever mine.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Be Thou my Shield and my Sword in the fight.
Be Thou my Comforter, Thou my Delight,
Thou my soul's Shelter, Thou my high Tow'r.
Raise Thou me heav'nward, O Pow'r of my pow'r.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Riches I heed not, nor vain, empty praise;
Thou mine Inheritance, now and always.
Thou and Thou only, first in my heart,
Sov'reign of heaven, my Treasure Thou art.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: High King of heaven, when vict'ry is won
may I reach heaven's joys, bright heaven's Sun!
Heart of my heart, whatever befall,
still be my Vision, O Ruler of all.

hymns.title: Before my heart's King bowing
hymns.source_file: 236 Before my heart's King bowing lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Before my heart's King bowing a humble gift I bring
and though it's small and modest, it pleases Him, my King.
It is my will I offer upon this narrow way,
so that His mind and stature may grow in me each day.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I will no longer tarry by anxious fear distressed;
with joyful heart I'll venture to lean upon His breast.
For me His life He offered, for me He shed His blood.
Will He not always render what wholesome is and good?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I know that His compassion is boundless like His grace.
And even poorest sinners He holds in fond embrace,
and through His love eternal He seeks to make me whole.
I will with patience follow His footsteps to the goal.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O look upon me kindly, on me, Your feeble child.
I look to You, my Saviour, for strength and mercy mild.
I lay my hands now gladly in Your almighty hand
and know You home will lead me, up to the Father land.

hymns.title: Blessed Jesus, at Thy word
hymns.source_file: 237 Blessed Jesus, at Thy word lyrics.txt

metadata.composer: Johann R Ahle (1625-1673) harmony based on J S Bach (1685-1750)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Blessed Jesus, at Thy word we are gathered here, beseeching;
let our hearts and souls be stirred by Thy loving, heav'nly teaching.
By that teaching sweet and holy, draw us close to love Thee only!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: All our knowledge, sense and sight lie in deepest darkness shrouded,
till Thy Spirit breaks our night with the beams of truth unclouded.
Thou alone to God canst win us; Thou must work all good within us!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Glorious Lord, Thyself impart! Light of light, from God proceeding.
Open Thou our ears and heart, help us by Thy Spirit's pleading.
Hear the cry each soul now raises, hear and bless our prayers and praises!

hymns.title: Dear Lord, I give completely
hymns.source_file: 238 Dear Lord, I give completely lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Dear Lord, I give completely my body, heart and soul;
Thou High Priest, I entreat Thee, my mind and will control.
With holy fire igniting my longing, Lord, for Thee,
behold how I am waiting; hide not Thy light from me.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O mighty, blessed Saviour, eternal, sweet Retreat;
I wait in chaste behaviour, my trust in Thee complete.
With holy fire igniting my longing, Lord, for Thee,
behold how I am waiting; hide not Thy light from me.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Fill me with zeal and fervour that I can do Thy will;
to be an active server, Thy word through me fulfil.
With holy fire igniting my longing, Lord, for Thee,
behold how I am waiting; hide not Thy light from me.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: If I then make provision to wisely use this time,
I make the best decision for reaching realms sublime.
With holy fire igniting my longing, Lord, for Thee,
behold how I am waiting; hide not Thy light from me.

hymns.title: Gentle Shepherd, come and lead us
hymns.source_file: 239 Gentle Shepherd, come and lead us lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Gentle Shepherd, come and lead us, for we need You to help us find our way.
Gentle Shepherd, come and feed us, for we need Your strength from day to day.
There's no other we can turn to who can help us face another day.
Gentle Shepherd, come and lead us for we need You to help us find our way.

hymns.title: Give me a perfect heart
hymns.source_file: 240 Give me a perfect heart lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Give me a perfect heart, guide all my thoughts and actions, that I do not leave You to follow vain distractions.
These cause my heart distress; Lord, let me never stray on paths of wickedness, but walk the narrow way.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Give me a perfect heart when evil comes to hound me. May the Holy Ghost then enlighten and surround me,
that on this narrow way I seek not worldly praise, but follow Christ always, be with Him all my days.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Give me a perfect heart when worldly thoughts are pressing, lust of eye and flesh overcoming through Your blessing.
The world with all its lust must some day come to naught; the pure in heart, the just, in heav'n to God are brought.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Give me a perfect heart; no evil will alarm me. If You take my part, then the raw winds cannot harm me.
Let then Your Spirit's pow'r be strong and firm in me that in that glorious hour in pure white robes I'm free!

hymns.title: God, all-pow'rful, help the humble
hymns.source_file: 241 God, all-pow'rful, help the humble lyrics.txt

metadata.composer: attr. B F White (1800-1879) harm. Joan A Fyock (b. 1938)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God, all-pow'rful, help the humble, I am hopeless without Thee!
Lift me up, Lord, when I stumble; comfort, bless and strengthen me.
Let me feel Thy presence near me ev'rywhere I go or stay;
when I call, dear Father, hear me, God, almighty, lead the way!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: God, all-pow'rful, from my conscience ev'ry accusation purge.
Thoughts that vexed and burdened long since, take away, I humbly urge.
Lord, Thy Son– Oh! revelation– came to earth to save the soul;
gave His life for my salvation, grace to reach the promised goal.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: God, all-pow'rful, my devotion lukewarm oft appears to be.
Let no doubt or false emotion weaken Thy dear word in me.
Hear my prayer when I beseech Thee; I before Thy altar bow.
In Thy sacred temple grant me, Lord, Thy counsel, hear me now.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: God, all-pow'rful, when in sadness I am filled with fear and woe,
in this world I find no gladness, then Thy love can heal, I know.
When oppressed by grief and sorrow, help me then to bear the pain.
Grant me patience, Lord, to follow, heal my wounded heart again.

hymns.title: Guide me, O Thou great Redeemer
hymns.source_file: 242 Guide me, O Thou great Redeemer lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: William Williams (1717-1791) transl. Peter Williams (1722-1796) and others

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Guide me, O Thou great Redeemer, pilgrim through this barren land.
I am weak, but Thou art mighty; hold me with Thy pow'rful hand.
Bread of heaven, bread of heaven, feed me now and evermore; (evermore)
feed me now and evermore.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Open now the crystal fountain, whence the healing stream doth flow;
let the fire and cloudy pillar lead me all my journey through.
Strong deliv'rer, strong deliv'rer, be Thou still my strength and shield; (strength and shield)
be Thou still my strength and shield.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: When I tread the verge of Jordan, bid my anxious fears subside;
death of death and hell's destruction, land me safe on Canaan's side.
Songs of praises, songs of praises I will ever give to Thee; (give to Thee)
I will ever give to Thee.

hymns.title: Have Thine own way, Lord
hymns.source_file: 243 Have Thine own way, Lord lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Have Thine own way, Lord! Have Thine own way! Thou art the Potter; I am the clay.
Mould me and make me after Thy will, while I am waiting yielded and still.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Have Thine own way, Lord! Have Thine own way! Search me and try me, Master, today!
Whiter than snow, Lord, wash me just now, as in Thy presence humbly I bow.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Have Thine own way, Lord! Have Thine own way! Wounded and weary, help me, I pray!
Power– all power– surely is Thine! Touch me and heal me, Saviour divine!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Have Thine own way, Lord! Have Thine own way! Hold o'er my being absolute sway!
Fill with Thy Spirit till all shall see Christ only, always, living in me!

hymns.title: Here is my heart
hymns.source_file: 244 Here is my heart lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Here is my heart; my God, I give it Thee who hath by grace it made.
"Deny the world, My child, give it to Me!" Thy voice did me persuade.
In love my gift is dedicated; O take it, Lord, and consecrate it.
Here is my heart, here is my heart.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Here is my heart; it graciously receive although it is forlorn.
I give it Thee in love and true belief, Thy grace I do not scorn!
With sin and guilt it is bespotted, with dark desires and shame allotted,
my sinful heart, my sinful heart.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Here is my heart; in Christ it would be whole; it to the cross draws nigh,
and says: "O Lord, Thou treasure of my soul, life by Thy death have I."
It has in wounds of Christ, the Saviour, found comfort, blessedness and favour,
my faithful heart, my faithful heart.

hymns.title: I need Thee every hour
hymns.source_file: 245 I need Thee every hour lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I need Thee ev'ry hour, most gracious Lord.
No tender voice like Thine can peace afford.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I need Thee, Oh, I need Thee, ev'ry hour I need Thee.
O bless me now, my Saviour, I come to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I need Thee ev'ry hour, stay Thou nearby.
Temptations lose their pow'r when Thou art nigh.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I need Thee, Oh, I need Thee, ev'ry hour I need Thee.
O bless me now, my Saviour, I come to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I need Thee ev'ry hour in joy or pain.
Come quickly and abide or life is vain.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I need Thee, Oh, I need Thee, ev'ry hour I need Thee.
O bless me now, my Saviour, I come to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I need Thee ev'ry hour. Teach me Thy will
and Thy rich promises in me fulfil.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I need Thee, Oh, I need Thee, ev'ry hour I need Thee.
O bless me now, my Saviour, I come to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: I need Thee ev'ry hour, most Holy One.
Oh, make me Thine indeed, Thou blessed Son!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I need Thee, Oh, I need Thee, ev'ry hour I need Thee.
O bless me now, my Saviour, I come to Thee.

hymns.title: I want to love Thee more sincerely
hymns.source_file: 246 I want to love Thee more sincerely lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I want to love Thee more sincerely; my Saviour, give me strength for this.
Long did the world at random steer me, but now I've found in Thee true bliss.
This bliss outshines all fleeting pleasures, all royal crowns and earthly treasures:
This bliss shows heaven open wide.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Deceived by foes, I spurned Thy mercy and death I faced eternally.
Yet kindly Thou hast drawn me to Thee and Thy compassion gave to me.
Friend of my soul, for love so tender, take Thou my heart, I all surrender.
Accept it, Lord, make it Thine own!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: My dearest Lord, I often wonder if e'er my love would perfect grow.
I know Thy heart grows ever fonder for me who begs Thee help to show.
I seek the wealth of Thy great kindness; Thy light let shine, heal me from blindness;
let Thy perfection dwell in me.

hymns.title: Just as God leads me
hymns.source_file: 247 Just as God leads me.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Just as God leads me I would go,
I would not ask to choose my way.
Content with what He will bestow, assured He will not let me stray.
So as He leads, my path I make and ev'ry step I gladly take, a child in Him confiding.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Just as God leads,
I am content.
I rest so calmly in His hands.
I then accept what He has sent, that which His will of me commands.
I would that He should all fulfil and I may do His holy will in living and in dying.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Just as God leads, I all re-sign.
I trust e'er to my Fa-ther's will.
When rea-son's rays de-cep-tive shine, His coun-sel would I yet ful-fil.
That which His love or-dained as right be-fore He brought me to the light, I trea-sure now and ev-er.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Just as God leads me, I a-bide, in faith, in hope, in suf-f'ring too.
His strength is ev-er by my side, can aught my hold on Him un-do?
Thus firm I stand, in pa-tience know that God on me does grace be-stow; the best in kind-ness send-ing.

hymns.title: Lord, preserve my soul
hymns.source_file: 248 Lord, preserve my soul lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord, preserve my soul from all evil, make me pure and clean within.
Make me worthy, I implore You; Lord, grant my soul the strength to overcome all sin.
Make me worthy, I implore You. Lord, keep me ever sheltered in Your love and grace until my longing is fulfilled:
To meet You face to face, O loving Father, now before You in this prayer I stand:
"Come, take me up into the heav'nly Fatherland."

hymns.title: Lord, teach us how to pray aright
hymns.source_file: 249 Lord, teach us how to pray aright lyrics.txt

metadata.composer: William V Wallace (1814-1865) arr. Uzziah C Burnap (1834-1900)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord, teach us how to pray aright with rev'rence and with fear;
though dust and ashes in Thy sight, we may, we must draw  near.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We perish if we cease from prayer: O grant us pow'r to pray;
and, when to meet Thee we prepare, Lord, meet us on the way.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O God of grace, we bring to Thee a broken, contrite heart;
give what Thine eye delights to see: Truth in the inward part;

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: faith in the only sacrifice that can for sin atone,
to cast our hopes, to fix our eyes on Christ, on Christ alone;

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: with patience watch and wait and weep, tho' long we have to grieve,
and courage that our souls will keep, that still we may believe.

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: Give these, and then Thy will be done; thus filled with Godly might
we through Thy Spirit and Thy Son shall pray, and pray aright.

hymns.title: Master, speak, Thy servant heareth
hymns.source_file: 250 Master, speak, Thy servant heareth lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Master, speak, Thy servant heareth, waiting for Thy gracious word,
longing for Thy voice that cheereth; Master, let it now be heard.
I am list'ning, Lord, for Thee: what hast Thou to say to me?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Speak to me by name, O Master, let me know it is to me;
speak, that I may follow faster, with a step more firm and free,
where the Shepherd leads the flock in the shadow of the rock.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Master, speak and make me ready, when Thy voice is truly heard,
with obedience glad and steady still to follow ev'ry word.
I am list'ning Lord, for Thee: Master, speak, O speak to me!

hymns.title: My Father, as You will
hymns.source_file: 251 My Father, as You will lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: My Father, as You will; Oh, may Your will be mine!
Into Your hand of love I would my all resign.
Through sorrow or through joy, my ways with Yours be one
and help me still to say: "My Lord, Your will be done!"
And help me still to say: "My Lord, Your will be done!"

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: My Father, as You will; tho' oft I shed a tear,
let not my star of hope grow dim or disappear.
With grace and blessing, Lord, my path of faith here pave.
Your will alone be done, for You my soul would save.
Your will alone be done, for You my soul would save.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: My Father, as You will; all shall be well for me.
In ev'ry future scene I'll gladly trusting be.
Straight to my home above I travel calmly on
and sing in life or death: "My Lord, Your will be done!"
And sing in life or death: "My Lord, Your will be done!"

hymns.title: Nearer, my God, to Thee
hymns.source_file: 252 Nearer, my God, to Thee_mason ii lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Nearer, my God, to Thee, nearer to Thee!
E'en though it be a cross that raiseth me.
Still all my song shall be, nearer, my God, to Thee,
nearer, my God, to Thee, nearer to Thee!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Though like the wanderer, the sun gone down,
darkness be over me, my rest a stone;
yet in my dreams I'd be nearer, my God, to Thee,
nearer, my God, to Thee, nearer to Thee!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: There let the way appear, steps unto heav'n;
all that Thou sendest me in mercy giv'n.
Angels to beckon me nearer, my God, to Thee,
nearer, my God, to Thee, nearer to Thee!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Or if, on joyful wing, cleaving the sky,
sun, moon and stars forgot, upwards I fly,
still all my song shall be, nearer, my God, to Thee,
nearer, my God, to Thee, nearer to Thee!

hymns.title: Nearer, my God, to Thee
hymns.source_file: 253 Nearer, my God, to Thee_unknown lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Nearer, my God, to Thee, nearer to Thee!
E'en though it be a cross that raiseth me.
Still all my song shall be, nearer, my God, to Thee,
nearer, my God, to Thee, nearer to Thee!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Though like the wanderer, the sun gone down,
darkness be over me, my rest a stone;
yet in my dreams I'd be nearer, my God, to Thee,
nearer, my God, to Thee, nearer to Thee!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: There let the way appear, steps unto heav'n;
all that Thou sendest me in mercy giv'n.
Angels to beckon me nearer, my God, to Thee,
nearer, my God, to Thee, nearer to Thee!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Or if, on joyful wing, cleaving the sky,
sun, moon and stars forgot, upwards I fly,
still all my song shall be, nearer, my God, to Thee,
nearer, my God, to Thee, nearer to Thee!

hymns.title: No longer my own
hymns.source_file: 254 No longer my own lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: No longer my own, for now I am free!
In Jesus forever, His own, His own I'll be!
He has me created, my time did appoint;
with fire and with Spirit He did me anoint.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: No longer my own, a most blessed choice!
To Jesus I dedicate heart and lips and voice.
I'll speak and be silent upon His request;
in praying and singing is my praise expressed.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: No longer my own, with Thee I abide.
My life and my sunshine, Lord, stay Thou at my side!
As Thine own disciple from evil I flee;
through sadness and gladness, honour bring to Thee!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: No longer my own, Thou art at my side!
Dear Lord, with Thy hand for my ev'ry need provide.
In living and dying I'll strive to be true;
dear Jesus, my whole life long I'll Thee pursue.

hymns.title: O for a heart to praise my God
hymns.source_file: 255 O for a heart to praise my God lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O for a heart to praise my God, a heart from sin set free,
a heart that always feels the blood so freely shed for me.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: A heart resigned, submissive, meek– my great Redeemer's throne–
where only Christ is heard to speak, and where He reigns alone.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: A humble, lowly contrite heart, believing, true, and clean,
which neither life nor death can part from Christ who dwells within.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: A heart in ev'ry thought renewed and full of love divine,
so right and perfect, pure and good, the image, Lord, of Thine.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Thy nature, gracious Lord, impart; come quickly from above;
write Thy new name upon my heart, Thy new blest name of Love.

hymns.title: O Love, that will not let me go
hymns.source_file: 256 O Love, that will not let me go lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O Love, that will not let me go, I rest my weary soul in Thee;
I give Thee back the love I owe, that  in Thine ocean depths its flow may richer, fuller be.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O Light, that follows all my way, I yield my flick'ring torch to Thee;
my heart restores its borrowed ray, that in Thy sunshine's blaze its day may brighter, fairer be.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O Joy, that seekest me through pain, I cannot close my eyes to Thee;
I trace the rainbow through the rain and feel the promise is not vain that morn shall tearless be.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O Cross, that liftest up my head, I dare not ask to fly from Thee;
I lay in dust life's glory dead and from the ground there blooms, instead, life that shall endless be.

hymns.title: Prayer is the soul's sincere desire
hymns.source_file: 257 Prayer is the soul's sincere desire lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Prayer is the soul's sincere desire, in word or unexpressed,
a pure, consuming Godly fire that burns within the breast.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Prayer is for soul the vital breath, for soul its native air,
its watchword at the gates of death, for home it goes with prayer.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Prayer is the contrite sinner's voice, returning from his ways,
while angels in their songs rejoice and cry: "Behold, he prays!"

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: God's own in prayer appear as one, in word and deed and mind,
while with the Father and the Son sweet fellowship they find.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Prayer is not made on earth alone: The Holy Spirit pleads,
and Jesus at His Father's throne for sinners intercedes.

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: O Thou by whom we come to God, the Life, the Truth, the Way,
the path of prayer Thyself has trod: Lord, teach us how to pray!

hymns.title: Precious Lord, take my hand
hymns.source_file: 258 Precious Lord, take my hand lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Precious Lord, take my hand, lead me on, let me stand,
I am tired, I am weak, I am worn;
through the storm, through the night, lead me on to the light:
Take my hand, precious Lord, lead me home.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: When my way grows drear, precious Lord, linger near,
when my life is almost gone;
hear my cry, hear my call, hold my hand lest I fall:
Take my hand, precious Lord, lead me home.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: When the darkness appears and the night draws near,
and the day is past and gone,
at the river I stand, guide my feet, hold my hand:
Take my hand, precious Lord, lead me home.

hymns.title: Saviour, like a shepherd lead us
hymns.source_file: 259 Saviour, like a shepherd lead us lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: attr. Dorothy A Thrupp (1779-1847) Hymns for the Young, 1936

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Saviour, like a shepherd lead us, much we need Thy tender care;
in Thy pleasant pastures feed us, for our use Thy folds prepare:
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus, Thou hast bought us, Thine we are;
blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus, Thou hast bought us, Thine we are.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We are Thine, do Thou befriend us, be the Guardian of our way;
keep Thy flock, from sin defend us, seek us when we go astray:
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus, hear Thy children when they pray;
blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus, hear Thy children when they pray.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Early let us seek Thy favour, early let us do Thy will;
blessed Lord and only Saviour, with Thy love our bosoms fill:
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus, Thou hast loved us, love us still;
blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus, Thou hast loved us, love us still.

hymns.title: See, I spread my arms in yearning
hymns.source_file: 260 See, I spread my arms in yearning lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: See, I spread my arms in yearning, lifting up my eyes to Thee;
would receive Thee, humbly, pleading; come and dwell, O Lord, in me.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Give me food for I am hungry; I am poor, increase my wealth.
Long and hard has been the  journey; give me rest, restore my health.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I can bring Thee no donation– I come naked, poor and ill
to the festive celebration; from Thy strength I take my fill.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Knowing I am not forsaken, I am Thine and Thine alone;
never can Thy word be shaken telling me I am Thine own.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Grant Thy grace in fullest measure and Thy healing pow'r bestow;
fill my heart with precious treasure, set my lowly heart aglow.

hymns.title: Sweet hour of prayer
hymns.source_file: 261 Sweet hour of prayer lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Sweet hour of prayer! Sweet hour of prayer! That calls me from a world of care
and bids me at my Father's throne make all my wants and wishes known.
In seasons of disstress and grief my soul has often found relief
and oft escaped the tempter's snare by thy return, sweet hour of prayer.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Sweet hour of prayer! Sweet hour of prayer! Thy wings shall my petition bear
to Him whose truth and faithfulness engage the waiting soul to bless.
And since He bids me seek His face, believe His word and trust His grace,
I'll cast on Him my ev'ry care and wait for thee, sweet hour of prayer!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Sweet hour of prayer! Sweet hour of prayer! May I thy consolation share,
till from Mount Tabor's lofty height I view my home and take my flight.
This robe of flesh I'll drop and rise to sieze the everlasting prize,
and call when passing thro' the air: "Farewell, farewell, sweet hour of prayer!"

hymns.title: Take Thou my hand and lead me
hymns.source_file: 262 Take Thou my hand and lead me lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Take Thou my hand and lead me, I Thee implore,
until my life is ended and evermore.
Alone I cannot journey, each step needs Thee.
Where Thou would go and journey, there take Thou me!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Let Thy compassion shelter my feeble heart
and make me ever patient in joy or smart!
If faithfully I follow the narrow way,
Thou surely will me strengthen from day to day.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Be Thou my light to guide me in darkest vale,
for Thou alone can banish all my travail!
Thy humble child, O Saviour, with Thee let rest.
My eyes see at their closing whate'er is best.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Though I cannot perceive Thee in all Thy might,
Thou to the goal will lead me, though dark the night.
Take Thou my hand and lead me, I Thee implore,
until my life is ended and evermore!

hymns.title: Teach me the measure of my days
hymns.source_file: 263 Teach me the measure of my days lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Teach me the measure of my days, Thou Maker of my frame;
I would survey life's narrow space and learn how frail I am.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: A span is all that we can boast, an inch or two of time;
man is but vanity and dust in all his flow'r and prime.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O see, how many mortals move like shadows o'er the plain,
they rage and strive, desire and love, but all their noise is vain.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: What should I wish or wait for then from creatures, earth, and dust?
They make our expectations vain, and disappoint our trust.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Now I forbid my carnal hope, my fond desires recall;
I give my mortal interest up and make my God my all.

hymns.title: To pray to God in heaven
hymns.source_file: 264 To pray to God in heaven lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: To pray to God in heaven is wonderful and sweet.
O child, be glad to give Him your heart, your thanks complete.
The words are not spoken according to one's mind,
but thankful hearts betoken a soul to God inclined.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: So, quietly, dear children, devote yourselves to prayer
for God knows how to bless them whose hearts are thus laid bare.
Each word is a treasure that childlike lips present;
on this will rest His pleasure, with this He is content.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: On bended knees, dear children, when young, your hearts prepare.
Let virtue be increased then for this is found through prayer.
God's love will uplift you, new strength through prayer will come.
Let God direct in virtue, your Guide let Him become.

hymns.title: Whate'er my God ordains is right
hymns.source_file: 265 Whate'er my God ordains is right lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Whate'er my God ordains is right, and, in His will abiding,
I will be still, whate'er betide, and go where He is guiding.
My God is He, makes evil flee, from falling He does hold me; I therefore trust Him only.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Whate'er my God ordains is right, He is my whole existence.
He lets no evil me betide; I'll show Him no resistance.
In joy and grief I hold belief 'twill soon be manifested that we in love were tested.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Whate'er my God ordains is right; this is the stand I've taken.
Through sorrow, need and bitter plight I'll never be forsaken.
My Father's care I daily share, His loving arms enfold me; I therefore trust Him only.

hymns.title: Your way, not mine, O Lord
hymns.source_file: 266 Your way, not mine, O Lord lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Your way, not mine, O Lord! Though dark it may be,
O lead me by Your hand, directing me.
Smooth let it be, or rough, still it will be best,
the straight or winding path will lead to Your rest.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I dare not choose my lot if even I might,
but choose for me, my God, I'll walk aright.
Not mine, not mine the choice in great or in small;
God be my Guide, my Strength, my Wisdom, my All.

hymns.title: A sparkling stream
hymns.source_file: 267 A sparkling stream lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: A sparkling stream so pure and clear flows from the throne of grace
and those who plunge within its flood will all their sins efface.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O Word of truth, O holy stream, so wonderful does flow.
O plunge within, you chosen flock, where God His grace does show.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: So fresh and cooling is this stream which sinners does invite.
This holy flood which flows so clear makes sinful hearts pure white.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O Word of truth, O holy stream, so wonderful does flow.
O plunge within, you chosen flock, where God His grace does show.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O stream of life, now flow within and purge our hearts from care.
Then water too our thirsty souls that we much fruit may bear.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O Word of truth, O holy stream, so wonderful does flow.
O plunge within, you chosen flock, where God His grace does show.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O'erflow our hearts, lifegiving stream, our strength is all in you.
Come, weary soul, and quench your thirst, it flows for us anew.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O Word of truth, O holy stream, so wonderful does flow.
O plunge within, you chosen flock, where God His grace does show.

hymns.title: Arise, your light is come
hymns.source_file: 268 Arise, your light is come lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The Spirit's call obey; show forth the glory of your God which shines on you today.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Fling wide the prison door; proclaim the captive's liberty, good tidings to the poor.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: All you in sorrow born, bind up the brokenhearted ones and comfort those who mourn.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: The mountains burst in song!
Rise up like eagles on the wing,
God's pow'r will make us strong.

hymns.title: Behold Me standing at your door
hymns.source_file: 269 Behold Me standing at the door lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Behold Me standing at your door and hear Me pleading ever more
with gentle voice, O heart of sin: "May I come in? May I come in?"

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Behold Me standing at your door, and hear Me pleading ever more.
Say, weary heart, oppressed with sin:
"May I come in? May I come in?"

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I bore the cruel thorns for you and patiently have waited too.
Say, weary heart, oppressed with sin: "May I come in? May I come in?"

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Behold Me standing at your door, and hear Me pleading ever more.
Say, weary heart, oppressed with sin:
"May I come in? May I come in?"

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I would not plead with you in vain; remember all My grief and pain!
I died to ransom you from sin: "May I come in? May I come in?"

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Behold Me standing at your door, and hear Me pleading ever more.
Say, weary heart, oppressed with sin:
"May I come in? May I come in?"

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I bring you joy from heav'n above; I bring you pardon, peace and love.
Say, weary heart, oppressed with sin: "May I come in? May I come in?"

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Behold Me standing at your door, and hear Me pleading ever more.
Say, weary heart, oppressed with sin:
"May I come in? May I come in?"

hymns.title: Bethesda is open
hymns.source_file: 270 Bethesda is open lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The pool of Bethesda is open anew, not only for one, but for all.
The merit of Jesus is valid for you and all who are heeding His call.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Bethesda is open, salvation is free! A fount of redemption and love!
Come, enter its waters; Oh, hasten and see what's granted to you from above!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: God's blessings He gives through the waters of grace and cleanses the soul from all sin.
He sent His apostles whose footsteps we trace; He strengthens our soul's life within.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Bethesda is open, salvation is free! A fount of redemption and love!
Come, enter its waters; Oh, hasten and see what's granted to you from above!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: That pool of Bethesda is open today to all who God's mercy implore.
For Jesus invites you, no longer delay, your soul to new life now restore.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Bethesda is open, salvation is free! A fount of redemption and love!
Come, enter its waters; Oh, hasten and see what's granted to you from above!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Make use of each moment and, trusting, believe what Jesus, the Saviour has taught:
Salvation you only through Him will receive, which He through His death for us wrought.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Bethesda is open, salvation is free! A fount of redemption and love!
Come, enter its waters; Oh, hasten and see what's granted to you from above!

hymns.title: Break Thou the bread of life
hymns.source_file: 271 Break Thou the bread of life lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Break Thou the bread of life, dear Lord, to me, as Thou didst break the loaves beside the sea.
Beyond the sacred page I seek Thee,
Lord; my spirit pants for Thee,
O living Word.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Break Thou the bread of life,
O Lord, to me, that hid within my heart Thy word may be.
Mould Thou each inward thought, from self set free, and let my steps be all controlled by Thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Open Thy word of truth that I may see Thy message written clear and plain for me.
Then in sweet fellowship, walking with Thee,
Thine image on my life engraved will be.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O send Thy Spirit,
Lord, now unto me, that He may touch my eyes and make me see.
Show me the truth concealed within Thy word, and in Thy Book revealed I see the Lord.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Bless Thou the truth, dear Lord, living in me, as Thou didst bless the bread by Galilee; then shall all bondage cease, all fetters fall, and I shall find my peace, my All in All.

hymns.title: Christ, whose glory fills the skies
hymns.source_file: 272 Christ, whose glory fills the skies lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Christ, whose glory fills the skies, Christ, the true, the only Light,
Sun of Righteousness, arise; triumph o'er the shades of night.
Dayspring from on high, be near, Daystar, in my heart appear.
Christ, whose glory fills the skies, Christ the true, the only Light.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Dark and cheerless is the morn unaccompanied by Thee,
joyless is the day's return till Thy mercy's beams I see;
till they inward light impart, glad my eyes and warm my heart.
Christ, whose glory fills the skies, Christ the true, the only Light.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Visit then this soul of mine; pierce the gloom of sin and grief, fill me,
Radiancy divine, scatter all my unbelief.
More and more Thyself display, shining to the perfect day.
Christ, whose glory fills the skies, Christ the true, the only Light.

hymns.title: Come in, O Lord, come in!
hymns.source_file: 273 Come in, O Lord, come in! lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come in, O Lord, come in! Wait not outside the door.
My heart into Your dwelling make, abide there evermore.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Come in, O Lord, come in! Your radiant truth let shine
and with Your glowing countenance, light up this heart of mine.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Come in, O Lord, come in! Oft have You knocked before.
No more will I indifferent be when You do me implore.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Come in and here abide, O Lord and honoured Guest,
and hold communion now with me and give me promised rest.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Come in, O Lord, come in! The dwelling's set aright.
I wait upon those gifts of Yours; give me the raiment white.

hymns.title: Come near, you are invited
hymns.source_file: 274 Come near, you are invited lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come near, you are invited; the Saviour's call resounds.
By grace you are invited where wealth of love abounds!
Who earth and heav'n has made, a feast has been preparing
for all there to be sharing who had His call obeyed.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Then come, dear soul, exulting; with joy receive your Lord!
For sin, in grief resulting, His grace God does accord.
O Fount of Life and Love, the blessed heav'nly manna
in such mysterious manner is granted from above!

hymns.title: Come to the life-giving fountain
hymns.source_file: 275 Come to the life-giving fountain lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come to the life-giving fountain, thirsty and burdened with grief.
Come, for it will not be fruitless; peace you will find, and relief.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Haste then today.
Why longer stay?
Heavenly gain you may lose by delay.
Here is the life-giving fountain; here is the heavenly way!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Come to the fount for refreshment; come and in faith plunge within.
Bury your sins in its waters; freedom and blessedness win.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Haste then today.
Why longer stay?
Heavenly gain you may lose by delay.
Here is the life-giving fountain; here is the heavenly way!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Come to the fountain of healing; health here receive for your soul.
See how it bubbles and sparkles; drink and forever be whole.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Haste then today.
Why longer stay?
Heavenly gain you may lose by delay.
Here is the life-giving fountain; here is the heavenly way!

hymns.title: Come to the Saviour
hymns.source_file: 276 Come to the Saviour lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come to the Saviour, come yet today; O heed His word and come while you may.
He is so near to bless you today, calling so friendly, "Come!"

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Joyful, joyful will the meeting be; when, from sin forever pure and free,
there we shall enter Canaan to see. Come now, you chosen, come!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: "Come, all my children," calls now His voice. Give Him your heart, in Him to rejoice.
He is a safe and heavenly choice; therefore take heed and come!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Joyful, joyful will the meeting be; when, from sin forever pure and free,
there we shall enter Canaan to see. Come now, you chosen, come!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Firmly believe He hears when you pray. O, can you feel His presence today?
He will with love and grace you repay. Come then, O sinner come!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Joyful, joyful will the meeting be; when, from sin forever pure and free,
there we shall enter Canaan to see. Come now, you chosen, come!

hymns.title: Come, for the feast is spread
hymns.source_file: 277 Come, for the feast is spread lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, for the feast is spread; hark to the call!
Come for the living bread broken for all.
Come and partake of wine, here on His breast recline.
All that He has is thine; come, sinner, come.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Come where the fountain flows, river of life.
Healing is here for woes, doubting and strife.
Countless have been supplied, noone was e'er denied.

hymns.title: For you I am praying

sections.label: Refrain
lines: For you I am praying, for you I am praying,
for you I am praying, I'm praying for you.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: For you I am praying, for you I am praying,

hymns.title: Fresh from the throne of glory

holy river, let me ever drink of only thee.

hymns.title: Glorious, glorious is the Work of God
hymns.source_file: 280 Glorious, glorious is the Work of God lyrics.txt

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O this is wonderful, glorious, Jesus makes sinners believe.

hymns.title: God is offering through the Saviour
hymns.source_file: 281 God is offering through the Saviour lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God is off'ring through the Saviour full redemption by His grace.

sections.label: Verse 2

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Thousand times I've felt the guidance of His gracious, Godly hand

hymns.title: Hark! Jesus calls
hymns.source_file: 282 Hark Jesus calls lyrics.txt

we'll sing aloud: "Victoria, the Lamb, Hallelujah!"

hymns.title: Hark! the gospel bells are ringing
hymns.source_file: 283 Hark the gospel bells are ringing lyrics.txt

lines: Hark! the gospel bells are ringing over land, from sea to sea.

Whosoe'er believeth in Him, everlasting life shall have.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Gospel bells, how they ring over land, from sea to sea!
Gospel bells, freely bring blessed news to you and me!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Hark! the gospel bells invite us, to the marriage feast they call.
There is help for ev'ry suff'ring, room for sinners one and all.
Jesus, Bread for all the living; eat of Him, thou hungry soul.
Come, thy faith shall not be futile: they that have Christ are made whole.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Gospel bells, how they ring over land, from sea to sea!
Gospel bells, freely bring blessed news to you and me!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Let my heart be like the gospel, always filled with truth divine,
so if Satan should allure me, stirring too, my heartstrings fine.
Frightened, he must flee in terror from its pure, clear ringing sound
which is filled with life and Spirit, with the strength in Jesus found.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Gospel bells, how they ring over land, from sea to sea!
Gospel bells, freely bring blessed news to you and me!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Hark! the gospel bells sound joyful. Soon we'll sing the glad new song.
Child of God, come with rejoicing, join the great and blessed throng.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Gospel bells, how they ring over land, from sea to sea!

hymns.title: Hark! Who's knocking

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Hark!
Who's knocking o'er and o'er?

Ah, my heart, no longer waver, let Him in and Him adore!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Hark!
He's knocking, hear His plea;
He would enter, sup with me.
May my heart to Him be open ev'ry time I hear His call.
Words of promise He has spoken to the faithful, one and all!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Hark!
He's knocking, kind and true, and He counsels me anew that this promise which was given to the souls that overcome is that they may once in heaven see the Father and His Son!

hymns.title: Have you any room for Jesus?
hymns.source_file: 285 Have you any room for Jesus lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Have you any room for Jesus, He who bore your load of sin,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Room for Jesus, King of glory!
Hasten now, His word obey!
Swing the heart's door widely open!
Bid Him enter while you may.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Room for pleasure, room for bus'ness, but for Christ, the Crucified,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Room for Jesus, King of glory!
Hasten now, His word obey!
Swing the heart's door widely open!
Bid Him enter while you may.

sections.label: Verse 3

sections.label: Refrain

sections.label: Refrain

hymns.title: Hearken! A narrow way
hymns.source_file: 286 Hearken! A narrow way lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Hearken!
A narrow way:
Jesus the way!
Only one open door:
Jesus the door!
Only one Shep herd kind seeks all the lost to find and but one bleeding Lamb died for the world.
Only one narrow way: "I am the way!" Only one open door: "I am the door!"

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Only one sacred fold, one as of old when those who first believed,
God's gift received.
Only one gentle hand leads on the faithful band safely through joy and pain to heav'nly home.
Only one narrow way:
Jesus the way!
Only one open door:
Jesus the door!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: For you His blood was shed, for you He bled; for you the greatest Friend His life did spend.
To find that way to life for which so few here strive, though often steep and hard, worthwhile it is.
That is the bridge restored, leads to the Lord.
Here through apostolate enter that gate!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: You ask:
Where is that way, the door today?
That Lamb who shed His blood, that gracefilled flood?

There– through apostles' heard:
God's holy word; there one may find release, yes, glorious peace.

hymns.title: I know of a city

Lord

hymns.title: Let in your Saviour

lines: See, who's standing at your door! How often has He there knocked before?

So much love He has in store, will you open for Him the door?
Let in your Saviour, He's knocking at your door, waiting for sure.

lines: Open now to Him your heart or else He in grief would then depart.

lines: "Come, dear children, come to Me. Come, one and all to Me, to Me.

sections.label: Refrain

hymns.title: Let there be light

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thou who didst come to bring on Thy redeeming wing, healing and sight, health to the sick in mind, sight to the inly blind;

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Spirit of truth and love, lifegiving,

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Holy and blessed Three, glorious Trinity, wisdom, love, might; boundless as ocean's tide rolling in fullest pride, through the world far and wide:

hymns.title: Love divine, all loves excelling

lines: Love divine, all loves excelling, Joy of heav'n, to earth come down;

visit us with Thy salvation; enter ev'ry longing heart.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Breathe, O breathe Thy loving Spirit into ev'ry troubled breast!

end of faith, as its beginning, set our hearts at liberty.

lines: Come, Almighty to deliver, let us all Thy light receive;

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Finish, then, Thy new creation; pure and spotless let us be.

hymns.title: O come now to Jesus

lines: Jesus has mercy for you; Jesus has mercy for you.

lines: O flee now to Jesus, the Saviour divine, or sin will your spirit subdue;

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Jesus has mercy for you; Jesus has mercy for you.

hymns.title: O come with me
hymns.source_file: 296 O come with me lyrics.txt

lines: O come with me and I will lead you gently into a garden of enchanting charm.

lines: O come!

hymns.title: O where is Jesus?

hymns.title: Of compassion and salvation

lines: Thus the secret is compassion which to fallen man is shown, love divine in perfect fashion which the poor can claim their own.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Teaching with the Lord's commission, preaching peace and rest today, brings the news of full remission to the souls that went astray.

hymns.title: Open now your gates of beauty

lines: Lord, my faith increase and quicken, let me keep Your gift divine.

lines: Come home, come home, all who are weary, come home.
