Shadows are gathering, night-time is coming, coming for you and for me.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Come home, come home, all who are weary, come home.
Earnestly, tenderly, Jesus is calling, calling, O sinner, come home!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Oh! for the wonderful love He has promised, promised to you and to me.
Though we have sinned He has mercy and pardon, pardon for you and for me.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Come home, come home, all who are weary, come home.
Earnestly, tenderly, Jesus is calling, calling, O sinner, come home!

hymns.title: See, who's standing at your door
hymns.source_file: 301 See, who's standing at your door lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: See, who's standing at your door! Let Him in! (Let the Saviour in!)
Often has He knocked before; let Him in! (Let the Saviour in!)
Tarry not till He is gone; let Him in, the Holy One;
'tis your King, the Father's Son; let Him in! (Let the Saviour in!)

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Open now to Him your heart. Let Him in! (Let the Saviour in!)
Or in grief He must depart; let Him in! (Let the Saviour in!)
Let Him in, He is your Friend; He is faithful to the end;
gladly will your way attend; let Him in! (Let the Saviour in!)

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Do you hear His loving voice? Let Him in! (Let the Saviour in!)
To be His, now make your choice; let Him in! (Let the Saviour in!)
He is pleading at the door; He has joy for you in store;
you will thank Him evermore; let Him in! (Let the Saviour in!)

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Do not shun the heav'nly Guest. Let Him in! (Let the Saviour in!)
For with Him is peace and rest; let Him in! (Let the Saviour in!)
He who has your sins forgiv'n, through whom earthly ties are riv'n;
He will take you home to heav'n; let Him in! (Let the Saviour in!)

hymns.title: Shine, Jesus, shine
hymns.source_file: 302 Shine, Jesus, shine lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord, the light of Your love is shining, in the midst of the darkness, shining;
Jesus, light of the world, shine upon us, set us free by the truth You now bring us.
Shine on me, shine on me:

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Shine, Jesus, shine, fill this land with the Father's glory;
blaze, Spirit, blaze, set our hearts on fire.
Flow, river, flow, flood the nations with love and mercy;
send forth Your word, Lord, and let there be light!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Lord, I come to Your awesome presence, from the shadows into Your radiance;
by the blood I may enter Your brightness; search me, try me, consume all my darkness:
Shine on me, shine on me:

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Shine, Jesus, shine, fill this land with the Father's glory;
blaze, Spirit, blaze, set our hearts on fire.
Flow, river, flow, flood the nations with love and mercy;
send forth Your word, Lord, and let there be light!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: As we gaze on Your kingly brightness, so our faces display Your likeness,
ever changing from glory to glory; mirrored here, may our lives tell Your story:
Shine on me, shine on me:

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Shine, Jesus, shine, fill this land with the Father's glory;
blaze, Spirit, blaze, set our hearts on fire.
Flow, river, flow, flood the nations with love and mercy;
send forth Your word, Lord, and let there be light!

hymns.title: There is a call most precious
hymns.source_file: 303 There is a call most precious lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There is a call most precious, so fervent and so great.
It draws us ever nearer to meet a blessed fate.
It echoes rich with promise and gives us blessed rest.
When Jesus calls, we hasten to lean upon His breast.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: "Come, come unto Me, O come, come unto Me,
though weary, heavy laden, come, come, O come to me!
Come, come unto Me, O come, come unto Me
where rest to you is given; O come, come unto Me!"

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The words which He is voicing are sure to make us free.
What He to us is giving shall ours forever be.
His word, like thunder rolling, awakes our soul within,
sheds light upon our pathway and takes away our sin.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: "Come, come unto Me, O come, come unto Me,
though weary, heavy laden, come, come, O come to me!
Come, come unto Me, O come, come unto Me
where rest to you is given; O come, come unto Me!"

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Who would not come to Jesus, to such a loving Friend,
and be with Him united who's faithful to the end?
Though we're so weak and sinful and weary in our souls,
yet we can come to Jesus and He will make us whole.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: "Come, come unto Me, O come, come unto Me,
though weary, heavy laden, come, come, O come to me!
Come, come unto Me, O come, come unto Me
where rest to you is given; O come, come unto Me!"

hymns.title: There is still room
hymns.source_file: 304 There is still room lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There is still room in Thy great mercy, Lord, for my fearful, saddened heart.
Make Thou my soul from ev'ry curse free and heav'nly peace to me impart.
My Saviour, take me unto Thee where I forever safe shall be, where I forever safe shall be.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: There is still room, Lord, in Thy pasture, where I, a sinner, may abide.
Thy will it is that none be lost here, therefore with Thee my rest I'll find.
My Saviour and my soul's true Friend is faithful, gracious to the end, is faithful, gracious to the end.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: There is still room; Thou grace art giving, for me a table is prepared.
Freedom from sin I am receiving, mercy and love to me declared.
I hear Thy call: "Come unto Me." I come, dear Lord, I come to Thee! I come, dear Lord, I come to Thee!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: There is still room– Thy arms, embracing, stretch out in love to me each day;
so am I, Thy compassion facing, sheltered upon my homeward way.
I grasp in faith the Father's hand which leads me to the promised land, which leads me to the promised land.

hymns.title: There's a place
hymns.source_file: 305 There's a place lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There's a place the Father wants to give you, in dimensions man has never seen.
It's a place of glorious in spiration from God and all around is peace.
If only you would yield to God's intention, from all your burdens there you'd be released;
for in the Father's heart there is an answer to your troubles: Hear Him, you'll find eternal peace,
O hear Him, you'll find eternal peace.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: There's a place the Father wants to give you, there's a place no one has ever been.
It's a place beyond imagination, of beauty none has ever seen.
If only you would yield to God's intention, all pain and suff'ring there will disappear,
for with the Father you will find eternal joy and comfort: Hear Him, for glory now is near,
O hear Him, for glory now is near.

hymns.title: Thou didst leave Thy throne
hymns.source_file: 306 Thou didst leave Thy throne lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Thou didst leave Thy throne and Thy kingly crown when Thou camest to earth for me;
but in Bethlehem's home was there found no room for Thy holy nativity.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O come to my heart, Lord Jesus–
there is room in my heart for Thee!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Heaven's arches rang when the angels sang, proclaiming Thy royal degree;
but of lowly birth didst Thou come to earth, and in great humility.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: (Verse 1)

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Thou camest, Lord, with the living word that should set Thy people free,
but with mocking scorn and with crown of thorn they bore Thee to Calvary.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: (Verse 1)

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: When the heav'ns shall ring and the angels sing at Thy coming in victory,
let Thy voice call me home, saying, "Yet there is room, there is room at My side for thee."

sections.label: Refrain
lines: My heart shall rejoice, Lord Jesus,
when Thou comest to call for me!

hymns.title: Welcome to the Fount of Mercy
hymns.source_file: 307 Welcome to the Fount of mercy lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Welcome to the Fount of Mercy, Saviour, Thou the Spring of Life!
Light upon the pilgrim's pathway, humble sinner's Help in strife!
Thou the will of Thy dear Father unto us here didst make known.
Bind our hearts by grace together and refresh us at Thy throne.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Light that in the world is beaming from the Father, Word of Old,
that once earthly form had taken, while Thy love no bounds could hold.
Peer within our heart's dark corners, let Thy Spirit pierce our soul,
that we from vain pride, O Saviour, may be freed and thus made whole.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Jesus, Prince of Peace, invited hast Thou us to Zion's height;
makest known to us God's graces; Thee we hail, the King of Light!
Let Thy peace anew be granted, for salvation is Thine own.
Be to us a Staff of comfort, through the gospel to us shown.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O Thou good and faithful Shepherd, to whom all Thy sheep are known,
and who truly seeks the lost ones with a love before unknown.
Thou dost lead us in green pastures, by the living waters still;
heal our wounds and give in suff'ring peace and comfort to our fill.

hymns.title: Whosoever heareth
hymns.source_file: 308 Whosoever heareth lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: "Whosoever heareth," rings far and wide. "To the living fountain, come," say Groom and Bride.
They no more are thirsty who in Christ confide. Whosoever will, may come.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Hungry, thirsty, come! Hear the Saviour's plea.
Jesus through apostles calleth: "Come to Me."
Yet the door is open, grace and mercy's free, whosoever will, may come.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: "Whosoever heareth," hark, 'tis His word. Blessed he that keepeth all that he hath heard.
All who seek salvation are to grace referred. Whosoever will, may come.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Hungry, thirsty, come! Hear the Saviour's plea.
Jesus through apostles calleth: "Come to Me."
Yet the door is open, grace and mercy's free, whosoever will, may come.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: "Whosoever heareth," do not delay. Come now to repentance, there's still grace today.
Jesus' word is living, hear it while you may. Whosoever will, may come.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Hungry, thirsty, come! Hear the Saviour's plea.
Jesus through apostles calleth: "Come to Me."
Yet the door is open, grace and mercy's free, whosoever will, may come.

hymns.title: Why wait ye still outside the portals?
hymns.source_file: 309 Why wait ye still outside the portals lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Why wait ye still outside the portals? O hasten, come hasten within!
Partake of the blessed enjoyment that Jesus would give you within.
Without it is dark and so dreary. You'll find no refreshment when sad.
All care cast aside, come and hasten, without there is naught to make glad.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Why wait ye still outside the portals? Come, hasten within!
Partake of the blessed enjoyment that Jesus would give you within.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: No longer in darkness now linger. O hasten, and tarry no more.
Forsake your own will now and follow; come, soul, I sincerely implore.
Outside there, no peace you will beckon, which Jesus so willingly gives.
Outside are destruction and mis'ry; O come, the Lord Jesus still lives.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Why wait ye still outside the portals? Come, hasten within!
Partake of the blessed enjoyment that Jesus would give you within.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The portals for all are now open, you're bidden, come enter within;
for they who apostles' word keepeth shall peace for their souls thereby win.
Without, there is fellowship wanting, but Jesus so wants to forgive.
O flee from the world of destruction, in heavenly realms come and live.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Why wait ye still outside the portals? Come, hasten within!
Partake of the blessed enjoyment that Jesus would give you within.

hymns.title: Wonderful words of life
hymns.source_file: 310 Wonderful words of life lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Sing them over again to me, wonderful words of life!
Let me more of their beauty see, wonderful words of life!
Words of life and beauty teach me faith and duty.
Beautiful words, wonderful words, wonderful words of  life!
Beautiful words, wonderful words, wonderful words of  life!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Christ, the blessed One, gives to all wonderful words of life!
Sinner, list to the loving call, wonderful words of life!
All so freely given, wooing us to heaven.
Beautiful words, wonderful words, wonderful words of  life!
Beautiful words, wonderful words, wonderful words of  life!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Sweetly echoes the gospel call, wonderful words of life!
Offers pardon and peace to all, wonderful words of life!
Jesus, only Saviour, sanctifies forever.
Beautiful words, wonderful words, wonderful words of  life!
Beautiful words, wonderful words, wonderful words of  life!

hymns.title: Amazing grace
hymns.source_file: 311 Amazing grace lyrics.txt

metadata.composer: American folk melody harm. John Rodriques (b. 1979)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Amazing grace! how sweet the sound, that saved a wretch like me!
I once was lost, but now am found, was blind but now I see.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: 'Twas grace that taught my heart to fear, and grace my fears relieved.
How precious did that grace appear the hour I first believed.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Through many dangers, toils, and snares I have already come.
'Tis grace has brought me safe thus far, and grace will lead me home.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Yes, when this flesh and heart shall fail, and mortal life shall cease,
I shall possess, within the veil, a life of joy and peace.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: The earth shall soon dissolve like snow, the sun forbear to shine;
but God, who called me here below, will be forever mine.

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: When we've been there ten thousand years, bright shining as the sun,
we've no less days to sing God's praise than when we'd first begun.

hymns.title: Come, Thou fount of every blessing
hymns.source_file: 312 Come, Thou fount of every blessing lyrics.txt

metadata.composer: John Wyeth's Repository of Sacred Music, 1813

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, Thou fount of ev'ry blessing, tune my heart to sing Thy grace.
Streams of mercy, never ceasing, call for songs of loudest praise.
Teach me some melodious measure sung by flaming tongues above;
praise His name– I'm fixed upon it– name of God's redeeming love.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Here I raise to Thee an altar, hither by Thy help I've come;
and I hope, by Thy good pleasure, to arrive there safely, home.
Jesus sought me when a stranger, wand'ring from the fold of God;
He, to rescue me from danger, bought me with His precious blood.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O to grace how great a debtor daily I'm constrained to be!
Let Thy goodness, like a fetter, bind my wand'ring heart to Thee.
Prone to wander, Lord, I feel it, prone to leave the God I love;
here's my heart, O take and seal it; seal it for Thy courts above.

hymns.title: Endless compassion
hymns.source_file: 313 Endless compassion lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Endless compassion, O wondrous love!
Endless compassion, from heav'n above.
All sinners who confide in Christ with Him abide
and heart and soul decide, to Christ resign.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Heavenly freedom, precious release!
Heavenly freedom, how good it is!
Ever released to be, from sin and pain made free,
with God fore'er to be; O, that is bliss!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Now I am Yours, Lord, all of my days;
and henceforth living unto Your praise.
Hardships shall come my way, yet You'll remain my stay.
Lord, from Your way, I'm sure, I'll never stray.

hymns.title: Forgive our sins as we forgive
hymns.source_file: 314 Forgive our sins as we forgive lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: “Forgive our sins as we forgive,” You taught us, Lord, to pray
but You alone can grant us grace to live the words we say.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: How can Your pardon reach and bless the unforgiving heart
that broods on wrongs and will not let old bitterness depart?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: In blazing light Your cross reveals the truth we dimly knew:
what trivial debts are owed to us, how great our debt to You!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Lord, cleanse the depths within our souls and bid resentment cease;
then, bound to all in bonds of love, our lives will spread Your peace.

hymns.title: Fountain of purity
hymns.source_file: 315 Fountain of purity lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Fountain of purity, fount of all grace, only redemption from sin and disgrace.
Jesus, Redeemer from mis'ry and woe, wash me and make me as white as the snow!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: White as the snow, white as the snow;
wash me, Redeemer, and I shall be white as the snow.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Though I endeavoured, I never was free; pure can a sinner by grace only be.
Free are the waters which from this fount flow; wash me, O Jesus, as white as the snow!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: White as the snow, white as the snow;
wash me, Redeemer, and I shall be white as the snow.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Streams of pure water, the fountain Thou art, cleanse me and purify, peace bring my heart.
All, Lord, art Thou, so I pray in my woe: "Wash me and make me as white as the snow!"

sections.label: Refrain
lines: White as the snow, white as the snow;
wash me, Redeemer, and I shall be white as the snow.

hymns.title: Here is Jesus, here is mercy
hymns.source_file: 316 Here is Jesus, here is mercy lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Here is Jesus, here is mercy, hasten to the living stream!
He will rescue, save from mis'ry; come, He will your soul redeem.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: The fountain of mercy is flowing, though red as blood sins may be.
Here Christ His love is bestowing; great is His pardon for me.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Here is Jesus, freedom granting, blest release from Satan's snare.
Jesus is new hope implanting; go to Him when in despair.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: The fountain of mercy is flowing, though red as blood sins may be.
Here Christ His love is bestowing; great is His pardon for me.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Here is Jesus, here is virtue, far from Satan's evil pow'r.
Jesus Christ will not desert you, He is with you ev'ry hour.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: The fountain of mercy is flowing, though red as blood sins may be.
Here Christ His love is bestowing; great is His pardon for me.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Here is Jesus, Christ our Saviour; peace and rest grants you today.
His redeeming love and favour washes sin and guilt away.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: The fountain of mercy is flowing, though red as blood sins may be.
Here Christ His love is bestowing; great is His pardon for me.

hymns.title: How often do I wonder
hymns.source_file: 317 How often do I wonder lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: How often do I wonder that Christ could love me so,
but never can I answer why He such love should show.
It passes understanding, outreaching human thought,
that He, the Lord of glory my soul with blood has bought.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Most wondrous love and mercy that Christ from heaven came;
that He, for man's redemption, would suffer death and shame,
that Christ so loved transgressors and shed His precious blood,
that He would die for sinners among whom once I stood.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I never will forget Him, the cross of Calvary.
Forever will I love Him who gave His life for me.
O help me, blessed Saviour, to keep Your cross in view,
within Your love e'er hide me and thus my love renew.

hymns.title: I hear Thy welcome voice
hymns.source_file: 318 I hear Thy welcome voice lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I hear Thy welcome voice that calls me, Lord, to Thee
for cleansing in Thy precious blood that flowed on Calvary.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I am coming Lord! Coming now to Thee!
Wash me, cleanse me in Thy blood that flowed on Calvary.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Though coming weak with sin, Thou dost my strength assure;
my vileness Thou dost fully cleanse till spotless all and pure.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I am coming Lord! Coming now to Thee!
Wash me, cleanse me in Thy blood that flowed on Calvary.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: 'Tis Jesus calls me on to perfect faith and love,
to perfect hope and peace and trust, for earth and heav'n above.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I am coming Lord! Coming now to Thee!
Wash me, cleanse me in Thy blood that flowed on Calvary.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: 'Tis Jesus who confirms the blessed work within,
by adding grace to welcomed grace, where reigned the pow'r of sin.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I am coming Lord! Coming now to Thee!
Wash me, cleanse me in Thy blood that flowed on Calvary.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: And He the witness gives to loyal hearts and free,
that ev'ry promise is fulfilled if faith but brings the plea.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I am coming Lord! Coming now to Thee!
Wash me, cleanse me in Thy blood that flowed on Calvary.

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: All hail, atoning blood! All hail, redeeming grace!
All hail, the gift of Christ our Lord, our Strength and Righteousness.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I am coming Lord! Coming now to Thee!
Wash me, cleanse me in Thy blood that flowed on Calvary.

hymns.title: I know of something precious
hymns.source_file: 319 I know of something precious lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I know of something precious which brings me joy untold,
and in my heart it ever the foremost place will hold.
It makes me ever happy, relieves my ev'ry smart:
It's You, O loving fountain, my faithful Saviour's heart,
it's You, O loving fountain, my faithful Saviour's heart.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The joys of life, the sweetest, my heart has found alone
where God has consecrated a true and godly throne.
It's You, O loving fountain, that ever wins my heart,
O stream of life, the purest, my faithful Saviour's heart,
O stream of life, the purest, my faithful Saviour's heart.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: My Jesus, by His mercy, salvation brought to me
and by His many graces He made me glad and free.
Of love His works are only, a comfort to my heart:
In You, O purest fountain, there beats a loving heart,
in You, O purest fountain, there beats a loving heart.

hymns.title: I live by grace and kindness
hymns.source_file: 320 I live by grace and kindness lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I live by grace and kindness, Lord. It is my soul's subsistence.
For sin does naught but death afford; now saved by Your assistance.
What joy and comfort, what accord, to live by Your great kindness, Lord.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: How great Your grace and kindness, Lord, through Jesus' selfless earnings.
His mercy brought me in accord and stilled my deepest yearnings.
Your Son, Christ Jesus, is adored; this is Your grace and kindness, Lord.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I praise Your grace and kindness, Lord: It guides my soul to heaven.
Repentance brings a great reward– then sins can be forgiven.
Should I give all I can afford, I still will live by grace, dear Lord!

hymns.title: I stood at mercy's gate
hymns.source_file: 321 I stood at mercy's gate lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I stood at mercy's gate, a lost and wand'ring child;
a fear oppressed my heart: Would I find mercy mild?
A fear disturbed my soul that I may be too late,
may never reach my goal; I prayed outside the gate, I prayed outside the gate.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: For mercy loud I cried: "O free me, Lord, from sin!"
I did not hope in vain, for Jesus let me in
and washed away my guilt. He drew me to His breast;
my heart with joy He filled and gave me peace and rest, and gave me peace and rest.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I know my loving Lord who longed my soul to win;
He sought me near and far, in love died for my sin.
I in His bosom rest, free from the pain of sin.
My lot is not without, no, Jesus let me in, no, Jesus let me in.

hymns.title: I want a principle within
hymns.source_file: 322 I want a principle within lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I want a principle within of watchful, Godly fear,
a sensibility of sin, a pain to feel it near.
I want to feel the first approach of pride or wrong desire,
to catch the wand'ring of my will and quench the kindling fire.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: From Thee that I no more may stray, no more Thy goodness grieve,
grant me the filial awe, I pray, the tender conscience give.
Quick as the twinkling of an eye, O God, my conscience make;
awake my soul when sin is nigh and keep it thus awake.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Almighty God of truth and love, to me Thy pow'r impart;
the mountain from my soul remove, the hardness from my heart.
O may the least omission pain my reawakened soul
and drive me to that grace again, which makes the wounded whole.

hymns.title: In Jesus I have found salvation
hymns.source_file: 323 In Jesus I have found salvation lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: In Jesus I have found salvation, a pure and wondrous, heav'nly joy.
His love and grace have been unbounding, the bonds of Satan to destroy.
Salvation divine in Christ is mine; the love of my Lord, my blessed reward.
Salvation divine in Christ is mine; the love of my Lord, my blessed reward.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Upon life's journey, striving homeward, with Jesus going on before,
my heart shall praise His grace and mercy, His goodness worship and adore.
Salvation divine in Christ is mine; the love of my Lord, my blessed reward.
Salvation divine in Christ is mine; the love of my Lord, my blessed reward.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O that is blessed, joyous living when wholly pure and free from sin,
by Jesus' gracious, full atonement, I heav'nly, blessed peace will win.
Salvation divine in Christ is mine; the love of my Lord, my blessed reward.
Salvation divine in Christ is mine; the love of my Lord, my blessed reward.

hymns.title: In Your grace
hymns.source_file: 324 In Your grace lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: In Your grace, Lord, let me ever dwell, Your blessing ever grant me from above.
A longing does my prayer compel: I need Your guidance, strength and love.
You have mercy and compassion, and with patience would me fashion.
In Your care and keeping all is well; preserve me there and in Your grace,
O Father, let me dwell!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: In Your grace, Lord, let me now remain and teach me here to understand Your will;
to walk Your ways in joy and pain, to know Your plan You would fulfil.
Gladly heart and soul I'm giving and for You I shall be living.
Of Your love and mercy I will tell; proclaim to all that in Your grace,
O Father, I may dwell!

hymns.title: I've found a place I love so well
hymns.source_file: 325 I've found a place I love so well lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I've found a place I love so well where cares no more around me dwell.

lines: O throne of grace that beams with light, exalted throne of grace!

hymns.title: I've found the spring of blessing

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Upon my Immanuel's bosom, I've found precious rest for my soul.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Upon my Immanuel's bosom, I've found precious rest for my soul.

sections.label: Refrain

hymns.title: Jesus paid it all

hymns.title: Jesus sinners does receive
hymns.source_file: 328 Jesus sinners does receive lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus sinners does receive; let the lost and straying hear it,
though in sin and shame they grieve and Jehovah's anger merit.
This does then their woe relieve; Jesus sinners does receive.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: As the shepherd seeks to find ev'ry sheep when lost and straying,
Christ so loves here all mankind, is for its salvation praying.
He would have each wand'rer live: Jesus sinners does receive.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Come then, all by guilt oppressed, Jesus calls, His own to make you.
He would make you pure and blest, and to glory He would take you.
Think of this and do believe: Jesus sinners does receive.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Jesus sinners does receive; me, too, has in love accepted.
I in childlike trust believe that no child will be excepted.
When He comes, this earth we'll leave; Jesus sinners does receive.

hymns.title: Jesus, what a Friend for sinners
hymns.source_file: 329 Jesus, what a Friend for sinners lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus, what a Friend for sinners! Jesus, Lover of my soul.
Friends may fail me, foes assail me, He, my Saviour, makes me whole.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Hallelujah! What a Saviour! Hallelujah! What a Friend!
Saviour, helping, keeping, loving,
He'll be with me to the end.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Jesus, what a Strength in weakness! Let me hide myself in Him;
tempted, tried and sometimes failing– He, my Strength, my vict'ry wins.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Hallelujah! What a Saviour! Hallelujah! What a Friend!
Saviour, helping, keeping, loving,
He'll be with me to the end.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Jesus, what a Help in sorrow! While the billows o'er me roll,
even when my heart is breaking, He, my Comfort, helps my soul.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Hallelujah! What a Saviour! Hallelujah! What a Friend!
Saviour, helping, keeping, loving,
He'll be with me to the end.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Jesus, what a Guide and Keeper! While the tempest still is high,
storms about me, night o'ertakes me, He, my Pilot, hears my cry.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Hallelujah! What a Saviour! Hallelujah! What a Friend!
Saviour, helping, keeping, loving,
He'll be with me to the end.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Jesus, I do now receive Him; more than all in Him I find.
He does grant to me forgiveness; I am His, and He is mine.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Hallelujah! What a Saviour! Hallelujah! What a Friend!
Saviour, helping, keeping, loving,
He'll be with me to the end.

hymns.title: Just as I am

and that Thou bidst me come to Thee,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

sections.label: Verse 2

to Thee whose blood does cleanse each spot,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Just as I am, though tossed about by many conflicts, many doubts,
and fights and fears within, without,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Just as I am, poor, wretched, blind; sight, riches, healing of the mind,
yea, all I need in Thee to find,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Just as I am, Thou wilt receive, wilt welcome, pardon, cleanse, relieve;
because Thy promise I believe,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: Just as I am, Thy love unknown hath broken ev'ry barrier down;
to be Thine own, yea, Thine alone,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

hymns.title: O boundless joy, there is salvation!
hymns.source_file: 331 O boundless joy, there is salvation lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O boundless joy, there is salvation! For me a sinner there is grace.
I was unworthy of compassion 'til in His heart I found a place, 'til in His heart I found a place.
His love prevailed and mercy mild sought out this lost and erring child, sought out this lost and erring child.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O Lord, forever and forever my ransomed soul shall voice Your praise,
and to Your mercy, blessed Saviour, my grateful hymns forever raise, my grateful hymns forever raise.
O wondrous gospel, holy theme! Christ came us sinners to redeem, Christ came us sinners to redeem.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O Saviour, never shall Your glory be dimmed by time and fade away.
Whate'er betide, I need not worry; with You I fear not when I pray, with You I fear not when I pray.
With You I dread no earthly loss, with You I bear each painful cross, with You I bear each painful cross.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: At last, when death shall fade life's flower, I'll take my journey not alone.
With Your sustaining hope and power, I'll come before the heav'nly throne; I'll come before the heav'nly throne.
And there in endless joy I'll sing eternal praises to my King, eternal praises to my King.

hymns.title: O happy day
hymns.source_file: 332 O happy day lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O happy day that fixed my choice on Thee, my Saviour and my God!

Happy day, happy day, when Jesus washed my sins away!

sections.label: Refrain

hymns.title: Pass me not, O gentle Saviour
hymns.source_file: 333 Pass me not, O gentle Saviour lyrics.txt

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Saviour, Saviour, hear my humble cry;
while on others Thou art calling, do not pass me by.

sections.label: Verse 2

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Saviour, Saviour, hear my humble cry;
while on others Thou art calling, do not pass me by.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Trusting only in Thy merit, would I seek Thy face;

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Saviour, Saviour, hear my humble cry;
while on others Thou art calling, do not pass me by.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Thou the Spring of all my comfort, more than life to me,
whom have I on earth beside Thee? Whom in heav'n but Thee?

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Saviour, Saviour, hear my humble cry;
while on others Thou art calling, do not pass me by.

hymns.title: Search me, O God
hymns.source_file: 334 Search me, O God lyrics.txt

metadata.composer: Maori melody arr. Robert F Douglas (b. 1941)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Search me, O God, and know my heart today;
try me, O Saviour, know my thoughts, I pray.
See if there be some wicked way in me;
cleanse me from ev'ry sin and set me free.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I pray Thee, Lord, to cleanse my soul from sin;
Thy word fulfill and make me pure within.
Fill me with fire where once I burned with shame;
grant my desire to magnify Thy name.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Lord, take my life and make it wholly Thine;
fill all my heart with Thy great love divine.
Take all my will, my passion, self and pride;
I now surrender, Lord– in me abide.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O Holy Ghost, renewal comes from Thee;
come and fulfill Thy holy work in me.
Thy word declares Thou wilt supply our need;
now for Thy blessings, Lord, I humbly plead.

hymns.title: The great Physician
hymns.source_file: 335 The great Physician lyrics.txt

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Sweetest note in seraph song, sweetest name on mortal tongue!
Sweetest carol ever sung: Jesus, blessed Jesus!

sections.label: Verse 2

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Sweetest note in seraph song, sweetest name on mortal tongue!
Sweetest carol ever sung: Jesus, blessed Jesus!

lines: His name dispels my grief and fear, no other name but Jesus.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Sweetest note in seraph song, sweetest name on mortal tongue!
Sweetest carol ever sung: Jesus, blessed Jesus!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Sweetest note in seraph song, sweetest name on mortal tongue!
Sweetest carol ever sung: Jesus, blessed Jesus!

hymns.title: There is a fountain
hymns.source_file: 336 There is a fountain lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There is a fountain where the blood of Christ for sinners flows;
a fountain that great wonders does, makes free from cares and woes.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: It flows for me, this precious blood, through faith this fount I see;
my sins all vanish in its flood, for Jesus died for me.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O Lamb of God, Thy precious blood with power still doth wait;
pour out Thy Spirit's flame of love and creatures new create.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: It flows for me, this precious blood, through faith this fount I see;
my sins all vanish in its flood, for Jesus died for me.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: When in my greatest plight of sin I long for Jesus' blood,
with joy I'll sing, in life or death, of this most gracious flood.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: It flows for me, this precious blood, through faith this fount I see;
my sins all vanish in its flood, for Jesus died for me.

sections.label: Verse 4

sections.label: Refrain
lines: It flows for me, this precious blood, through faith this fount I see;
my sins all vanish in its flood, for Jesus died for me.

hymns.title: There's a wideness in God's mercy
hymns.source_file: 337 There's a wideness in God's mercy lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There's a wideness in God's mercy, like the wideness of the sea.
There's a kindness in God's justice, which is more than liberty.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: There is welcome for the sinner, and a gracious, cleansing flood.
There is mercy with the Saviour, there is healing in His blood.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: But we make God's love too narrow by false limits of our own,
and we magnify its strictness with the zeal God will not own.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: For the love of God is broader than the measures of the mind,
and the heart of the Eternal is most wonderfully kind.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: If our love were but more simple we should take Him at His word,
and our lives would be illumined by the presence of our Lord.

hymns.title: This is a day of new beginnings
hymns.source_file: 338 This is a day of new beginnings lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: This is a day of new beginnings, time to remember and move on,
time to believe what love is bringing, laying to rest the pain that's gone.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: For by the life and death of Jesus, God's mighty Spirit, now as then,
can make for us a world of difference, as faith and hope are born again.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Then let us, with the Spirit's daring, step from the past and leave behind
our disappointment, guilt and grieving, seeking new paths and sure to find.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Christ is alive and goes before us to show and share what love can do.
This is a day of new beginnings; our God is making all things new.

hymns.title: What a sea of grace
hymns.source_file: 339 What a sea of grace lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: What a sea of grace, full of blessedness flows from Jesus' heart so full of love!
It brings sinners rest, peace we then possess, cleansed are we, and one with Him above!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O Lord Jesus mine, here I will remain, close to You to have Your love and warmth.
May Your love divine keep this heart of mine till that day that heaven I'll attain.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Oh, through Jesus' love, woes would disappear, our anxiety and grief and fear.
He, the gift of love, sent by God above, bought our freedom and salvation here.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O Lord Jesus mine, here I will remain, close to You to have Your love and warmth.
May Your love divine keep this heart of mine till that day that heaven I'll attain.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Oh, what grace it is to be Jesus' own and in sorrow to be ne'er alone.
He does courage give, strength that we may live, here on earth His love to us makes known.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O Lord Jesus mine, here I will remain, close to You to have Your love and warmth.
May Your love divine keep this heart of mine till that day that heaven I'll attain.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Oh, what heights of love, full of blessedness; Oh, what riches from a single hour!
Thus my heart knows rest, peace it does possess, all attained by grace through His great pow'r.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O Lord Jesus mine, here I will remain, close to You to have Your love and warmth.
May Your love divine keep this heart of mine till that day that heaven I'll attain.

hymns.title: With contrite heart I come to Thee
hymns.source_file: 340 With contrite heart I come to Thee.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: With contrite heart I come to Thee, Thou blessed throne of grace;
Thou Jesus Christ, God's only Son, died my sins to efface.
These tidings bring to all mankind: There's grace for you and me;
there's open now a door of grace, O soul, to make you free.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Reveal then clearly, Lord,Thy countenance to me;
extend Thy grace that I may now be reconciled to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: As beggar I now come to Thee, I've naught to bring but guilt,
but if with contrite heart I come, then pardon me Thou wilt.
Though nothing worthy I can bring, lamentable I stand
and cry: "O Lord, save Thou my soul; extend to me Thy hand."

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Reveal then clearly, Lord,Thy countenance to me;
extend Thy grace that I may now be reconciled to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Who in repentance come to Thee is never turned away,
so now I humbly Thee entreat, dear Lord: "Hear me, I pray."
O Jesus Christ, Thy precious blood from sin delivers me,
I plunge within and now I am again at peace with Thee.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Reveal then clearly, Lord,Thy countenance to me;
extend Thy grace that I may now be reconciled to Thee.

hymns.title: Grant us, Lord, due preparation
hymns.source_file: 341 Grant us, Lord, due preparation lyrics.txt

metadata.composer: Phillip Nicolai (1556-1608) arr. Johann Sebastian Bach (1685-1750)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Grant us, Lord, due preparation for Your blest supper's celebration!
Come, come, O Lord, and enter in.
In this life do us enable in faith to now approach Your table;
pronounce us free from death and sin.
O Lord, we are Your own and we are Yours alone!
Amen! Amen!
All praise to You! In heav'n anew Your supper we shall celebrate.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: May Your glorious invitation to this most blessed celebration
extend to all who love Your name.
Come then, you who hear this calling, His plea be not on deaf ears falling,
for strength and pow'r is ours to gain.
O Lord, we are Your own and we are Yours alone!
Amen! Amen!
All praise to You! In heav'n anew Your supper we shall celebrate.

hymns.title: Host and King of grace
hymns.source_file: 342 Host and King of grace lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Host and King of grace and riches, we long to commune with Thee.
We today have been invited: "Come, Oh come, and sup with Me."
What is served at earthly tables, be it rich and tasteful shown,
cannot still the soul's deep longing; souls are fed by Thee alone!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Here we see no golden goblets on display before our eyes,
nor find earthly, senseless pleasures in the feast God's love provides,
for the bread that here is broken and the cup which here we share,
where the word of God is spoken, can to naught on earth compare!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Here is blessing, healing, mercy, love and goodness, friendliness;
thus are satisfied the needy, filling them with blessedness.
From their sin made free and happy, resting from their tears and pain,
guided by the love of Jesus, they a taste of heav'n obtain.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: See, the Master sits at table with His own, a blessed sight,
granting gifts of grace and mercy, speaking words which bring delight.
Oh, the hearts are opened fully; how God's children's eyes do shine!
Tears of thanks then flow so freely, thanks for blessed joy divine!

hymns.title: Blessed is the peace to my heart
hymns.source_file: 346 Blessed is the peace to my heart lyrics.txt

lines: Blessed is the peace that my soul waited, Oh, so long, to receive.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Whiter than the snow, whiter than the snow.
Mighty is the Helper in need; His blood makes me whiter than snow. (than snow)

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Whiter than the snow, whiter than the snow.

that we all are of one Father and united stand in Thee.

hymns.title: Help us to help each other
hymns.source_file: 369 Help us to help each other lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Help us to help each other, Lord, each other's cross to bear;
let all their friendly aid afford and feel their neighbours' care.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Up into Thee, our living Head, let us in all things grow
and by Thy sacrifice be led the fruits of love to show.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Drawn by the magnet of Thy love, let all our hearts agree;
and ever t'wards each other move, and ever more to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: This is the bond of perfectness, Thy spotless charity.
O let us still, we pray, possess the mind that was in Thee.

hymns.title: His love
hymns.source_file: 370 His love lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God's love reached out to me one day on Calvary,
when I was lost in sin and shame.
He pardoned all my sin and now He lives within.
Oh, blessed love of God, so rich and free!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: His love is deeper than any ocean and it is broader than any sea.
The love of Jesus took Him to Calvary, to suffer there for you and me.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: His love can win you too if you will let Him do
for you what He has done for me.
He'll take away your sin and give you peace within.
Oh, precious love of Christ, so rich and free!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: His love is deeper than any ocean and it is broader than any sea.
The love of Jesus took Him to Calvary, to suffer there for you and me.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: How sweet to walk each day and know He's there alway,
assured His love does satisfy!
O sinner, heed His call, make Him your all in all.
No truer Friend you'll find along life's way.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: His love is deeper than any ocean and it is broader than any sea.
The love of Jesus took Him to Calvary, to suffer there for you and me.

hymns.title: How blessed and glorious with Jesus
hymns.source_file: 371 How blessed and glorious with Jesus lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: How blessed and glorious with Jesus forever united to be.
O great is Thy love and Thy mercy which daily is granted us free.
Near to Thee in Thy fold, what glorious love we behold!
Near to Thee in Thy fold, what glorious love we behold!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Once more didst Thou, Lord, by Thy mercy the office that reconciles give;
the world may behold it as folly, but they who accept it shall live.
Near to Thee in Thy fold, what glorious love we behold!
Near to Thee in Thy fold, what glorious love we behold!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: We wandered about in the desert and blindly were searching for Thee.
Thou sawest us, dear loving Saviour, and helped us the way of life see.
Near to Thee in Thy fold, what glorious love we behold!
Near to Thee in Thy fold, what glorious love we behold!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Of such love we were not deserving that leads into pastures serene,
but Thou art of love and of mercy and washest the uncleanest clean.
Near to Thee in Thy fold, what glorious love we behold!
Near to Thee in Thy fold, what glorious love we behold!

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: With deeds shall we therefore now thank Thee that into Thy truth Thou us drew.
Lord, strengthen our faith in the future, in honour to Thee whom 'tis due.
Near to Thee in Thy fold, what glorious love we behold!
Near to Thee in Thy fold, what glorious love we behold!

hymns.title: I fare so well with You
hymns.source_file: 372 I fare so well with You lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I fare so well with You, O Lord, since I Your own have been.
You drew me deeper in accord into Your heart serene.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: How well I fare with Christ the Lord!
My heart's with Him in sweet accord.
How well I fare with Christ the Lord!
My heart's with Him in sweet accord.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Ah, blessed joy abounds here free for those who can believe
and sweetest peace He gives to me which Hades cannot thieve.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: How well I fare with Christ the Lord!
My heart's with Him in sweet accord.
How well I fare with Christ the Lord!
My heart's with Him in sweet accord.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Though fear and sorrow may alarm, my God will always care.
I am His child, He shields from harm, my burden helps me  bear.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: How well I fare with Christ the Lord!
My heart's with Him in sweet accord.
How well I fare with Christ the Lord!
My heart's with Him in sweet accord.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Be sorrowful whoever will, my heart's a happy shrine.
To God in faith I'm clinging still, I'm His and He is mine.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: How well I fare with Christ the Lord!
My heart's with Him in sweet accord.
How well I fare with Christ the Lord!
My heart's with Him in sweet accord.

hymns.title: I have found a Friend in Jesus
hymns.source_file: 373 I have found a Friend in Jesus lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I have found a Friend in Jesus, there's none other quite so true;
ev'ry hour and ev'ry moment do I feel His love anew.
He does lead on paths of safety, guides me on the narrow way,
gives me peace and crowns with blessing, grants new grace from day to day.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He, my heart's delight and sunshine, now does make my pathway bright,
brings my soul peace and contentment, fills my heart with love and light.
Thus He stills my deepest longing, leads through night to brightest day.
When my work on earth is over, my last tears He'll wipe away.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And now tell me where's another, such a Friend as He on earth,
who as He, my Lord and Saviour, to my soul so much is worth?
Could I speak with tongues of angels, praising Him, my dearest Friend,
songs at best could not express it, for His love is without end.

hymns.title: I heard the voice of Jesus say
hymns.source_file: 374 I heard the voice of Jesus say lyrics.txt

metadata.composer: William H Havergal (1793-1870) arr. Lowell Mason (1792-1872)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I heard the voice of Jesus say: "Come unto Me and rest.
Lay down, O weary one, lay down thy head upon My breast."

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I came to Jesus as I was, so weary, worn and sad.
I found in Him a resting place and He has made me glad.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I heard the voice of Jesus say: "Behold, I freely give
the living water, thirsty one. Bow down and drink, and live!"

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I came to Jesus, and I drank of that lifegiving stream.
My thirst was quenched, my soul revived, and now I live in Him.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: I heard the voice of Jesus say: "I am this dark world's light.
Look unto Me, that morn may break and all the day be bright."

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: I looked to Jesus and I found in Him my Star, my Sun.
And in that light of life I'll walk till trav-'ling days are done.

hymns.title: I know a heart I call my own
hymns.source_file: 375 I know a heart I call my own lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I know a heart I call my own; it is a holy shrine,
I'd change it not for precious stones or passing vain design.
There I am free from all concern; to rest, it is so sweet!
To Jesus' loving heart I turn, in paradise to meet,
to Jesus' loving heart I turn, in paradise to meet!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Upon my loving Saviour's breast, no greater joy than this!
It draws me to the heav'nly rest, to that blest place of bliss!
If then, at times, from Him I part, in shame I must concede:
Alone upon my Saviour's breast is paradise indeed,
alone upon my Saviour's breast is paradise indeed.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: From this, our faithful Jesus' heart, a stream of love does flow.
I drink from it in joy or smart, its cheer and comfort know.
So full of mercy is this stream, its banks it would o'erflow
that it may sinful souls redeem and grace on all bestow,
that it may sinful souls redeem and grace on all bestow.

hymns.title: I praise God's love in adoration
hymns.source_file: 376 I praise God's love in adoration lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I praise God's love in adoration which is by Jesus Christ revealed.
Myself yield to its inspiration, this love that first my pardon sealed.
All thoughts of self from me I'll banish into the gulf of love to vanish.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O love, thou art so kind and friendly; Ah, how my heart doth long for thee.
Love meek, yet strong, hath drawn me kindly, with all I have, I bow to thee.
O love, thou virtue God effected, hath me and I have Thee selected.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: My heart is Thine, in earth and heaven, Redeemer, Thou my greatest good.
Thou hast in love Thy pure life given for my salvation through Thy blood.
From greatest sin didst Thou deliver: I give my heart to Thee forever.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O Jesus, may Thy name forever be deeply in my heart impressed.
May Thy great love, O Jesus, ever be both by heart and mind confessed.
In word and deed, in all my nature, may Thou, Lord, be in ev'ry feature.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: In this most precious name of Jesus, the Father's heart is manifest.
A fount of love and peace most gracious still flows today in sweet attest.
If sinners knew this, my dear Saviour, they soon in love would seek Thy favour.

hymns.title: In Christ there is no east or west
hymns.source_file: 377 In Christ there is no east or west lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: In Christ there is no east or west, in Him no south or north,
but one great fellowship of love throughout the whole wide earth.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: In Him shall true hearts ev'rywhere their high communion find;
His service is the golden cord close binding humankind.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Join hands, disciples of the faith, whate'er your race may be!
Who serves my Father as His child is surely kin to me.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: In Christ now meet both east and west; in Him meet south and north;
believing souls are one in Him throughout the whole wide earth.

hymns.title: In the garden
hymns.source_file: 378 In the garden lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I come to the garden alone, while the dew is still on the roses;
and the voice I hear, falling on my ear, the Son of God discloses.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: And He walks with me, and He talks with me, and He tells me I am His own.
And the joy we share as we tarry there, none other has ever known.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He speaks and the sound of His voice is so sweet the birds hush their singing,
and the melody that He gave to me within my heart is ringing.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: And He walks with me, and He talks with me, and He tells me I am His own.
And the joy we share as we tarry there, none other has ever known.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I'd stay in the garden with Him though the night around me be falling,
but He bids me go; through the voice of woe His voice to me is calling.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: And He walks with me, and He talks with me, and He tells me I am His own.
And the joy we share as we tarry there, none other has ever known.

hymns.title: Into pastures green and fair
hymns.source_file: 379 Into pastures green and fair lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Into pastures green and fair leads the Shepherd us with care,
shows to us the fount of living waters here.
In this blessed peace we live, peace as only He can give.
O how bright becomes the vision and how clear!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Glorious stream of life eternal; blessed, peaceful pastures green.
Jesus' word is there revealed, many by Him would be healed;
by the pure in heart alone can He be seen.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: How we love to linger there, far from ev'ry earthly care
and in prayer our hearts to God we there unfold.
In its quiet Him we hear as He to our soul draws near,
plainly speaking to us words of love untold.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Glorious stream of life eternal; blessed, peaceful pastures green.
Jesus' word is there revealed, many by Him would be healed;
by the pure in heart alone can He be seen.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: He is friendly, true and good, seeks us as a shepherd would
when a lamb within the thicket goes astray.
Brethren, let us evermore follow as He walks before,
'til at last to glory He shall lead the way!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Glorious stream of life eternal; blessed, peaceful pastures green.
Jesus' word is there revealed, many by Him would be healed;
by the pure in heart alone can He be seen.

hymns.title: Jesus loves me
hymns.source_file: 380 Jesus loves me lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: verses 1 & 3: Anna B Warner (1820-1915) verse 2: David R McGuire (1929-1971)
metadata.composer: William B Bradbury (1816-1868) arr. John Rodriques (b. 1979)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus loves me! This I know, for the Bible tells me so.
Little ones to Him belong; they are safe, for He is strong.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Yes, Jesus loves me!
Yes, Jesus loves me!
Yes, Jesus loves me!
The Bible tells me so.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Jesus loves me! This I know, as He loved so long ago,
taking children on His knee, saying, "Let them come to Me."

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Yes, Jesus loves me!
Yes, Jesus loves me!
Yes, Jesus loves me!
The Bible tells me so.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Jesus loves me! He will stay close beside me on my way.
He's prepared a home for me and someday His face I'll see.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Yes, Jesus loves me!
Yes, Jesus loves me!
Yes, Jesus loves me!
The Bible tells me so.

hymns.title: Jesus, Lord, we look to Thee
hymns.source_file: 381 Jesus, Lord, we look to Thee lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus, Lord, we look to Thee, let us in Thy name agree:
Show Thyself the Prince of peace; bid all strife forever cease.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Make us one of heart and mind, courteous, merciful and kind,
lowly, meek in thought and word, altogether like our Lord.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Let us for each other care, each the other's burden bear;
to Thy Church the pattern give, show how true believers live.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Free from anger and from pride, let us thus in God abide;
all the depths of love express, all the heights of holiness.

hymns.title: Jesus, my truest Friend
hymns.source_file: 382 Jesus, my truest Friend lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Thou only art my song, Jesus, my truest Friend;
Thou art, my whole life long, Jesus, my Friend!
O Thou art ever true, as I have found anew.
Thy love would I pursue, Jesus, my Friend!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O how it humbles me, Jesus, my truest Friend;
that once I could not see, Jesus, my Friend!
Thy word I cast away, on wrong paths went astray,
but Thy grace found a way, Jesus, my Friend!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Now all is well with me, Jesus, my truest Friend;
I now sing happily, Jesus, my Friend!
Thou hast forgiven me, Thy peace and joy make free;
I follow lovingly, Jesus, my Friend!

hymns.title: Jesus, the very thought of Thee
hymns.source_file: 383 Jesus, the very thought of Thee lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: Attr. Bernard of Clairvaux, 12th cent. transl. Edward Caswall (1814-1878)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus, the very thought of Thee with sweetness fills my breast;
but sweeter still Thy face to see, and in Thy presence rest.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O Hope of ev'ry contrite heart, O Joy of all the meek,
to those who fall, how kind Thou art! How good to those who seek!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: What it then means to those who find, no tongue nor pen can show;
the love of Jesus, gracious, kind, none but His loved ones know.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Jesus, our only joy art Thou, as Thou our prize wilt be;
Jesus, be Thou our glory now and through eternity.

hymns.title: Lord, more would I love Thee
hymns.source_file: 384 Lord, more would I love Thee lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord, more would I love Thee, hear me I pray!
I make this earnest plea to Thee each day.
More, Lord, would I love Thee, O Saviour, more love Thee,
still more love Thee, still more love Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Once sought I without Thee my peace and rest.
But now I clearly see in Thee the best,
which is: Still more love Thee, O Saviour, more love Thee,
still more love Thee, still more love Thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Though there's a cross for me to bear each day,
still shall it ever be my choice to say:
Lord, more would I love Thee, O Saviour, more love Thee,
still more love Thee, still more love Thee.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: When ends my mortal race, my earthly time,
I find with Thee a place– what bliss sublime!
Then shall I more love Thee, O Saviour, more love Thee,
still more love Thee, still more love Thee.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Once when in glory there, Lord, at Thy throne,
white raiment I shall wear and have a crown,
then shall I still love Thee, O Saviour, more love Thee,
still more love Thee, still more love Thee.

hymns.title: O how precious are the moments
hymns.source_file: 385 O how precious are the moments lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O how precious are the moments in God's tabernacle here, where in oneness we're united, through the door of grace draw near.
Ev'ry heart with joy perceiving that His love here for us lives, grants us comfort in all suff'ring and for sorrow joy it gives!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Lord, again today we gather, to Thy sanctuary flee. Thankful hearts and lips together honour, praise and worship Thee.
Thou, O Lord, now manifested through the Spirit of Thy Son, till today hast us protected and our faith reward hath won.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Comfort Thou the brokenhearted with the balsam that's from Thee. Let us not with Satan trifle, wise and watchful let us be.
Teach us faithfully to honour all Thou didst to us entrust, how we may in ev'ry danger, as a bride, stay pure and just.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Favours, these that we petition, grant through Thy apostles' word, wherein Thou hast placed the weapons that are sharper than a sword.
Thou, O Lord, in us be Victor over hell and death and grave, ev'ry enemy succumbing, to us all a mighty stave.

hymns.title: O love, the golden sunshine bright
hymns.source_file: 386 O love, the golden sunshine bright lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O love, the golden sunshine bright, of weary human hearts,
when in my heart it sheds its light, all pain from me departs.
The darkness fades and night must flee where Jesus' love does shine,
and peace and happiness flow free within the hearts that pine.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O love of God, so full and true, of ancient time, yet ever new.
It lives for me, it lives for you and draws us all to Him anew.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: When from the cross that ray of love pierced through my night of sin
and brought me sunshine from above, I woke to God within.
Since then I know who loved me true, yes, even unto death.
My heart shall now His will pursue; praise Him in ev'ry breath!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O love of God, so full and true, of ancient time, yet ever new.
It lives for me, it lives for you and draws us all to Him anew.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The Sun that shines my fears to quell and offers bliss to me
is Jesus, my Immanuel, for all eternity!
I'll sing to Him my joyful song while in this vale of tears
and ever with the heav'nly throng when He to me appears.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O love of God, so full and true, of ancient time, yet ever new.
It lives for me, it lives for you and draws us all to Him anew.

hymns.title: O Master of the loving heart
hymns.source_file: 387 O Master of the loving heart lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: Calvin W Laufer (1874-1938) refrain: Jaques Cronjé (b. 1966)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O Master of the loving heart, the Friend of all in need,
we pray that we may be like You in thought, in word, in deed.
Your days were full of kindly acts, Your speech was true and plain;
and none who ever sought You, Lord, would come to You in vain.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O Lord, we love You, O Lord, we love You,
we want to see You face to face.
O Lord, we love You, O Lord, we love You,
accept us in Your loving grace.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Your countenance God's love displayed, Your hand God's strength revealed;
who saw Your face, or felt Your touch, were comforted and who healed.
O grant us hearts like Yours, dear Lord, so joyous, free, and true,
that all Your children ev'rywhere be drawn by us to You:

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O Lord, we love You, O Lord, we love You,
we want to see You face to face.
O Lord, we love You, O Lord, we love You,
accept us in Your loving grace.

hymns.title: O the deep, deep love of Jesus
hymns.source_file: 388 O the deep, deep love of Jesus lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O the deep, deep love of Jesus, vast, unmeasured, boundless, free,
rolling as a mighty ocean in its fullness over me.
Underneath me, all around me, is the current of His love;
leading onward, leading homeward to my glorious rest above.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O the deep, deep love of Jesus– spread His praise from shore to shore!
He is loving, ever loving, changing never, nevermore.
How He watches o'er His loved ones, died that they may be His own;
how for them He's interceding, watching o'er them from the throne.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O the deep, deep love of Jesus, love of ev'ry love the best;
'tis an ocean vast of blessing, 'tis a haven sweet of rest.
O the deep, deep love of Jesus, 'tis a heav'n of heav'ns to me;
and it lifts me up to glory, where fore'er with Him I'll be.

hymns.title: On the mount of bliss ascending
hymns.source_file: 389 On the mount of bliss ascending lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: On the mount of bliss ascending Jesus us desires to lead.
There God's love which is unending will provide our ev'ry need.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O how wonderful 'twill be in such blessed company!
Ev'ry anxious worry flees for the soul now Jesus sees!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: On the mount of bliss unending– who would not these heights ascend?
There see Christ with heaven blending, clothed in glory without end.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O how wonderful 'twill be in such blessed company!
Ev'ry anxious worry flees for the soul now Jesus sees!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: On the mount of bliss unending, what a joy His child to be!
There, our earthly life transcending, we may glimpse eternity.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O how wonderful 'twill be in such blessed company!
Ev'ry anxious worry flees for the soul now Jesus sees!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: On the mount of bliss ascending, let us tabernacles build.
All distraction here suspending that His will may be fulfilled.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O how wonderful 'twill be in such blessed company!
Ev'ry anxious worry flees for the soul now Jesus sees!

hymns.title: Our God is loving
hymns.source_file: 390 Our God is loving lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Our God is loving, from sin He saves us;
our God is loving, He loves us all.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: We praise Him evermore: Our God is loving,
our God is loving, He loves us all.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He sent us Jesus, the loving Saviour;
He sent us Jesus and made us free.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: We praise Him evermore: Our God is loving,
our God is loving, He loves us all.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: His word of mercy our souls does nourish;
His word of mercy our thirst does quench.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: We praise Him evermore: Our God is loving,
our God is loving, He loves us all.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: With joy He fills ev'ry soul grown weary;
with joy He fills ev'ry aching heart.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: We praise Him evermore: Our God is loving,
our God is loving, He loves us all.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: We all now praise Him, our God eternal;
we all now praise Him forevermore.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: We praise Him evermore: Our God is loving,
our God is loving, He loves us all.

hymns.title: Peace that God has given
hymns.source_file: 391 Peace that God has given lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Peace that God has given! Precious glorious prize!
Sweetest gift from heaven, leads to Paradise!
Blessed, blessed, they who peace attain,
they shall reach the city where God's peace does reign.
Blessed, blest are they who this peace attain!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Joy brings purest pleasure like a sunbeam bright.
Souls in verdant pasture, comfort find in plight!
Blessed, blessed, who in joy remain!
They who see God's beauty and the goal attain.
Blessed, blest are they who in joy remain!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Holy love, the dearest, fount of purest gold!
Pow'r of love sincerest, God and man enfold!
Blessed, blessed, those who love possess,
in God's love abiding, dwell in happiness!
Blessed, blest are they who this love possess.

hymns.title: Peace, O how precious
hymns.source_file: 392 Peace, O how precious lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Peace, O how precious, gift from the Lord, from my dear Saviour, Jesus, outpoured!
Deep in my spirit this be instilled, that my desire in You be fulfilled!
Grant that the heart with sweetness be filled!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Peace from my Saviour, gladly received– only through Jesus is it achieved.
Great was the suff'ring He had endured; greatest His love which peace has secured!
Peace without measure He has assured!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Lord, may Your glory in me increase, ever preserving heavenly peace.
Just as a father gifts will bestow, grant that Your child, who loves You, may know
peace where no cloud, Lord, ever will show.

hymns.title: Seeing I am Jesus' lamb
hymns.source_file: 393 Seeing I am Jesus' lamb lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Seeing I am Jesus' lamb, ever glad at heart I am
o'er my Shepherd good, who provides me food,
His lamb by name doth call; He knows and loves us all.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: By His gentle staff I'm led, in His pastures I am fed.
There His love I find, and His mercy kind;
His thirsty lamb He brings to cool, refreshing springs.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Now I shall rejoice and sing, and my praise to Him I'll bring,
knowing ev'ry day He will lead the way
till heaven I shall see, with Jesus there to be!

hymns.title: Tell me the stories of Jesus
hymns.source_file: 394 Tell me the stories of Jesus lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Tell me the stories of Jesus I love to hear;
things I would ask Him to tell me if He were here:
Scenes by the wayside, tales of the sea,
stories of Jesus, tell them to me.

lines: First let me hear how the children stood round His knee,
and I shall cherish His blessing resting on me;
words full of kindness, deeds full of grace,
all in the lovelight of Jesus' face.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Into the city I'd follow the children's band,
waving a branch of the palm tree high in my hand;
one of His heralds, yes, I would sing loudest hosannas, "Jesus is King!"

hymns.title: The gift of love
hymns.source_file: 395 The gift of love lyrics.txt

lines: Though I may speak with bravest fire, and have the gift to all inspire,
and have not love, my words are vain as sounding brass, and worthless gain.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Though I may give all I possess, and striving so my love profess,
but not be giv'n by love within, it naught shall profit, naught shall win.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Come, Spirit, come, our hearts control, our spirits long to be made whole.
Let inward love guide ev'ry deed; of Your command we then take heed.

hymns.title: The love of God

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O blest the hearts which love within them bear that surging floods can never wash away.

sections.label: Refrain

lines: Think about His love, think about His goodness, think about His grace that's brought us through.

Great is the measure of our Father's love.

hymns.title: To our loving God sing praises
hymns.source_file: 398 To our loving God sing praises lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: To our loving God sing praises, for His love shall ever last!
Songs that, prompted by God's Spirit, courage bring in standing fast.
With great zeal God's pow'r is active, bringing Satan's works to naught.
Yes, our Lord is everloving, us to His great Work has brought.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: In God's love is recognition of the Son whom He had sent.
And this love is far surpassing all man's knowledge and intent.
To His children, rich in mercy He has been and will remain.
With compassion for the sinner, He helps heav'nly heights attain.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Love would have my heart believing what my mind cannot conceive.
Of this love shall none deprive me; Satan seeks me to deceive.
Love, may this be my assurance: Great reward is found in thee.
Teach me that my song may ever to the Lord praiseworthy be!

hymns.title: We have a gentle Shepherd
hymns.source_file: 399 We have a gentle Shepherd lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We have a gentle Shepherd who holds us very dear, whose love for seeking sinners drew Him to us so near.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: That we might find redemption, He took us by the hand, for we were like blind people astray in foreign land.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And He would daily guard us, the children's faithful Friend, and daily send upon us His blessings without end.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O Shepherd kind and gentle, we praise Your saving love. O keep us safe and lead us to Your blest home above.

hymns.title: When peace with the Father
hymns.source_file: 400 When peace with the Father lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: When peace with the Father attendeth my way, though sorrows like sea billows roll;
my heart in the joy of the Spirit doth sing: "It is well, it is well with my soul."

sections.label: Refrain
lines: It is well with my soul, it is well, it is well with my soul.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: My sins and my sorrows are borne by the Lamb; not part He forgave, but the whole.
How often my heart doth His mercy behold– praise the Lord, praise the Lord, O my soul!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: It is well with my soul, it is well, it is well with my soul.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Though Satan should buffet, though trials should come, this knowledge points me to the goal:
My Jesus for me gave His life on the cross and hath shed His own blood for my soul.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: It is well with my soul, it is well, it is well with my soul.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I live now in Jesus, for Jesus alone, His Spirit my life doth control.
In Him I have peace and redemption from sin; praise the Lord, praise the Lord, O my soul!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: It is well with my soul, it is well, it is well with my soul.

hymns.title: When I'm with Him
hymns.source_file: 401 When I'm with Him lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: A fellowship so blest  my soul has found with Him whose sweetest name is Love;
there in His grace and goodness I abound, I share His blessings from above.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: When I'm with Him, the fairest pleasures of the world grow dim and fade away,
and in my heart I feel His glory nearer ev'ry day; when I'm with Him, when I'm with Him.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: In troubled times He fills my heart with peace; with love He lifts me when I fall.
For Him my longing ever does increase, with joy I wait upon His call.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: When I'm with Him, the fairest pleasures of the world grow dim and fade away,
and in my heart I feel His glory nearer ev'ry day; when I'm with Him, when I'm with Him.

hymns.title: Where charity and love prevail
hymns.source_file: 402 Where charity and love prevail lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Where charity and love prevail, there God is ever found; brought here together by Christ's love, by love we thus are bound.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: With grateful joy and holy fear true charity we learn; let us with heart and mind and strength now love Christ in return.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Now we forgive each other's faults as we our faults confess; and let us love each other well in Christian holiness.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Let strife among us be unknown, let all contention cease; be Christ the glory that we seek, be ours His holy peace.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Let us recall that in our midst dwells God's beloved Son; as members of His body joined, we are in Him made one.

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: Love can exclude no race or creed if hon-oured be God's name; our com-mon life embraces all whose Maker is the same.

hymns.title: Again He'll come
hymns.source_file: 403 Again He'll come lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: From Olive's hill disciples, heav'nward gazing,
looked up until the Saviour passed from view;
but radiant angels uttered words of promise:
"He who has gone shall come again to you.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: "Again, again the faithful shall behold Him!
Again, again enrobed in majesty;
in clouds of glory souls redeemed shall see Him.
Again, again the King of Glory see!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The Son of God shall come in splendid glory,
again, but not for bitter pain and loss.
Again, but not in weakness or in sorrow;
again, but not to bear shame's bitter cross.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: "Again, again the faithful shall behold Him!
Again, again enrobed in majesty;
in clouds of glory souls redeemed shall see Him.
Again, again the King of Glory see!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O Zion, clothe yourself in raiment holy;
lift up your eyes to greet your coming King.
Rejoice, rejoice, no more be robed in sorrow,
rejoice, O Zion, lift your voice and sing.

hymns.title: Ascend to Zion's highest
hymns.source_file: 404 Ascend to Zion's highest lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Ascend to Zion's highest; ascend, ascend, ascend!

Soon shall we stand at pearly gates, yes, soon before God's throne.
We soon shall sing in realms on high the new song to the Son.

sections.label: Refrain

Ascend to heavenly rest, we journey home at last.
Ascend to heavenly rest, we journey home at last.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Ascend to Zion's highest; ascend, ascend, ascend!
Although the foe may threaten, still upward is the trend.
Soon shall our lips of gladness sing, our tongues shall utter praise.
The chosen ones soon journey up to realms beyond earth's gaze.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O pilgrim, will you come?
We journey up to Salem's heights, up to a home of light on high.
Soon there, in everlasting joy, we shall the face of God behold.
Ascend to heavenly rest, we journey home at last.
Ascend to heavenly rest, we journey home at last.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Ascend to Zion's highest; ascend, ascend, ascend!

We then in glory shall behold what you and I believed.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O pilgrim, will you come?
We journey up to Salem's heights, up to a home of light on high.
