Ascend to heavenly rest, we journey home at last.
Ascend to heavenly rest, we journey home at last.

hymns.title: Beyond the sunset
hymns.source_file: 405 Beyond the sunset_Brock lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Beyond the sunset,
O blissful morning, when with our Saviour heav'n is begun; earth's toiling ended,
O glorious dawning, beyond the sunset, when day is done.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Beyond the sunset no clouds will gather, no storms will threaten, no fears annoy;
O day of gladness,
O day unending, beyond the sunset, eternal joy!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Beyond the sunset a hand will guide me to God the Father, whom I adore;
His glorious presence,
His words of welcome will be my portion on that fair shore.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Beyond the sunset,
O glad reunion with our dear loved ones who've gone before; in that fair homeland we'll know no parting, beyond the sunset forevermore!

hymns.title: Come ye that love the Lord
hymns.source_file: 406 Come ye that love the Lord lyrics.txt

lines: Come ye that love the Lord, and let your joys be known.
Join in a song with sweet accord, join in a song with sweet accord

sections.label: Refrain

sections.label: Refrain
lines: We journey to Zion, beautiful, glorious Zion!
Yes, heav'nward go we to Zion, the glorious city of God!

lines: We journey to Zion, beautiful, glorious Zion!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: We journey to Zion, beautiful, glorious Zion!

hymns.title: Deep river
hymns.source_file: 407 Deep river lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Deep river, my home is over Jordan.
Deep river,
Lord,

Oh, deep river,
Lord,
I want to cross over into campground.

hymns.title: Forth, forth, my heart, to heaven
hymns.source_file: 408 Forth, forth, heart, to heaven lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Forth, forth, my heart, to heaven, forth, forth, to heaven go!
Amid this world's confusion there is no rest for you.
Where God's Lamb hath us guided there is a place provided; there, there is rest I know.
Forth, forth to  heaven go!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: If you still feel you're fettered, then wrest yourself away.
The Lamb has all things conquered which bring you such dismay.
Behold His banner waving where He the souls is saving; there His sweet rest you'll know.
Forth, forth to heaven go!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O Lamb upon Mount Zion, how wonderful art Thou.
Had I wings like a falcon, I would fly home right now.
With triumph there rejoicing, Thine own are Thee embracing with joy and love aglow.
Forth, forth to heaven go!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: However, all my longing should rest within Thy will;
my heart to Thee belonging, Thy wishes to fulfil.
I shall remain here waiting until I hear Thee saying: "Forth, forth, sweet rest you'll know.
Forth, forth to heaven go!"

hymns.title: Gathering homeward, you pilgrims
hymns.source_file: 409 Gathering homeward, you pilgrims lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Gath'ring homeward, you pilgrims, from ev'ry land:
O rejoice! O rejoice!
Weary feet you'll soon rest on that pearly strand.
Come and rejoice!
Golden crowns by the blessed are worn up there as they flourish their palms and sing praises fair.
In His glory forever the Lamb behold as He leads into splendour the heav'nly fold.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O rejoice! O rejoice!
Jubilant homeward to heav'n we go!
O rejoice! O rejoice!
Come and rejoice!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Very soon you shall enter that blessed rest:
O rejoice! O rejoice!
Ever nearer you draw to your journey's quest.
Come and rejoice!
Let the billows be roaring, just trust the Lord, they but carry the pilgrims still heavenward.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O rejoice! O rejoice!
Jubilant homeward to heav'n we go!
O rejoice! O rejoice!
Come and rejoice!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Blessed Jesus, our Saviour, to You we cling:
O rejoice! O rejoice!
In our hearts we are thankful and praises bring.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: O rejoice! O rejoice!
Jubilant homeward to heav'n we go!
O rejoice! O rejoice!

hymns.title: Gird on your armour
hymns.source_file: 410 Gird on your armour lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Gird on your armour, be prepared; your lamps with oil keep filled.
With godliness and holy love, to Christ the Lamb to yield.
The Bridegroom soon will come, His bride to carry home.
O be prepared, He'll not delay, therefore His call obey.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: How shall I then prepare my heart to meet this heav'nly Guest,
so that His Holy Spirit's light my heart may fill, make blest?
His temple pure and clean, I'd be with love serene;
that I may pray without a fear: "My Lord, O soon appear!"

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: There still is time, go out today, guests to the feast invite;
that they may come and purchase oil, their hearts with Christ unite.
Outside yet many wait to join the marriage fête.
There is yet much room vacant still, bring guests this space to fill.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: What great rejoicing when we there our bridal robes unfold.
And in the heaven's glorious realm our King shall there behold.
Sing "Hallelujah" loud, O bride of Christ avowed.
Yes, "Hallelujah" to our Lord we'll sing in one accord.

hymns.title: Glory for me
hymns.source_file: 411 Glory for me lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: When all my labours and trials are o'er,
and I am safe on that beautiful shore,
just to be near the dear Lord I adore,
will through the ages be glory for me.
[Refrain]
O that will be glory for me,
yes, it will be glory for me
when by His grace there His face I shall see,
that will be glory, be glory for me.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: When, by the gift of His infinite grace,
I am accorded in heaven a place,
just to be there and to look on His face,
will through the ages be glory for me.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: There will be friends I have loved long ago;
joy like a river around me will flow;
yet just a smile from my Saviour, I know,
will through the ages be glory for me.

hymns.title: How will it be?
hymns.source_file: 412 How will it be lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: How will it be then after this life's journey, when the last battle's fought and we are free, and we with Him as bride go up to heaven, pass through the portal of eternity?
When from our feet the dust of earth is shaken, toil and its sweat at last are wiped away; then we shall see the reasons for our striving that oft refreshed our courage on life's way!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: How will it be when we will hear Him calling: "Come, all ye blessed, come, into the light"?
When at God's throne we on the steps are standing there face to face with Him– O gracious sight!
Then eyes will see where once the tears were flowing, all human fears in heaven will be stilled; all wounds and pain through His love then shall vanish and with eternal bliss our souls be filled!

hymns.title: I see in spirit
hymns.source_file: 413 I see in spirit lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I see in spirit,
Lord,
Your most glorious throne, could I inherit now this eternal home!
Gladly I give You my life completely; in grace receive me,
Lord, into glory!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Radiant its beauty for all eternity!
That wondrous kingdom mine will forever be!
Fervent my longing, great is my yearning for that sweet morning of Christ's returning.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: All thanks I bring You:
You blest my eyes to see what joy awaits me where now I long to be.
May I be worthy; grant me,
Lord, entry into that city to see Your glory!

hymns.title: My Lord! What a morning

when the bright and glorious morning I shall see,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I shall know Him, I shall know Him
and redeemed by His side I shall stand.
I shall know Him, I shall know Him
by the print of the nails in His hand.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Oh, the dear ones in glory, how they beckon me to come,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I shall know Him, I shall know Him
and redeemed by His side I shall stand.
I shall know Him, I shall know Him
by the print of the nails in His hand.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Through the gates to the city in a robe of spotless white,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I shall know Him, I shall know Him
and redeemed by His side I shall stand.
I shall know Him, I shall know Him

hymns.title: No night there

lines: God shall wipe away all tears, there's no death, no pain, nor fears;
and they count not time by years, for there is no night there.

lines: God shall wipe away all tears, there's no death, no pain, nor fears;

sections.label: Refrain
lines: God shall wipe away all tears, there's no death, no pain, nor fears;

sections.label: Refrain
lines: God shall wipe away all tears, there's no death, no pain, nor fears;

hymns.title: O Son of God, we wait for Thee
hymns.source_file: 417 O Son of God, we wait for Thee lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O Son of God, we wait for Thee, in love for Thine appearing;
this time of waiting soon will be forgotten, stilled our yearning.
Who trust in Thee, shall joyful be and see Thee, Lord, descending
to bring us bliss unending.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We wait for Thee, mid toil and pain, in weariness and sighing,
but glad that Thou our guilt has borne and cancelled it by dying.
Hence cheerfully may we with Thee take up our cross and bear it,
till we relief inherit.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: We wait for Thee, here Thou hast won our hearts to hope and duty,
but while our spirits feel Thee near, our eyes would see Thy beauty.
We long to be at rest with Thee in peace and joy supernal,
in glorious life eternal.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: We wait for Thee, for Thou wilt come; our hearts with joy are beating.

O, bliss 'twill be when Thee we see; our praises to Thee singing,
eternal thanks Thee bringing.

hymns.title: Oh, what a change!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Oh, what a change! Oh, what a change! When I shall see His wonderful face!
Oh, what a change! Oh, what a change! When I shall see His face!

hymns.title: Our King doth come
hymns.source_file: 419 Our King doth come lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: In Him rejoice, O virgins wise! Your lamps with oil are filled.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The Bridegroom comes, the call is clear. The bride now enters in

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Rejoice, all ye believers, and let your lights appear!
The evening is advancing and darkest night is near.
The Bridegroom is arising and soon He will draw nigh; up, pray and watch and wrestle, at midnight comes the cry.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Your lamps have ready, waiting; let them be filled with oil and for the Lord be worthy; prepare both heart and soul!
The watchmen call in Zion: "The Bridegroom is not far!" United go to meet Him and sing hallelujah!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Wise virgins all, now come ye; your heads of faith lift up, with music and rejoicing prepare yourself to sup.
The marriage feast is waiting, the gates wide open stand; up, up, ye heirs of glory, the Bridegroom is at hand!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Our hope and expectation,
O Jesus, now appear; arise,
Thou Sun, so longed for, o'er this benighted sphere!
With hearts and hands uplifted, we plead,
O Lord, to see the day of earth's redemption that brings us unto Thee!

hymns.title: Safe in the arms of Jesus
hymns.source_file: 421 Safe in the arms of Jesus lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Safe in the arms of Jesus, safe on His gentle breast,
there by His love o'ershaded, sweetly my soul shall rest.
Hark, 'tis the voice of angels borne in a song to me
over the fields of glory, over the jasper sea.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Safe in the arms of Jesus, safe on His gentle breast,
there by His love o'ershaded, sweetly my soul shall rest.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Safe in the arms of Jesus, safe from corroding care,
safe from the world's temptations, sin cannot harm me there.
Free from the blight of sorrow, free from my doubts and fears;
only a few more trials, only a few more tears!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Safe in the arms of Jesus, safe on His gentle breast,
there by His love o'ershaded, sweetly my soul shall rest.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Jesus, my heart's dear refuge, Jesus had died for me.
Firm on the Rock of Ages ever my trust shall be.
Here let me wait with patience, wait till the night is o'er,
wait till I see the morning break on the golden shore.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Safe in the arms of Jesus, safe on His gentle breast,
there by His love o'ershaded, sweetly my soul shall rest.

hymns.title: Sometime we'll understand
hymns.source_file: 422 Sometime we'll understand.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Not now, but in the coming years, it may be in the better land,
we'll read the meaning of our tears, and there, sometime we'll understand.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Then trust in God through all your days; fear not, for He will hold your hand;
Though dark your way, still sing and praise: Sometime, sometime, we'll understand.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We'll catch the broken threads again, and finish what we here began:
our God the myst'ries will explain and then, ah, then we'll understand.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Then trust in God through all your days; fear not, for He will hold your hand;
Though dark your way, still sing and praise: Sometime, sometime, we'll understand.

sections.label: Verse 3

why song had ceased when scarce begun: 'Tis there, sometime we'll understand.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Then trust in God through all your days; fear not, for He will hold your hand;
Though dark your way, still sing and praise: Sometime, sometime, we'll understand.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Why what we long for most of all eludes so oft our eager hand;
why hopes are crushed and castles fall– up there, sometime we'll understand.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Then trust in God through all your days; fear not, for He will hold your hand;
Though dark your way, still sing and praise: Sometime, sometime, we'll understand.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: God knows the way, He holds the key, He guides us with unerring hand.
Sometime, with tearless eyes we'll see: Yes, there, sometime we'll understand.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Then trust in God through all your days; fear not, for He will hold your hand;
Though dark your way, still sing and praise: Sometime, sometime, we'll understand.

hymns.title: The bride has waited, O so long
hymns.source_file: 424 The bride has waited, O so long lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The bride has waited, O so long, dear Lord, for Thy returning.
O Son of God, when wilt Thou come to still her earnest yearning?
Thy presence, Lord, brings blessedness, what other joy can equal this? "Come soon, come soon, Lord Jesus! Fulfil the time, Lord Jesus!"

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thou art so near in ev'ry hour; Thy people praise and thank Thee.
Lend through Thy word new faith and pow'r that we may soon expect Thee.
This blessing, Lord, do not withhold, but grant that we Thy face behold.
"Come soon, come soon, Lord Jesus! Fulfil the time, Lord Jesus!"

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: So let us always watchful be, and let our lamps be burning
with holy oil supplied by Thee, stand waiting, Lord, and yearning.
Be ready when the cry is heard: "The Bridegroom comes!" be not deterred.
"Come soon, come soon, Lord Jesus! Fulfil the time, Lord Jesus!"

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Our yearning is with Thee to be, the wedding to be sharing.
O Jesus, see, we wait for Thee, resplendent raiment wearing!
With joy we look to Thee on high, and ever louder sounds the cry:
"Come soon, come soon, Lord Jesus! Fulfil the time, Lord Jesus!"

hymns.title: The Bridegroom comes
hymns.source_file: 425 The Bridegroom comes lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The Bridegroom comes! Remember His word!
Watch, ye redeemed, watch with hearts bestirred
in ev'ry moment as you have heard,
watch, for the Lord comes soon!

sections.label: Refrain

till we shall see then Thy glory grand and meet Thee hand in hand.

sections.label: Verse 2

will seek his heart with Jesus to link
and not in earthly evils to sink,
watch, for the Lord comes soon!

lines: Joyfully in readiness we stand, watching, praying, waiting Thy command
till we shall see then Thy glory grand and meet Thee hand in hand.

sections.label: Refrain

sections.label: Verse 4

watch, for the Lord comes soon!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Joyfully in readiness we stand, watching, praying, waiting Thy command
till we shall see then Thy glory grand and meet Thee hand in hand.

sections.label: Verse 5

watch, for the Lord comes soon!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Joyfully in readiness we stand, watching, praying, waiting Thy command

hymns.title: The Bridegroom soon will call us
hymns.source_file: 426 The Bridegroom soon will call us lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The Bridegroom soon will call us: "Come, share the wedding feast!"
May not His voice appall us while watching we have ceased.
May all our lamps be burning and oil we have in store,
that we, with Him returning, may find an open door.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: There we shall see, delighted, our great Redeemer's face,
who leads our souls benighted to glory by His grace.
The host redeemed shall meet us, the blessed, holy band,
and loved ones there will greet us in that celestial land.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: In yonder home shall never be silent music's voice;
with hearts and lips forever we shall in God rejoice.
The angels shall adore Him, the saints shall sing His praise
and bring with joy before Him their sweetest heav'nly lays.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: In mansions fair and spacious will God the feast prepare,
and, ever kind and gracious, bid us its riches share.
The bliss that knows no measure from springs of love shall flow,
and never changing pleasure His bounty will bestow.

hymns.title: The King shall come
hymns.source_file: 427 The King shall come lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: Lyrics based on a Greek text John Brownlie (1857-1925)
metadata.composer: W Gawler's Hymns and Psalms, ca. 1787

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The King shall come when morning dawns and light triumphant breaks;
when beauty gilds the eastern hills and life to joy awakes.
Not as of old, a little Child to bear our sins and die,
but crowned with glory like the sun that lights that morning sky.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O brighter than the rising morn when He, victorious, rose
and overcame the pow'r of death despite the raging foes;
O brighter than that glorious morn shall this fair morning be
when Christ, our King, in beauty comes and we His face shall see.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The King shall come when morning dawns and earth's dark night is past;
O haste the rising of that morn when glory breaks at last.
The King shall come when morning dawns and light and beauty brings.
Hail! Christ the Lord; They people pray: "Come quickly, King of kings."

hymns.title: The Lord appears when all is still
hymns.source_file: 428 The Lord appears when all is still lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The Lord appears when all is still; the midnight hour is here!
Make ready, ev'ryone who will, for soon He will appear.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The world is blind, lies dead in sin and sleeps in thought secure
that all is well: the day wherein the Lord shall come, not sure.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Arouse your neighbour from his rest; let none feel too secure.
Warn ev'ryone to do his best, be watchful, faithful, sure.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Are your lamps filled and are they clean? Does faith your lamp make bright?
Do you lack oil, have you foreseen? The Bridegroom comes tonight!

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: So watchful be in heart and mind, for sleep may you betray.
Be ready and you well may find that it could be today!

hymns.title: There is a land
hymns.source_file: 429 There is a land lyrics.txt

a land wherein the angels sing around the heav'nly throne.

whereon the glorious sun ne'er sets, but shines forevermore, but shines forevermore.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We are but pilgrims on the earth, and brief our sojourn here;

hymns.title: To Christ, the Lord, be faithful

lines: To Christ, the Lord, be faithful, O bride, 'twill not be long
until His second coming for all the faithful throng.

hymns.title: Wake, arise, for night is flying
hymns.source_file: 431 Wake, arise, for night is flying lyrics.txt

metadata.composer: Phillip Nicolai (1556-1608) arr. Johann Sebastian Bach (1685-1750)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Wake, arise, for night is flying; the watchmen on the heights are crying: "Awake, Jerusalem, arise!"
Midnight hears the welcome voices and at the urgent cry rejoices: "Where are you all, you virgins wise?"
The Bridegroom is at hand; take up your lamps and stand.
Hallelujah! With joy prepare to meet Him there, the wedding feast with Him to share.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Zion hears the watchmen singing and in her heart new joy is springing; she wakes and to the call attends.
For her Lord now comes all-glorious, and strong in grace, in truth victorious; her light shines bright, her star ascends.
He comes, the Blessed One, Lord Jesus, God's own Son.
Hallelujah! Now, great and small, come, enter all to feast with Him in wedding hall!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Now let all the heav'ns adore You, and saints and angels sing before You with harp and cymbal's joyful tone.
Gates of pearl in heav'n are shining; there with the angelchoir combining, we gather round Your radiant throne.
No eye has seen that sight, no ear heard such delight.
Hallelujah! Yet there will we eternally with songs proclaim Your majesty.

hymns.title: We are waiting, blessed Saviour
hymns.source_file: 432 We are waiting, blessed Saviour lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We are waiting, blessed Saviour, we are watching for the hour
when, in majesty descending, Thou shalt come in mighty pow'r.
Then the shadows will be lifted and the darkness rolled away,
and our eyes behold the splendour of Thy glorious crowning day.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We are waiting, blessed Saviour, we are watching not in vain
for the cloud that bore Thee upward and will bring Thee back again.
Then, among Thy ransomed people, we shall tread the shining way,
and our eyes behold the splendour of Thy glorious crowning day.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: We are waiting, blessed Saviour, for reunion, heart to heart,
with our dear ones o'er the river, where we nevermore shall part.
Then our sorrows, in a moment, like a dream will pass away
when our eyes behold the splendour of Thy glorious crowning day.

hymns.title: When strikes the hour?
hymns.source_file: 435 When strikes the hour.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: When strikes the hour,Lord, and when shall it be?
I long for home, heavenly home!
When I, transfigured, eternity see;
my heav'nly home, my heav'nly home!
Here on the earth is much sorrow and pain,
there will my soul ever happiness gain.
Oh, how I long for my heavenly home;
I long for home, for my home!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Only as long as it pleases Thee, Lord,
will I remain, will I remain.
Sin I shall fight here on earth through Thy word
till I attain heavenly gain.
Here I may cherish my brethren in Thee,
working and striving that worthy I'll be!
Till I, transformed, see Thee coming again
and then attain heav'nly gain.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Here still contented but glorified there
is my desire, is my desire.
Dwelling with Thee, this is daily my prayer
and my desire, yes, my desire.
Patient in sorrow, in grief or distress,
one day in joy I shall glory possess.
There I shall sing in the heavenly choir,
this my desire, my desire!

sections.label: Refrain

hymns.title: Depart, dear child
hymns.source_file: 440 Depart, dear child lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Depart, dear child! Our God has called your soul this futile world to leave.
Tho' now I grieve, God's love does me console; He will you now receive.
No need for further lamentation! God gives the spirit consolation.
Depart, dear child! Depart, dear child!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Depart, dear child! In heaven you will find what here the world denied.
Alone with God is peace for all mankind! No pain the soul need hide.
Where we on earth are often frightened, in heav'n through God we are enlightened.
Depart, dear child! Depart, dear child!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Depart, dear child! Soon shall we follow you, whenever God decrees.
Go forth to Him whose love is ever true; with Him all sorrows cease.
When life is long, then long man's mis'ry, if short, you soon may see His glory!
Depart, dear child! Depart, dear child!

hymns.title: For all the saints

Alleluia, Alleluia.

Alleluia, Alleluia.

sections.label: Verse 5

Alleluia, Alleluia.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Homeland mine, homeland mine, beautiful to see!
I dearly long with all my heart in that blest place to be.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Not too long, not too long: soon all battles cease.
There beckons from the Father's house the sweetest heav'nly peace.
What human ears can never hear nor human eyes can see,
what never entered human thoughts will there my portion be.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Homeland mine, homeland mine, beautiful to see!
I dearly long with all my heart in that blest place to be.

hymns.title: I have a home beyond the river

when with trouble here I sigh:
There's a home beyond the river,
that I'll enter by and by.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I have a home beyond the river,
I have a mansion bright and fair.
I have a home beyond the river
and I will dwell with Jesus there.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Just a little more to labour:
Spread the gospel, watch and pray.
Just a few more earthly sorrows,
then to heav'n we'll fly away.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I have a home beyond the river,
I have a mansion bright and fair.
I have a home beyond the river
and I will dwell with Jesus there.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Oh, how sweet t'will be to meet them,
all the ransomed host above.
Sweeter still to see the Saviour,
praise Him for redeeming love.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I have a home beyond the river,
I have a mansion bright and fair.
I have a home beyond the river
and I will dwell with Jesus there.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Though the world is filled with sorrow
and the teardrops often fall,
there will be but joy and gladness,
safe inside the jasper wall.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: I have a home beyond the river,
I have a mansion bright and fair.
I have a home beyond the river
and I will dwell with Jesus there.

hymns.title: I know a realm where Jesus dwells

where angels serve our Lord and King, there 'tis so wonderful!

How sweetly reechoes the heav'nly song, it draws me nearer home.

sections.label: Verse 2

hymns.title: In God's kingdom I long to be
hymns.source_file: 446 In God's kingdom I long to be lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: In God's kingdom I long to be: O what beauty I there shall see.
After strife, scorn and pain, there a crown I shall gain and my Saviour  I there shall see.

sections.label: Refrain

My Bridegroom is there, a place did prepare and I shall Him surely meet.

sections.label: Verse 2

Where all darkness is gone, ever bright shines the sun in that blessed and heav'nly home.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Blessed hope, O how pure and sweet, in Paradise joy's complete.
My Bridegroom is there, a place did prepare and I shall Him surely meet.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: In God's kingdom I would find rest and shall meet the redeemed and blest.
There we'll walk hand in hand on that sweet pearly strand where soft breezes the soul caress.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Blessed hope, O how pure and sweet, in Paradise joy's complete.
My Bridegroom is there, a place did prepare and I shall Him surely meet.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: In God's kingdom I want to be, where the blessed ones all things see.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Blessed hope, O how pure and sweet, in Paradise joy's complete.
My Bridegroom is there, a place did prepare and I shall Him surely meet.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: In God's kingdom I wish to stand. Hence I'm praying: "Lord, take my hand.
O my soul now prepare, raiment white there to wear at the wedding feast great and grand!"

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Blessed hope, O how pure and sweet, in Paradise joy's complete.
My Bridegroom is there, a place did prepare and I shall Him surely meet.

hymns.title: O the home of my soul is on high
hymns.source_file: 447 O the home of my soul is on high lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O the home of my soul is on high, far beyond ev'ry sorrow and sigh,
where the numberless, sanctified fold praises God with a joy that's untold.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: There on high, there on high; O the home of my soul is on high.
There on high, there on high, O the home of my soul is on high!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Many loved ones have journeyed on high, whom I'll see glorified by and by.
Evermore then united we'll be with the Lord who in love made us free.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: There on high, there on high; O the home of my soul is on high.
There on high, there on high, O the home of my soul is on high!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I rejoice, O my Lord, that on high, You, my Saviour, I may glorify!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: There on high, there on high; O the home of my soul is on high.
There on high, there on high, O the home of my soul is on high!

hymns.title: Our home
hymns.source_file: 448 Our home lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Our home! O words so beautiful! Our home! O place so wonderful!
Our home! That's where I long to be; our home, for all eternity!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: 'Tis there my heart desires to be. 'Tis there, from pain and suff'ring free.
In heav'n there is no earthly care; to be with Christ my ardent prayer.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Our home, where all complaint is stilled; a place with all God's glory filled.
And there, transformed by grace, we'll stand in pure white raiment from His hand.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Farewell, farewell, O yearning heart, from ev'ry earthly pain depart!
Farewell, beloved soul, be still. Farewell, it is the Father's will!

hymns.title: Shall we meet once more in glory
hymns.source_file: 449 Shall we meet once more in glory lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Shall we meet once more in glory, there in heav'n's eternal light,
where no pain or grief depresses, at the Lamb's throne, in His sight?
Shall we meet, shall we meet, shall we meet?
Shall we meet once more in glory there in heav'n's eternal light?
Yes, indeed, we'll see each other in that land of glorious light,
singing hymns and joining others who have fought for truth and right.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Shall we see you as God's children; after life's tempestuous way,
in the land of overcomers, round the Lamb in white array?
Shall we meet, shall we meet, shall we meet?
Shall we meet you as God's children, after life's tempestuous way?
Yes, we'll see our loved departed who have died in Christ the Lord,
waiting, long since we were parted, to be joined in one accord.

hymns.title: Shall I meet you at the fountain
hymns.source_file: 450 Shall I meet you at the fountain lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Shall I meet you at the fountain when I reach the gloryland?
Shall I meet you at the fountain? Shall I clasp your friendly hand?
Other friends will bid me welcome, other loving voices cheer;
there'll be music at the fountain– will you, will you meet me there?

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Yes, I'll meet you at the fountain, at the fountain bright and fair;
Oh, I'll meet you at the fountain; yes, I'll meet you, meet you there.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Shall I meet you at the fountain? For I'm sure that I shall know
kindred souls and sweet communion, more than I have known below;
and the chorus will be sweetter when it bursts upon my ear,
and my heaven seem completer, if your happy voice I hear.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Yes, I'll meet you at the fountain, at the fountain bright and fair;
Oh, I'll meet you at the fountain; yes, I'll meet you, meet you there.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Shall I meet you at the fountain? I shall long to have you near
when I meet my loving Saviour, when His welcome words I hear.
He will meet me at the fountain, His embraces I shall share;
there'll be glory at the fountain– will you, will you meet me there?

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Yes, I'll meet you at the fountain, at the fountain bright and fair;
Oh, I'll meet you at the fountain; yes, I'll meet you, meet you there.

hymns.title: Somewhere beyond the sunset
hymns.source_file: 451 Somewhere beyond the sunset lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Somewhere, beyond the sunset, a perfect realm is found
where all earth's holy longings are fulfilled and endless joys abound.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Somewhere, beyond the sunset, we'll see the Saviour we adore.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Somewhere, beyond the sunset, there is a place I know

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Somewhere, beyond the sunset, we'll see the Saviour we adore.
We'll fall in worship at His feet and dwell with Him forevermore.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Somewhere, beyond the sunset, the time is in God's hands,

sections.label: Refrain

hymns.title: Swing low, sweet chariot
hymns.source_file: 452 Swing low, sweet chariot lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Swing low, sweet chariot, coming for to carry me home;
swing low, sweet chariot, coming for to carry me home.

A  band of angels coming after me, coming for to carry me home.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Swing low, sweet chariot, coming for to carry me home;
swing low, sweet chariot, coming for to carry me home.
If you get there before I do, coming for to carry me home;
tell all my friends I'm coming too, coming for to carry me home.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Swing low, sweet chariot, coming for to carry me home;
swing low, sweet chariot, coming for to carry me home.
I'm sometimes up, I'm sometimes down, coming for to carry me home;
but still my soul feels heavenly bound, coming for to carry me home.

hymns.title: Ten thousand times ten thousand

sections.label: Refrain

Through Christ we're glorified!

hymns.title: The home of the Father
hymns.source_file: 455 The home of the Father lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The home of the Father draws me from the earth.
The home of the Father is mine by rebirth.
Here naught stills my longing, my heart's filled with care;
I long for my Father and home over there,
I long for my Father and home over there.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Farewell, earthly dwellings, I was but a guest.
Away with its pleasures and all its unrest.
Its mountains and valleys are wonderful sights,
but cannot compare with the heavenly heights,
but cannot compare with the heavenly heights.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: That home knows no sorrow, no darkness and night;
there stars ever shine with a heavenly light.
I find there the greatest of pleasures untold:
The Saviour I may there forever behold,
the Saviour I may there forever behold.

hymns.title: The Lord of harvest beckons
hymns.source_file: 456 The Lord of harvest beckons lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The Lord of harvest beckons, His ripened corn to reap.
The evening sun is setting, a soul now seeks its sleep.
Through many years of labour, that soul finds sweet repose
where peace is ever present and God all things controls.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The soul, led by His counsel, in wonder will survey
the blessings there presented to all who go His way.
Directed by His Spirit, the soul, so richly blest,
the fruits of faith will harvest and enter heav'nly rest.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: As pilgrim you have carried a cross oft hard to bear.
The load has now been lifted and gone is earthly care.
The eventide has fallen, completed is your task.
To dwell with overcomers, what more could one then ask!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: What joy when you behold Him and feel His fond embrace.
To see your faith rewarded and meet Him face to face!
He grants eternal blessings for trust and faith you've shown;
He grants to all the faithful a place before His throne.

hymns.title: There is a glorious land
hymns.source_file: 457 There is a glorious land lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There is a glorious land for which my heart doth long;
a glist'ning golden strand where ends not praise nor song!

lines: Home, home, home, borne upon boisterous billows.
Home, home, home, angels guide o'er the shallows.
Home, home, home, into that blessed harbour,
Jesus will lead the bride home.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I know the only way to that fair promised land.
My Jesus is the way; He'll lead me to that strand!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Home, home, home, borne upon boisterous billows.
Home, home, home, angels guide o'er the shallows.
Home, home, home, into that blessed harbour,
Jesus will lead the bride home.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Home, home, home, borne upon boisterous billows.
Home, home, home, angels guide o'er the shallows.
Home, home, home, into that blessed harbour,

sections.label: Refrain
lines: All His suf'fring ended, joyfully we sing,
Jesus has ascended! Glory to our King!
All His suf'fring ended, joyfully we sing,
Jesus has ascended! Glory to our King!

sections.label: Verse 3

hymns.title: On Your ascension, Lord, alone
hymns.source_file: 459 On Your ascension, Lord, alone lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: On Your ascension, Lord, alone my fervent hope is founded.
The doubt and fear to which I'm prone are overcome, confounded.
Now Christ, the Head, in heaven waits and when God's time is right, He takes His own to join the Father.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The Lord arose to heav'nly heights, a place for me preparing;
how great, Lord Jesus, my delight once glory to be sharing!
Through grace You drew me to that place; already now my heart embrace; for You is all my yearning.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Oh, Lord, that by Your grace I may, on my ascension morning,
the Spirit's fruits with joy display that are my soul adorning.
Then may I too on Your return, transfigured with Your own have earned to enter heav'nly glory.

hymns.title: Breathe on me, breath of God
hymns.source_file: 460 Breathe on me breath of God lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Breathe on me, breath of God, fill me with life anew,
that I may love what Thou dost love, and do what Thou would'st do.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Breathe on me, breath of God, until my heart is pure,
until with Thee my will be one, to do and to endure.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Breathe on me, breath of God, till I am wholly Thine,
until this earthly part of me does glow with fire divine.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Breathe on me, breath of God, so shall I never die,
but live with Thee the perfect life in Thy eternity.

hymns.title: Breathe upon us, Holy Spirit
hymns.source_file: 461 Breathe upon us, Holy Spirit lyrics.txt

metadata.composer: attr. B F White (1800-1879) harm. Joan A Fyock (b. 1938)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Breathe upon us, Holy Spirit, as adoringly we bow
at God's altar, pure and sacred, paying Him our solemn vow.
All our feeble graces quicken with the streams of Your sweet grace
and make glorious with Your presence this Your holy dwelling place.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: You are pure and You are holy; Jesus, make us more like You.
You are meek and You are lowly; may Your nature we pursue.
Shed abroad Your love within us, fill our souls with light divine.
Holy Spirit, fill and lead us, and our godliness refine.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Now receive us, as repentant; to Your heart of love we fly.
Pardon all our sin and folly, lead us to Yourself on high.
Oh, these hearts need Your refining and the cleansing of Your blood!
Consecrate and make us holy through redemption's mighty flood.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Here shall love, like sacred incense, upward mount to Your great throne,
from the clean, pure heart and conscience of a people all Your own.
Humble are the gifts we bring You and upon Your altar lay,
yet be gracious to Your people as they worship You today.

hymns.title: Come down, O love divine
hymns.source_file: 462 Come down, O love divine lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: Bianco da Siena (d. 1434) transl. Richard F Littledale (1833-1890)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come down, O love divine, seek Thou this soul of mine and visit it with Thine own ardour glowing.
O Comforter, draw near, within my heart appear and kindle it, Thy holy flame bestowing.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O let it freely burn, till earthly passions turn to dust and ashes in its heat consuming;
and let Thy glorious light shine ever on my sight, and clothe me round, the while my path illuming.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Let holy charity mine outward vesture be, and lowliness become mine inner clothing:
True lowliness of heart, which takes the humbler part, and o'er its own shortcomings weeps with loathing.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: And so the yearning strong, with which the soul will long, shall far outpass the pow'r of human telling;
for none can guess its grace, till he become the place wherein the Holy Spirit makes His dwelling.

hymns.title: Come, gracious Spirit, heavenly Dove
hymns.source_file: 463 Come, gracious Spirit, heav'nly Dove lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, gracious Spirit, heav'nly Dove, with light and comfort from above;
be Thou our Guardian, Thou our Guide, o'er ev'ry thought and step preside.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The light of truth to us display, and make us know and choose Thy way;
plant holy fear in ev'ry heart, that we from God may never part.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Lead us to Christ, the living Way, let us not from His pastures stray.
Lead us to holiness, the road that we must take to God's abode.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Lead us to heav'n, that we may share the joy, in full, forever there.
Lead us to God, our final rest, to be with Him, forever blest.

hymns.title: Come, O come, Thou quickning Spirit
hymns.source_file: 464 Come, O come Thou quickening Spirit lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, O come, Thou quick'ning Spirit. Thou forever art divine.
Let Thy power never fail me: Always fill this heart of mine;
thus shall grace and truth and light, then dispel the gloom of night;
thus shall grace and truth and light then dispel the gloom of night.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Grant my mind and my affections wisdom, counsel, purity.
That I may be ever seeking naught but that which pleases Thee.
Let Thy knowledge spread and grow, human errors overthrow;
let Thy knowledge spread and grow, human errors overthrow.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: In the faith, O make me steadfast; let not Satan, death or shame
of my confidence deprive me; Lord, my refuge is Thy name.
When the flesh inclines to ill, let Thy word prove stronger still;
when the flesh inclines to ill, let Thy word prove stronger still.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Holy Spirit, strong and mighty, who inspires to make things new,
make Thy work within me perfect; help me know God's word so true.
Arm me with that sword of Thine and the vic'try shall be mine;
arm me with that sword of Thine and the vict'ry shall be mine!

hymns.title: Holy Ghost of truth and power
hymns.source_file: 465 Holy Ghost of truth and power lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Holy Ghost of truth and power, Teacher of God's discipline;
O Creator and Endower, bearing heav'nly fruits within.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Grant God's children gifts and talents that they all strive valiantly.
Courage, faith, in even balance, for God's work in unity.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: In this world with all its treasures, carelessness and comfort thrive.
To deny all worldly pleasures is a goal for which we strive.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Grant that in this world's confusion, faith and joy will fill our heart.
Grant in glory this conclusion: Never from our Lord we'll part.

hymns.title: Holy Spirit
hymns.source_file: 466 Holy Spirit lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Holy Spirit, living Breath of God, breathe new life into my willing soul;
bring the presence of the risen Lord to renew my heart and make me whole.
Cause Your word to come alive in me; give me faith for what I cannot see.
Give me passion for Your purity; Holy Spirit, breathe new life in me.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Holy Spirit, come abide within; may Your joy be seen in all I do.
Love enough to cover ev'ry sin in each thought and deed and attitude.
Kindness to the greatest and the least; gentleness that goes the path of peace.
Turn my striving into works of grace; Breath of God, show Christ in all I do.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Holy Spirit, from creation's birth, giving life to all that God has made.
Show Your power now anew on earth, cause my soul to hunger for Your ways.
Let the fragrance of your prayers arise; lead us on the road of sacrifice,
that in unity the face of Christ will be clear for all the world to see.

hymns.title: Holy Spirit, come confirm us
hymns.source_file: 467 Holy Spirit, come confirm us lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Holy Spirit, come confirm us in the truth that Christ makes known.
We have faith and understanding through Your helping gifts alone.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Holy Spirit, come console us; come as Advocate to plead.
Loving Spirit from the Father, grant in Christ the help we need.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Holy Spirit, come renew us; come and teach us how to live:
Holy, through Your loving Presence, holy, through the gifts You give.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Holy Spirit, come inspire us, You the loving Trinity.
Holy Spirit of the Father, come fulfil our humble plea.

hymns.title: Holy Spirit, faithful Guide
hymns.source_file: 468 Holy Spirit, faithful Guide lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Holy Spirit, faithful Guide, ever near the Christian's side,
gently lead us by the hand, pilgrims in a desert land.
Weary souls fore'er rejoice when they hear that sweetest voice
whisper softly: "Wand'rer, come! Follow Me, I'll guide you home."

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Ever present, truest Friend, ever near Your aid to lend,
leave us not to doubt or fear, wand'ring on in darkness drear.
When the raging storms assail, hearts grow faint, and hopes, too, fail,
whisper softly: "Wand'rer, come! Follow Me, I'll guide you home."

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: When our life on earth shall cease, guide us into sweet release.
Wading through the dismal flood, pleading naught but Jesus' blood,
still the fear that may arise, grant assurance of the prize,
whisper softly: "Wand'rer, come! Follow Me, I'll guide you home."

hymns.title: Holy Spirit, heal my soul
hymns.source_file: 469 Holy Spirit, heal my soul lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Holy Spirit, heal my soul, Godly peace in me make whole
and with heav'nly grace my heart embrace till I see Him face to face, till I see Him face to face.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Holy Spirit, touch my eyes; heal my sight and make me wise.
Let me glimpse and see God's plan for me, heaven mine eternally, heaven mine eternally.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Holy Spirit, fill my being, cleanse all thoughts that are unclean.
Make me strong and sure, my heart make pure, that in faith I may endure, that in faith I may endure.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Holy Spirit, fill my heart, heav'nly gifts to me impart
that I soon may fly beyond the sky, there to meet my Lord on high, there to meet my Lord on high.

hymns.title: Holy Spirit, Truth divine
hymns.source_file: 470 Holy Spirit, Truth divine lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Holy Spirit, Truth divine, dawn upon this soul of mine;
Word of God and inward light, wake my spirit, clear my sight.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Holy Spirit, Love divine, glow within this heart of mine;
kindle ev'ry good desire; cleanse Thou me in Thy pure fire.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Holy Spirit, Pow'r divine, fill and steel this will of mine;
grant that I in strength may thrive, bravely bear and nobly strive.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Holy Spirit, King divine, reign within this conscience mine;
be my Lord, and I shall be firmly bound, forever free.

hymns.title: O come, eternal Spirit
hymns.source_file: 471 O come, eternal Spirit lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O come, eternal Spirit of truth, diffuse Thy light!
Shine in our soul and banish all blindness from our sight.
Thy holy fire pour o'er us, touch heart and lips that we
with faithful, good confession acknowledge Christ and Thee, acknowledge Christ and Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Rank unbelief is rampant, mad folly clouds man's love,
hence, Thou Thyself must arm us with weapons from above.
With wisdom, grace, endurance and faith robust, and then
completely banish from us all false respect for men, all false respect for men.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: These times call for decisions; though foes 'gainst us inveigh;
for open, bold confession, whate'er the world may say;
despite the empty glitter with which the world pretends,
to praise, defend and cherish Christ's gospel till the end, Christ's gospel till the end.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Pour over ev'ry nation a Pentecostal show'r,
the word of life thus spreading accompanied with pow'r.
Our hearts and lips, Lord, open; all nations' and our own
that we, through joy and sorrow, make Christ's salvation known, make Christ's salvation known.

hymns.title: O enter, Lord, Thy temple
hymns.source_file: 472 O enter, Lord, Thy temple lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O enter, Lord, Thy temple, be Thou my spirit's guest,
who through Thy Spirit gavest a second birth more blest.
Thou everlasting Lord, though here to dwell Thou deignest,
forever equal reignest, art equally adored.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O enter! Let me know Thee and feel Thy pow'r within;
the pow'r that breaks our fetters and rescues us from sin.
So wash and cleanse Thou me that I may serve Thee truly
and render honour duly, with perfect heart, to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Thou, Holy Spirit, teaches the soul to pray aright;
Thy songs have sweetest music; Thy prayers have wondrous might,
for God doth hear them all. They pierce the highest heaven
till He His help hath given who helpeth great and small.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Thou art the oil most holy anointing here Thine own.
This soul, this body lowly, is Thine and Thine alone.
Thy property are we; as bridal souls selected,
through love by Thee elected Thy holiness to see.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Thou art a joyous Spirit which sorrow's chains doth break.
Bring comfort through Thy merit, our burdens lighter make,
for Thou so often did with words of love and kindness,
remove from me the blindness which joy and blessing hid.

hymns.title: O Holy Spirit, enter in
hymns.source_file: 473 O Holy Spirit, enter in lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O Holy Spirit, enter in, anew in us Thy work begin; Thy temple holy make us.
Of soul the sun, Thou light divine, around and in us brightly shine; to strength and gladness wake us.
Where Thou shinest there is given life from heaven, faith and power, that for God we live each hour.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O mighty Spirit, source of life, let Thy dear word, mid doubt and strife, be so within us burning
that we be faithful unto death; in Thy pure love and holy faith from Thee true wisdom learning.
Come, Thy graces on us shower; by Thy power Christ confessing, let us win His grace and blessing.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O gentle dew, from heaven fall with pow'r upon the hearts of all, Thy tenderness instilling.
That heart to heart, more closely bound, we rich in kindly deeds be found, the law of love fulfilling.
No wrath, no strife here shall grieve Thee; they receive Thee where Thou livest; peace and love and joy Thou givest.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O grant that, while our life shall last, our days in holiness be passed; our minds so rule and strengthen
that they may rise o'er things of earth, o'er hopes and joys that here have birth, until our Lord dost end them.
Keep Thou pure, then, from offences heart and senses; blessed Spirit, grant us life to thus inherit.

hymns.title: O thou joyful Whitsuntide
hymns.source_file: 474 O thou joyful Whitsuntide lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: Lyrics: based on Johannes Daniel Falk (1768-1826)
metadata.composer: Sicilian  melody, 1788 arr. Johann Gottfried Herder (1744-1803)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O thou joyful time, O, thou blessed time, holy, grace-bringing Whitsuntide!
Christ by His merit, pours out His Spirit. Come rejoice, now rejoice, O sanctified!
Christ by His merit, pours out His Spirit. Come rejoice, now rejoice, O sanctified!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O thou joyful time, O, thou blessed time, holy, grace-bringing Whitsuntide!
Teach, Spirit Holy, lead Thou us only. Come rejoice, now rejoice, O sanctified!
Teach, Spirit Holy, lead Thou us only. Come rejoice, now rejoice, O sanctified!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: O thou joyful time, O, thou blessed time, holy, grace-bringing Whitsuntide!
Comfort Thou, Spirit, us the delivered. Come rejoice, now rejoice, O sanctified!
Comfort Thou, Spirit, us the delivered. Come rejoice, now rejoice, O sanctified!

hymns.title: Pentecostal power
hymns.source_file: 475 Pentecostal power.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord, as of old, at Pentecost, You did Your power display
with a cleansing, purifying flame, inspire us today.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Lord, grant that Oldtime power, the Pentecostal power!
Your floodgates of blessing on us throw open wide!
Lord, grant that Oldtime power, the Pentecostal power!
That sinners be converted and Your name be glorified!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Lord, may Your Spirit freely reign, may it with zeal now endue
ev'ry waiting heart to work for You; O Lord, our faith renew.

hymns.title: Sing praises on this festive day
hymns.source_file: 476 Sing praises on this festive day lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Sing praises on this festive day with new inspired voices.
All who the Spirit's call obey with laud and praise rejoices.
A rushing wind with might came down from heaven's height;
the Spirit of the Lord from God's own Son outpoured. A thousand tongues now praise Him.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We praise Thee now, God's very Own, to Him, Thy Lord, returning,
there to receive at His high throne the fullness of Thy earning.
That promised covenant, the Spirit Thou hast sent, creating life and light, instilled with pow'r and might: a comforting assurance.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Praise Him who has ordained and sent the heralds who inspire us,
who made with us a covenant, with fire and Spirit filled us.
From ev'ry tongue is heard the power of God's word.
The gospel call is clear; let all the world give ear until all people serve Him.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Come, hasten! The dear Lord appeals to ev'ry tongue and nation.
He who with fire and Spirit seals still offers all salvation.
God's Church in unity will stand eternally;
despite the storms and gale, when waves and floods prevail, firm stands God's congregation.

hymns.title: The Comforter has come
hymns.source_file: 477 The Comforter has come.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O spread the tidings 'round, wherever man is found, wherever human hearts and human woes abound.
Let ev'ry Christian tongue proclaim the joyful sound: The Comforter has come, has come.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: The Comforter has come!
The Comforter has come!
The Holy Ghost from heav'n, the Father's promise giv'n.
O spread the tidings 'round wherever man is found:
The Comforter has come, has come.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The long, long night is past; the morning breaks at last; and hushed the dreadful wail and fury of the blast,
as o'er the golden hills the day advances fast! The Comforter has come, has come.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: The Comforter has come!
The Comforter has come!
The Holy Ghost from heav'n, the Father's promise giv'n.
O spread the tidings 'round wherever man is found:
The Comforter has come, has come.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Behold the King of kings, with healing in His wings, to ev'ry captive soul a full deliv'rance brings;
and through the vacant cells the song of triumph rings:The Comforter has come, has come.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: The Comforter has come!
The Comforter has come!
The Holy Ghost from heav'n, the Father's promise giv'n.
O spread the tidings 'round wherever man is found:
The Comforter has come, has come.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O boundless love divine! How shall this tongue of mine to mortals here proclaim the matchless grace divine–
that I, weighed down with shame should in His image shine? The Comforter has come, has come.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: The Comforter has come!
The Comforter has come!
The Holy Ghost from heav'n, the Father's promise giv'n.
O spread the tidings 'round wherever man is found:
The Comforter has come, has come.

hymns.title: Another year is dawning
hymns.source_file: 478 Another year is dawning lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Another year is dawning: Dear Father, let it be,
in working or in waiting, another year with Thee;
another year of progress, another year of praise,
another year of proving Thy presence all the days.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Another year of mercies, of faithfulness and grace;
another year of gladness before Thy shining face;
another year of leaning upon Thy loving breast;
another year of trusting, of quiet, happy rest.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Another year of service, of witness for Thy love;
another year of training for holier work above.
Another year is dawning: Dear Father, let it be,
on earth or else in heaven, another year for Thee.

hymns.title: Bless us, Lord, this final day
hymns.source_file: 479 Bless us, Lord, this final day lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Bless us, Lord, this final day as the old year now has ended.
Bless us on our future way; hold Thy hands o'er us extended
that, with soul and body striving, goodness we may be deriving.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: If we fail along the way, lift us up, Lord, fail us never.
Teach us then how not to stray from the narrow path, not ever.
Grant us wisdom, grace and blessing, thus towards our goal progressing.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Lift us up so that we may feel Thy loving hands attending;
start with us anew each day, thus assure a blessed ending
that we may, through Thy love guided, reach that home for us provided.

hymns.title: Earthly pleasures are but fleeting
hymns.source_file: 480 Earthly pleasures are but fleeting lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Earthly pleasures are but fleeting, quickly passing by;
but, by Jesus' word receiving, lasting joy draws nigh.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Gladly, let us follow, all one, all one heart and soul.
As the fading year is passing, once more we'll strive toward the goal.
Yes, as the fading year is passing, once more we'll strive toward the goal.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Many joys, but also sorrow, brought the passing year;
yet the foe could us not harrow, for God's grace was near.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Gladly, let us follow, all one, all one heart and soul.
As the fading year is passing, once more we'll strive toward the goal.
Yes, as the fading year is passing, once more we'll strive toward the goal.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Now with darkness still enshrouded is the dawning year.
Filled with faith, we're not discouraged; God is ever near.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Gladly, let us follow, all one, all one heart and soul.
As the fading year is passing, once more we'll strive toward the goal.
Yes, as the fading year is passing, once more we'll strive toward the goal.

hymns.title: Jesus, shall our watchword be
hymns.source_file: 481 Jesus shall our watchword be lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus, shall our watchword be as the new year's dawn spreads o'er us;
Jesus' name alone will we as our standard bear before us;
in His covenant we stand, journey'ng to the promised land.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Jesus' name and Jesus' word shall resound in fullest measure.
In our churches this is heard; may we tread His courts with pleasure
that our hearts through grace anew prove a holy temple, too.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Thus our pathways would we tread, trusting in the name of Jesus.
While this Star guides overhead, neither doubt nor fear should seize us;
in its light of grace and love, blessings come from heav'n above.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Jesus' name shall lighten pain and in all our ills relieve us.
Losses thus shall turn to gain and to blessings what seems grievous.
Jesus's name is sun and shield, through Him all our sorrows yield.

hymns.title: Now this year, too, has ended
hymns.source_file: 482 Now this year, too, has ended lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Now this year, too, has ended, yet Your love does remain;
Your hands still mete out blessings and I Your grace retain.
The ties of fortune weaken, earth's treasures soon decay.
The best of friends will waver; Your love does with us stay.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The lure of youth does vanish, the strength of man soon wanes,
but he in spirit rises who You as Friend retains.
The old year now has vanished, a new year is at hand,
but since, O Lord, I've found You, rejoicing, firm I stand.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And should there rise before me the old year's sins anew,
by grace, through Your forgivness, You help me them subdue.
My help in great afflictions; my help in sin and fear.
O God, grant grace and blessing to me in this new year.

hymns.title: The year so still is ending
hymns.source_file: 483 The year so still is ending lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The year so still is ending, be also still, my heart!
Our God and faithful Father did joy and pain impart.
All that this year encompassed our God alone does know;
the wounds that were inflicted, the mournful tears of woe.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Just why so much of sadness, so shortlived joy and rest?
And why so soon the parting from those we loved the best?
So many eyes have closed now and death their lips has sealed
that once spoke with affection; Oh, may this pain be healed!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: So that it's not forgotten what often we forget;
that this poor earthly dwelling is for our home not set.
The Lord will with His people, whom all His Spirit bear,
in Zion's golden city a habitation share!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Here in this world we scatter the seed with anxious tears;
our joys we'll reap up yonder in neverending years.
Lord, help us on our journey that strong our faith may be
and walk Yourself beside us to heav'nly destiny!

hymns.title: Today we come anew
hymns.source_file: 484 Today we come anew lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Today we come anew, commit our cares and keeping,
Lord, in Thy faithful hands, eternal blessings reaping.
Here stands a fortress safe that Satan's host defies.
God's children therein find a refuge He supplies.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Lord, grant in this new year, new strength to keep us faithful;
that trusting we remain, and watching, ever wakeful.
Lord, fill both heart and mind with light from Thee on high;
Thy Holy Spirit's word let all our needs supply.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Grant that we more and more subdue our sinful nature;
in body, soul and mind, control our ev'ry feature;
and let us be content Thy wisdom, Lord to heed;
whatever Thou may send will goodness be indeed.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: And when the time has come that we're this world departing,
prepare us through Thy grace, Thy love to us imparting.
Our hearts we give anew; with Thee we shall commune.
O hear our daily plea: "Come Thou, O Lord, come soon!"

hymns.title: Glad hosanna! David's Son
hymns.source_file: 485 Glad hosanna! David's Son lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Glad hosanna! David's Son comes to Zion; come, adore Him.
O set up the regal throne, raise a thousand arches o'er Him.
Strew the palms, prepare His way; bid Him welcome on this day!
Strew the palms, prepare His way; bid Him welcome on this day!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Glad hosanna! Welcome, Thou. We go forth with praise to meet Thee.
Waiting hearts in homeage now lay we at Thy feet to greet Thee.
Enter Thou our portals, Lord, welcomed by us and adored.
Enter Thou our portals, Lord, welcomed by us and adored.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Glad hosanna! Honoured Guest. We, too, are Thy subjects royal.
Called and chosen to be blest, may we e'er to Thee prove loyal
and Thy sceptre ne'er disown; in us, Lord, rule Thou alone!
And Thy sceptre ne'er disown; in us, Lord, rule Thou alone!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Glad hosanna! Help, good Lord; grant success and grace we pray Thee.
May we all in one accord with an upright heart obey Thee.
Thou wilt ev'ryone receive who will hear Thee and believe!
Thou wilt ev'ryone receive who will hear Thee and believe!

hymns.title: Hosanna, loud hosanna
hymns.source_file: 486 Hosanna, loud hosanna lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Hosanna, loud hossanna, the little children sang;
through pillared court and temple the lovely anthem rang.
To Jesus, who had blessed them, close folded to His breast,
the children sang their praises, the simplest and the best.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: From Olivet they followed 'mid an exultant crowd,
the victor's palm branch waving, and chanting clear and loud.
The Lord of earth and heaven rode on in lowly state,
ne'er scorned that little children should on His bidding wait.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: "Hosanna in the highest!" That ancient song we sing,
for Christ is our Redeemer, the Lord of heav'n, our King.
O may we ever praise Him with heart and life and voice,
and in His blissful presence eternally rejoice!

hymns.title: In humble guise He's nearing
hymns.source_file: 487 In humble guise He's nearing lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: In humble guise He's nearing, upon a colt appearing: The King behold with joy!
Greet Him with palms and flowers, strewn on His way in showers; let all their songs of praise employ.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: No hosts He leads, our Saviour; of love speaks His behaviour. O hail the Prince of Peace!
Though pow'rs on earth are striving, the way to God depriving, His kingdom ever shall increase.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: The Lord of truth unending, anew today is sending in humble, lowly guise,
the servants who will guide us, with heav'nly peace provide us: The peace that only He supplies.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Let now Your light be shining; defeat all dark designing, Lord, through Your deed of grace.
Whilst glad hosannas singing, our burnished lamps we're bringing, what joy to meet You face to face!

hymns.title: With glad psalms
hymns.source_file: 488 With glad psalms lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: With glad psalms join in the singing, make for Him the pathway clear.
Spread the palms that you are bringing, lo! your King is drawing near!
He came forth from David's lineage; He, the Lord, forevermore!
He has come in God's own image; highly favoured, Him adore!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: See your King, God's word fulfilling, meek and humble, He draws nigh.
Nations, yield to Him, be willing, He brings blessings from on high.
Heaven honours His great glory, angels sing their praises, too.
We must tell this wondrous story: Christ brings glorious peace to you!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: With the joyful choir, resounding, psalms of praise on Him bestow;
songs expressing joy unbounding; may the world His glory know!
Sing "Hosanna" to the Master, praises to God's holy Son!
Though the world may face disaster, we eternal life have won!

hymns.title: All, Lord, for Thee
hymns.source_file: 489 All, Lord, for Thee lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Saviour, Thy dying love Thou gavest me.
Nor should I aught withhold, dear Lord, from Thee.
In love my soul would bow, my heart fulfill its vow,
my off'ring bring Thee now: All, Lord, for Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: At the blest mercyseat, pleading for me,
Jesus, my humble faith looks up to Thee.
Help me the cross to bear, Thy wondrous love declare;
praise Thee in song and pray'r: All, Lord, for Thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Give me a faithful heart, likeness to Thee.
That each departing day henceforth may see
some work of love begun, some deed of kindness done,
some wand'rer sought and won: All, Lord, for Thee.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: All that I am, and have, Thy gifts to me,
in joy and grief I give, dear Lord, for Thee.
Until Thy face I see, until I am with Thee,
my cause will ever be: All, Lord, for Thee.

hymns.title: Blest Man of Calvary
hymns.source_file: 490 Blest Man of Calvary lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Fairest of all the earth has known, greatest the mercy He has shown;
fullness divine in Him I see, beautiful man of Calvary!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Blest Man of Calvary has won my heart from me,
blest Man of Calvary has won my heart from me,
and died to set me free, blest Man of Calvary!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Granting the sinner life and peace, granting the captive sweet release,
shedding His blood to make us free, merciful Man of Calvary!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Blest Man of Calvary has won my heart from me,
blest Man of Calvary has won my heart from me,
and died to set me free, blest Man of Calvary!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Giving the gift to all mankind: Glorious love in Him we find,
giving us spotless purity, bountiful Man of Calvary!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Blest Man of Calvary has won my heart from me,
blest Man of Calvary has won my heart from me,
and died to set me free, blest Man of Calvary!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Comfort of all my earthly way, Jesus, I'll meet You some sweet day;
dwelling in glory, You I'll see, wonderful Man of Calvary!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Blest Man of Calvary has won my heart from me,
blest Man of Calvary has won my heart from me,
and died to set me free, blest Man of Calvary!

hymns.title: He gave His life
hymns.source_file: 491 He gave His life.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: He gave His life, a ransom for the world; the light of truth does win.
The world at last no more in darkness lies, no more in night of sin.
The world's Redeemer has completed His work on earth and sin defeated.
He gave His life, He gave His life.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He gave His life; in Calvary's dark hour did death Him not appal.
From all the pain and anguish He now rests, His love has borne it all.
His Spirit, over sin victorious, ascends to heav'nly realms most glorious.
He gave His life, He gave His life.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: He gave life, the Father's wish fulfilled; His glory we behold.
The veil was rent, and ever more would He His love for us unfold.
He who His slayers has forgiven, secured for us a home in heaven.
He gave His life, He gave His life.

hymns.title: He never said a mumbalin' word
hymns.source_file: 492 He never said a mumbalin' word lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: They crucified my Lord and He never said a mumbalin' word;
they crucified my Lord and He never said a mumbalin' word.
Not a word, not a word, not a word.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: They nailed Him to a tree and He never said a mumbalin' word;
they nailed Him to a tree and He never said a mumbalin' word.
Not a word, not a word, not a word.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: They pierced Him in the side and He never said a mumbalin' word;
they pierced Him in the side and He never said a mumbalin' word.
Not a word, not a word, not a word.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: He bowed His head and died and He never said a mumbalin' word;
he bowed His head and died and He never said a mumbalin' word.
Not a word, not a word, not a word.

hymns.title: I gave My life for thee
hymns.source_file: 493 I gave my life for thee lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I gave My life for thee, My precious blood I shed
that thou might ransomed be and quickened from the dead.
I gave, I gave My life for thee, what hast thou giv'n for Me?
I gave, I gave My life for thee, what hast thou giv'n for Me?

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: My Father's house of light, My great and glorious throne
I left, for earthly night, for wandering alone.
I left, I left it all for thee, hast thou left aught for Me?
I left, I left it all for thee, hast thou left aught for Me?

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: I suffered much for thee, more than thy tongue can tell,
of bitter agony, to rescue thee from hell.
I've borne, I've borne it all for thee, what hast thou borne for Me?
I've borne, I've borne it all for thee, what hast thou borne for Me?

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: I brought to earth for thee a gift from heav'n above:
Salvation full and free, My pardon and My love.
I bring, I bring rich gifts to thee, what hast thou brought for Me?
I bring, I bring rich gifts to thee, what hast thou brought for Me?

hymns.title: Lead me to Calvary

hymns.title: My faith looks up to Thee
hymns.source_file: 495 My faith looks up to Thee lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: My faith looks up to Thee, Thou Lamb of Calvary,
Saviour divine!
Now hear me when I pray, take all my guilt away;
O let me from this day be wholly Thine.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: May Thy rich grace impart strength to my fainting heart,
my zeal inspire.
As Thou hast died for me, may now my love for Thee

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: While life's dark maze I tread and doubts around me spread,

lines: When ends life's transient dream, when death's cold sullen stream

hymns.title: O Lamb of God divine
hymns.source_file: 496 O Lamb of God divine lyrics.txt

lines: O Lamb of God divine, who died on Golgotha,

Thou paid the ransom dear, all can now come to Thee.
Thy final cry was heard, just as God willed:
“It is fulfilled, it is fulfilled!”

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O Word of Life and Truth, to which my faith is bound,

for by Thy blood alone I am made pure and free.

“It is fulfilled, it is fulfilled!”

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Christ, our Redeemer now, we bring Thee thanks and praise.
Thou overcame death's pow'r, glad hymns to Thee we raise.

Thy final words shall be our cry for victory.
All honour to the Lamb, Light of the world:

hymns.title: O sacred Head, now wounded
hymns.source_file: 497 O sacred Head, now wounded lyrics.txt

metadata.composer: Hans Leo Hassler (1564-1612) harm. Johann Sebastian Bach (1685-1750)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O sacred Head, now wounded, with grief and shame weighed down,
now scornfully surrounded with thorns, Thine only crown!
O sacred Head, what splendour, what bliss till now was Thine!
Yet, though despised, I render Thy praise and call Thee mine.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: What Thou, my Lord, hast suffered was all for sinners' gain.
Mine, mine was the transgression, but Thine the deadly pain.
Lo, here I fall, my Saviour! 'Tis I deserve Thy place.
Look on me with Thy favour, vouchsafe to me Thy grace.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: What language shall I borrow to thank Thee, dearest Friend,
for this Thy dying sorrow, Thy pity without end?
O make me Thine forever, and should I fainting be,
Lord, let me never, never outlive my love to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Be near when I am dying, O show Thy cross to me,
and for my rescue, flying, come, Lord, and set me free!
These eyes, new faith receiving, will rest on Thee above,
for all who die believing, die safely, through Thy love.

hymns.title: Rock of Ages, cleft for me
hymns.source_file: 498 Rock of Ages, cleft for me lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Rock of Ages, cleft for me, let me hide myself in Thee;
let the water and the blood, from Thy riven side which flowed,
be for sin the double cure: save from wrath and make me pure.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Not the labour of my hands can fulfil Thy law's demands;
could my zeal no respite know, could my tears forever flow,
all for sin could not atone; Thou must save, and Thou alone!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Nothing in my hand I bring, simply to Thy cross I cling;
naked come to Thee for dress; helpless, look to Thee for grace;
foul, I to the fountain fly; wash me, Saviour, or I die.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: While I draw this fleeting breath, when my eyes shall close in death,
when I rise to realms above, see Thee on Thy throne of love,

hymns.title: There is a green hill far away
hymns.source_file: 499 There is a green hill far away lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: There is a green hill far away, without a city wall,
where Christ the Lord, was crucified, who died to save us all.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: We may not know, we cannot tell, what pains He had to bear,
but we believe it was for us He hung and suffered there.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: He died that we might be forgiv'n, He died to make us good,

sections.label: Verse 4

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: O dearly, dearly has He loved, and we must love Him too,
and trust in His redeeming blood, and try His works to do.

hymns.title: When I survey the wondrous cross
hymns.source_file: 502 When I survey the wondrous cross_unknown lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: When I survey the wondrous cross on which the Prince of Glory died,
my richest gain I count but loss, and pour contempt on all my pride.

lines: Forbid it, Lord, that I should boast, save in the death of Christ, my God.

hymns.title: Alleluia! Sing to Jesus

lines: Alleluia! Sing to Jesus, risen now to reign in love.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Alleluia! Not as orphans we are left in sorrow now.

hymns.source_file: 506 Alleluia, alleluia! Hearts to heaven lyrics.txt

hymns.title: Christ triumphant, ever reigning

lines: Crown Him with many crowns, the Lamb upon His throne.
