give thanks, O mortals, sing, and triumph evermore.
Lift up your heart, lift up your voice; rejoice; again I say, rejoice.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The Saviour, Jesus,  reigns, the Lord of truth and love;
when He had purged our stains, He took His seat above.
Lift up your heart, lift up your voice; rejoice; again I say, rejoice.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: His kingdom cannot fail; He rules o'er earth and heav'n;
the keys of heav'n and hell are to our Jesus giv'n.
Lift up your heart, lift up your voice; rejoice; again I say, rejoice.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Rejoice in glorious hope! For Jesus shall return
and take us to eternal rest for which we yearn.
We soon shall hear the angel's voice; the trump of God shall sound, rejoice!

hymns.title: See, what a morning
hymns.source_file: 518 See, what a morning lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: See, what a morning, gloriously bright, with the dawning of hope in Jerusalem;
folded the grave-clothes, tomb filled with light as the angels announce: "Christ is risen!"
See God's salvation plan, wrought in love, borne in pain, paid in sacrifice,
fulfilled in Christ, the Man, for He lives: Christ is risen from the dead.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: See Mary weeping: "Where is He laid?" As in sorrow she turns from the empty tomb,
hears a voice speaking, calling her name; it's the Master, the Lord, raised to life again!
The voice that spans the years, speaking life, stirring hope, bringing peace to us,
will sound till He appears, for He lives: Christ is risen from the dead.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: One with the Father, Ancient of Days, through the Spirit who clothes faith with certainty.
Honour and blessing, glory and praise to the King crowned with pow'r and authority.
And we are raised with Him; death is dead, love has won, Christ has conquered.
And we shall reign with Him, Christ is risen from the dead.

hymns.title: Sing, all you Christians
hymns.source_file: 519 Sing, all you Christians lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Sing, all you Christians, glad hymns now be voicing!
Praise bring the Lord who has died us to save!
Sing till the echoes ring out with rejoicing;
Jesus, arisen, has conquered the grave.
Jesus, arisen, has conquered the grave.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: “Peace unto you”, those are words great and glorious;
also today does the Risen One call.
Open the portals to all: 'tis so wondrous,
come to the Saviour, there's peace for us all,
come to the Saviour, there's peace for us all.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Lord, help our faith, help us fight, be victorious;
we trust and build here on Your mighty strength,
till earthly pow'rs have been proved just vainglorious
and we may see You in glory at length,
and we may see You in glory at length!

hymns.title: The day of resurrection
hymns.source_file: 520 The day of resurrection lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: John of Damascus, 8th cent. transl. John M Neale (1818-1866)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: The day of resurrection! Earth, tell it out abroad;
the Passover of gladness, the Passover of God.
From death to life eternal, from sin's dominion free,
our Christ has brought us over with hymns of victory.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Our hearts be pure from evil, that we may see aright
the Lord in rays eternal of resurrection light;
and, list'ning to His accents, may hear, so calm and plain,
His own "all hail" and, hearing, may raise the victor strain.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Now let the heav'ns be joyful! Let earth its song begin!
The world resound in triumph and all that is therein.
Let all things seen and unseen their notes of gladness blend;
for Christ the Lord has risen, our Joy that has no end.

hymns.title: We welcome glad Easter
hymns.source_file: 521 We welcome glad Easter lyrics.txt

metadata.composer: Traditional Welsh hymn melody harm. John Roberts, 1839

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We welcome glad Easter when Jesus arose and won a great victory over His foes.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Then raise your glad voices, ye children, and sing, bring sweet Easter praises to Jesus, our King.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: And tell how the Marys came early that day and there at the tomb found the stone rolled away.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Then raise your glad voices, ye children, and sing, bring sweet Easter praises to Jesus, our King.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And sing of the angel who said: "Do not fear! Your Saviour is risen again, He's not here."

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Then raise your glad voices, ye children, and sing, bring sweet Easter praises to Jesus, our King.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: So think of the promise which Jesus did give, that they who believe in Him also shall live.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Then raise your glad voices, ye children, and sing, bring sweet Easter praises to Jesus, our King.

hymns.title: Awake, sons of the kingdom
hymns.source_file: 522 Awake, sons of the kingdom lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Awake, sons of the kingdom, the King is drawing nigh.
Arise and hail with gladness the Ruler from on high.
God's children, come and see! The goal we are now nearing:
our banner proudly bearing: "We're waiting, Lord, for Thee."

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Look up, ye tearful mourners, the King is very near.
Away with grief and sorrow; behold, our help is here;
here in this holy place, O blessed consolation!
We find here our salvation through Him who grants us grace.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Arise, ye much afflicted, your King is not afar.
Rejoice, ye long dejected, here comes the Morning Star!
The Lord is with us now; though troubles here distress you,
with comfort He will bless you, ev'n death to Him shall bow.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Up, up, ye faint and fearful, the King now comes with might;
His heart hath long since loved us and makes our darkness light.
Now are our sorrows o'er; no wrath shall e'er befall us,
since God in grace doth call us His children evermore.

hymns.title: Come, Thou long-expected Jesus
hymns.source_file: 523 Come, Thou long-expected Jesus lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come, Thou longexpected Jesus, born to set Thy people free;
from our fears and sins release us; let us find our rest in Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thou, our strength and consolation, hope of all the earth Thou art;
dear desire of ev'ry nation, joy of ev'ry longing heart.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Born Thy people to deliver; born a Child and yet a King;
born to reign in us forever; now Thy gracious kingdom bring.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: By Thy own eternal Spirit, rule in all our hearts alone;
by Thy allsufficient merit, raise us to Thy glorious throne.

hymns.title: Comfort now My people
hymns.source_file: 524 Comfort now My people lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: Johannes G Olearius (1611-1684) transl. Catherine Winkworth (1827-1878) ref. Isaiah 40 : 1-5

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: "Comfort, comfort now My people; tell of peace!" so says our God.
Comfort those who sit in darkness mourning under sorrow's load.
To God's people now proclaim that God's pardon waits for them!
Tell them that their war is over; God will reign in peace forever!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: For the herald's voice is crying in the desert far and near,
calling us to true repentance since the Kingdom now is here.
Oh, that warning cry obey! Now prepare for God a way!
Let the valleys rise to meet Him and the hills bow down to greet Him!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Straight shall be what long was crooked and the rougher places plain!
Let your hearts be true and humble as befits His holy reign!
For the glory of the Lord now on earth is shed abroad
and all flesh shall see the token that God's word is never broken.

hymns.title: Hail to the Lord's annointed
hymns.source_file: 525 Hail to the Lord's annointed lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Hail to the Lord's anointed, great David's greater Son!
Hail to the time appointed, His reign on earth begun!
He comes to break oppression, to set the captive free;
to take away transgression and rule in equity.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He comes with succor speedy to those who suffer wrong;
to help the poor and needy, and bid the weak be strong;
to give them songs for sighing, their darkness turn to light,
whose souls, condemned and dying, are precious in His sight.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: He shall come down like showers onto the fruitful earth;
love, joy and hope, like flowers, spring in His path to birth.
Before Him, on the mountains shall peace, the herald, go;
and righteousness, in fountains, from hill to valley flow.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O'er ev'ry foe victorious, He on His throne shall rest;
from age to age more glorious, all blessing and all blest.
The tide of time shall never His covenant remove;
His name shall stand forever; that name to us is Love.

hymns.title: Lift up your heads, O mighty gates
hymns.source_file: 526 Lift up your heads, O mighty gates lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: George Weissel (1590-1635) transl. Catherine Winkworth (1827-1878) ref. Psalm 24 : 7-10

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lift up your heads, O mighty gates: Behold, the King of glory waits!
The King of kings is drawing near, the Saviour of the world is here.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Fling wide the portals of your heart: a temple make it, set apart
from earthly use for heav'n's employ, adorned with prayer and love and joy.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Come, Saviour, come! I open wide my heart to You: here, Lord, abide!
Let me Your inner presence feel: Your grace and love in me reveal.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: So come, my Sov'reign, enter in! Let me and nobler life begin!
Your Holy Spirit guide us on until the glorious crown be won.

hymns.title: Lift up your heads, you mighty gates
hymns.source_file: 527 Lift up your heads, you mighty gates!.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lift up your heads, you mighty gates,
behold, the King of glory waits!
The King of kings is drawing near,
the Saviour of the world is here;
salvation and new life He brings,
therefore the earth is glad and sings:
Our Maker, we sing praise,
for great are all Your ways.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The Lord is just, a Helper tried,
with mercy ever at His side;
His kingly crown is holiness,
His sceptre, pity in distress;
the end of all our woes He brings,
therefore the earth is glad and sings:
Our Saviour, we now raise
our grateful hymns of praise.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: How blest the land, the city blest,
where Christ the ruler is confessed!
What happy hearts and happy homes
to whom this King in triumph comes!
The cloudless sun of joy He is,
who brings us pure delight and bliss.
Our Comforter, we raise
our grateful hymns of praise.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Lift up the gates; lift up yor heart,
make it a temple set apart
from earthly use for heav'ns employ,
adorned with pray'r and love and joy;
so shall your sov'reign enter in,
and new and nobler life begin.
To You, O God, be praise
for word, and deed, and grace.

hymns.title: O how shall I receive You?
hymns.source_file: 528 O how shall I receive You lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O how shall I receive You, how greet You, Lord, aright?
All nations long to see You, my Hope, my  Heart's Delight!
O kindle, Lord, most holy Your lamp within my breast;
to do in spirit lowly all that may please You best.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Your Zion strews before You a palm branch fresh and fair.
My heart in joy would bring You a psalm of beauty rare.
My heart would sing Your praises, Your glory would proclaim;
in joyful song it raises all honour to Your name!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Did You not suffer gladly to bring me joy and peace?
Your soul and body sadly cried out: "God, grant release!"
When I was still in darkness and could not share Your light,
You, Saviour, came with gladness and changed my earthly plight.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: When heavy fetters bound me, You came to set me free.
When sin and guilt surround me, forgiveness grant to me!
Great glory You will give me, a treasure safe on high
that will not fail nor leave me as earthly riches fly.

hymns.title: Zion's daughter, O be glad
hymns.source_file: 529 Zion's daughter, O be glad lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Zion's daughter, O be glad and rejoice, Jerusalem!
Lo! thy King doth come to thee; lo! He comes, the Prince of peace!
Zion's daughter, O be glad and rejoice, Jerusalem!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Glad hosanna! David's Son, of Thy nation blest art Thou.
Thy eternal kingdom found; glad hosanna! Lord on high!
Glad hosanna! David's Son, of Thy nation blest art Thou.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Glad hosanna! Prince of peace, now we greet Thee, Sov'reign mild.
Ever stands Thy Throne of peace, Thou the heav'nly Father's Child!
Glad hosanna! Prince of peace, now we greet Thee, Sov'reign mild.

hymns.title: All my heart rejoices
hymns.source_file: 530 All my heart rejoices lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: All my heart rejoices; far and near I hear
sweetest angel-voices singing: "Christ the King is here."

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Let us join the chorus: "Jesus Christ is born.
Praise to God the Father, glory to the Son!"
All my heart rejoices; far and near I hear
sweetest angel-voices singing: "Christ the King is here."

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He came down from heaven all our souls to save.
God has sent salvation; He today the Saviour gave.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Let us join the chorus: "Jesus Christ is born.
Praise to God the Father, glory to the Son!"
All my heart rejoices; far and near I hear
sweetest angel-voices singing: "Christ the King is here."

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Gladly we embrace You, Saviour from above.
Keep us always with You, let us always feel Your love.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Let us join the chorus: "Jesus Christ is born.
Praise to God the Father, glory to the Son!"
All my heart rejoices; far and near I hear
sweetest angel-voices singing: "Christ the King is here."

hymns.title: Angels from the realms of glory
hymns.source_file: 531 Angels from the realms of glory lyrics.txt

metadata.composer: Henry T Smart (1813-1879) harm. Peter Lambert (b. 1964)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Angels from the realms of glory, wing your flight o'er all the earth;
ye who sang creation's story now proclaim Messiah's birth:
Come and worship, come and worship; worship Christ, the newborn King.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Shepherds, in the field abiding, watching o'er your flocks by night,
God with man is now residing; yonder shines the Infant Light:
Come and worship, come and worship; worship Christ, the newborn King.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Sages, leave your contemplations, brighter visions beam afar;
seek the great Desire of nations; ye have seen His natal star:
Come and worship, come and worship; worship Christ, the newborn King.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Saints before the altar bending, watching long in hope and fear,
suddenly the Lord, descending, in His temple shall appear:
Come and worship, come and worship; worship Christ, the newborn King.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Though an infant now we view Him, He will share His Father's throne.
Nations, gather all before Him, come and bow to Him alone:
Come and worship, come and worship; worship Christ, the newborn King.

hymns.title: As with gladness men of old
hymns.source_file: 532 As with gladness men of old lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: As with gladness men of old did the guiding star behold;
as with joy they hailed its light, leading onward, beaming bright;
so, most gracious Lord, may we evermore be led to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: As with joyful steps they sped to that lowly manger bed;
there to bend the knee before Thee whom heav'n and earth adore;
so, may we with willing feet ever seek Thy mercy seat.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: As they offered gifts most rare at that manger crude and bare,
so may we with holy joy, pure and free from sin's alloy,
all our dearest treasures bring, Christ, to Thee, our heav'nly King.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Holy Jesus, ev'ry day keep us in the narrow way;
and, when earthly days are past, bring our ransomed souls at last
where they need no star to guide, where no clouds Thy glory hide.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: In the heav'nly country bright need they no created light;
Thou its light, its joy, its crown, Thou its sun which goes not down.
There forever may we sing alleluias to our King.

hymns.title: Away in a manger
hymns.source_file: 533 Away in a manger_kirkpatrick lyrics.txt

metadata.composer: William J Kirkpatrick(1838-1921) harm. Peter Lambert (b. 1964)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Away in a manger, no crib for a bed,
the  little Lord Jesus laid down His sweet head.
The stars in the bright sky looked down where He lay,
the little Lord Jesus asleep on the hay.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The cattle are lowing, the baby awakes,
but little Lord Jesus, no crying He makes.
I love Thee, Lord Jesus! Look down from the sky,
and stay by my side until morning is nigh.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Be near me, Lord Jesus; I ask Thee to stay
close by me forever, and love me, I pray.
Bless all the dear children in Thy tender care,
and fit us for heaven, to live with Thee there.

hymns.title: Away in a manger
hymns.source_file: 534 Away in a manger_murray lyrics.txt

metadata.composer: James R Murray (1841-1905) harm. Peter Lambert (b. 1964)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Away in a manger, no crib for a bed, the little Lord Jesus laid down His sweet head.
The stars in the bright sky looked down where He lay, the little Lord Jesus asleep on the hay.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: The cattle are lowing, the baby awakes, but little Lord Jesus, no crying He makes.
I love Thee, Lord Jesus! Look down from the sky, and stay by my side until morning is nigh.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Be near me, Lord Jesus; I ask Thee to stay close by me forever, and love me, I pray.
Bless all the dear children in Thy tender care, and fit us for heaven, to live with Thee there.

hymns.title: Bright and glorious is the sky
hymns.source_file: 535 Bright and glorious is the sky lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Bright and glorious is the sky, radiant are the heavens high
where the golden stars were shining, and their rays to earth inclining,
calling us to heav'n above, calling us to heav'n above.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: On that holy Christmas night, through the darkness beamed a light.
All the stars above were paling, all their lustre slowly failing,
as the Christmas star drew near, as the Christmas star drew near.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Wise men from the East afar, when they saw this wondrous star,
went to find the King of nations  and to offer their oblations
unto Him as Lord and King, unto Him as Lord and King.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Him they found in Bethlehem, yet He wore no diadem,
they but saw a maiden lowly, with an Infant pure and holy,
resting in her loving arms, resting in her loving arms.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Guided by the star they found Him whose praise the angels sound.
We too have a Star to guide us which forever will provide us
with the light of Christ, our Lord, with the light of Christ, our Lord.

hymns.title: Christians, awake
hymns.source_file: 536 Christians, awake lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Christians, awake! Salute the happy morn whereon the Saviour of the world was born.
Rise to adore the mystery of love which hosts of angels chanted from above;
with them the joyful tidings first begun of God incarnate and the virgin's Son.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Then to the watchful shepherds it was told, who heard the herald angel's voice: "Behold,
I bring good tidings of the Saviour's birth to you and all the nations on the earth.
This day hath God fulfilled His promised word; this day is born a Saviour, Christ the Lord."

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: He spoke and this did the celestial choir with hymns of joy, unknown before, inspire;
praises to God's redeeming love they sang, and all the heav'ns with alleluias rang.
God's highest glory was their anthem still, peace on the earth, and unto men goodwill.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Then with the host of angels do we long, ever to sing our glad triumphant song;
He that was born upon this joyful day then round us all His glory shall display.
Saved by His love, forever we shall sing eternal praise to heav'n's almighty King.

hymns.title: Come, gather, ye children
hymns.source_file: 537 Come, gather, ye children lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Come gather, ye children, O come, one and all; to Bethlehem hasten, to manger so small.
God's Son as a gift has been sent you this night, to be your Redeemer, your joy and delight!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O kneel with the shepherds in worshipful prayer and lift up your eyes to the Christchild so dear.
Sing glory to God in the heavens above and praise Him for Jesus, the gift of His love.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: What gift can we children, what present can we, Thou purest and dearest of all, give to Thee?
Thou wishes no treasures nor riches of earth; a heart that is humble to Thee is of worth.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: So take now our hearts as an off'ring of love; we give them so gladly to Thee, Lord above.
Please make them as holy and blessed as Thine and let them forever to Thy heart resign!

hymns.title: Fairest Lord Jesus
hymns.source_file: 538 Fairest Lord Jesus lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Fairest Lord Jesus, King of creation,
Thou of God and man the Son,
truly I'd love Thee, truly I'd serve Thee;
light of my soul, my joy, my crown!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Fair are the meadows, fair are the woodlands,
robed in flow'rs of blooming spring.
Jesus is fairer, Jesus is purer,
He makes our grieving spirit sing.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Fair is the sunshine, fair is the moonlight;
bright the stars shine in the sky.
Jesus shines brighter, Jesus shines purer
than all the angels from on high.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Beautiful Saviour, Lord of the nations,
Son of God and Saviour mine:
Glory and honour, praise, adoration,
now and forevermore be Thine.

hymns.title: From heaven above to earth I come
hymns.source_file: 539 From heaven above to earth I come lyrics.txt

metadata.composer: attr. Martin Luther (1483-1546) from Geistliche Lieder, 1539

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: From heav'n above to earth I come to bring good news to ev'ryone.
Glad tidings of great joy I bring whereof I now will tell and sing:

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: To you this night is born a Child of Mary, chosen mother mild.
This little Child, of lowly birth, shall be the joy of all the earth!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: This is the Christ, God's Son most high, who hears your sad and troubled cry,
for you He will a Saviour be, from sin and fear to set you free.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Now let us all with gladsome cheer the shepherds follow and draw near
to see God's wondrous gift from heav'n; He us His only Son hath giv'n.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: All glory be to God above, who gave to us His Son through love.
With angels sing in joyful mirth– a glad new year to all the earth!

hymns.title: Gentle Mary laid her Child
hymns.source_file: 540 Gentle Mary laid her Child lyrics.txt

metadata.composer: Piae Cantiones, 1582 arr. Ernest C MacMillan (1893-1973)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Gentle Mary laid her Child lowly in a manger; there He lay, the Undefiled, to the world a stranger.
Such a Babe in such a place, can He be the Saviour? Ask the saved of all the race who have found His favour.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Angels sang about His birth, wise men sought and found Him; heaven's star shone brightly forth, glory all around Him.
Shepherds saw the wondrous sight, heard the angels singing; all the plains were lit that night, all the hills were ringing.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Gentle Mary laid her Child lowly in a manger; He is still the Undefiled, but no more a stranger.
Son of God, of humble birth, beautiful the story; praise His name in all the earth, hail the King of Glory!

hymns.title: Glorious light
hymns.source_file: 541 Glorious light lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: Keith Getty (b. 1974) Kristyn Getty (b. 1980) Ian Hannah
metadata.composer: Keith Getty (b. 1974) Kristyn Getty (b. 1980) Ian Hannah

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Glorious light! See the dawn of salvation:
Angels in white fill the skies with their wondrous song,
awakening earth with news of His birth.
Join the hymn of the highest heavens.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Glory to God in the highest!
Peace to men on earth.
Come and adore Him with wonder–
Christ, Lord of heaven and earth.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Long has the world fought the song of the angels;
heavenly music is drowned by a warring world.
Yet hope burns a light that shatters the night;
turn your heart to the call of glory.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Glory to God in the highest!
Peace to men on earth.
Come and adore Him with wonder–
Christ, Lord of heaven and earth.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: There is a day all creation has longed for,
when all of time has been spent and the Lord returns.
His song we'll repeat, as heaven completes
promised peace that will fill the nation.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Glory to God in the highest!
Peace to men on earth.
Come and adore Him with wonder–
Christ, Lord of heaven and earth.

hymns.title: Go, tell it on the mountain
hymns.source_file: 542 Go, tell it on the mountain lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Go, tell it on the mountain, over the hills and ev'rywhere;
Go, tell it on the mountain that Jesus Christ is born.
While shepherds kept their watching o'er silent flocks by night,
behold, throughout the heavens there shone a holy light.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Go, tell it on the mountain, over the hills and ev'rywhere;
Go, tell it on the mountain that Jesus Christ is born.
The shepherds feared and trembled when, lo! above the earth
rang out the angel chorus that hailed our Saviour's birth.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Go, tell it on the mountain, over the hills and ev'rywhere;
Go, tell it on the mountain that Jesus Christ is born.
Down in a lowly manger the humble Christ was born
and God sent us salvation that blessed Christmas morn.
Go, tell it on the mountain, over the hills and ev'rywhere;
Go, tell it on the mountain that Jesus Christ is born.

hymns.title: Good Christian friends, rejoice
hymns.source_file: 543 Good Christian friends, rejoice lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: Latin carol, 14th cent. transl. John M Neale (1818-1866)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Good Christian friends, rejoice with heart and soul and voice;
give ye heed to what we say: Jesus Christ is born today.
Wise men here before Him bow and He is in the manger now.
Christ is born today! Christ is born today!

sections.label: Verse 2

hymns.title: Hark! the herald angels sing

lines: Hark! the herald angels sing: "Glory to the newborn King;
peace on earth and mercy mild, God and sinners reconciled."

with angelic hosts proclaim: "Christ is born in Bethlehem!"
Hark! the herald angels sing: "Glory to the newborn King."

lines: Christ, by highest heav'n adored, Christ the everlasting Lord,
late in time He came, but sure, offspring of a virgin pure.

hymns.title: In Bethlehem the lowly
hymns.source_file: 545 In Bethlehem the lowly lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: In Bethlehem the lowly a Child to us is born.

truly, truly, I want to be His own.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Within His love abiding, in Jesus' love divine,
my heart to Him resigning and all else that is mine;
all else, all else, and all else that is mine.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: My life, my all, I bring Thee, O grant me, I implore,
Thy grace to love and serve Thee now and for evermore;
love Thee, serve Thee, now and for evermore.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: From Thee let naught me sever, the bond make firmer now
of love between us ever; receive my heart as vow,
Jesus, Jesus, receive my heart as vow.

hymns.title: It came upon the midnight clear

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: It came upon the midnight clear, that glorious song of old,
from angels bending near the earth to touch their harps of gold:
"Peace on the earth, goodwill to men, from heav'n's all-gracious King!"
The world in solemn stillness lay to hear the angels sing.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Still through the cloven skies they come, with peaceful wings unfurled,
and still their heav'nly music floats o'er all the weary world;
above its sad and lowly plains they bend on hov'ring wing
and ever o'er its Babel sounds the blessed angels sing.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And you, beneath life's crushing load, whose forms are bending low,
who toil along the climbing way with painful steps and slow:
Look now! For glad and golden hours come swiftly on the wing:
O rest beside the weary road and hear the angels sing.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: For lo! The days are hast'ning on, by prophetbards fortold,
when, with the evercircling years, comes round the age of gold:
When peace shall over all the earth its ancient splendours fling
and all the world give back the song which now the angels sing.

hymns.title: Lo, how a Rose e'er blooming
hymns.source_file: 549 Lo, how a Rose e'er blooming lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lo, how a Rose e'er blooming from tender stem hath sprung!
Of Jesse's lineage coming, as those of old have sung.

lines: Isaiah had foretold it, the Rose I have in mind;
with Mary we behold it, the Virgin Mother kind.

lines: O Flow'r, whose fragrance tender with sweetness fills the air,

hymns.title: O come, all ye faithful

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O come, all ye faithful, joyful and triumphant,

come and behold Him born, the King of angels:
O come, let us adore Him, O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him, Christ the Lord.

lines: God of God, Light of Light,
lo, He abhors not the Virgin's womb;
very God, begotten, not created:
O come, let us adore Him, O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him, Christ the Lord.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Sing, choirs of angels, sing in exultation,
sing, all ye citizens of heav'n above:
"Glory to God in the highest."
O come, let us adore Him, O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him, Christ the Lord.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Yea, Lord, we greet Thee, born this happy morning;
Jesus, to Thee be glory giv'n;
Word of the Father, now in flesh appearing:
O come, let us adore Him, O come, let us adore Him,
O come, let us adore Him, Christ the Lord.

hymns.title: O holy night
hymns.source_file: 551 O holy night lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: Placide Cappeau (1808-1877) transl. John S Dwight (1812-1893)
metadata.composer: Adolphe C Adam (1803-1856) arr. Peter Lambert (b. 1964)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O holy night! The stars are brightly shining, it is the night of the dear Saviour's birth.
Long lay the world in sin and error pining till He appeared and the soul felt its worth.
A thrill of hope, the weary world rejoices, for yonder breaks a new and glorious morn.
Fall on your knees! O hear the angel voices! O night divine, O night when Christ was born!
O night divine, O night, O night divine!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Led by the light of faith serenely beaming, with glowing hearts by His cradle we stand.
So led by light of a star sweetly gleaming, here came the wise men from Orient land.
The King of kings lay thus in lowly manger, in all our trials born to be our Friend.
He knows our need, He guardeth us from danger. Behold your King, before Him lowly bend!
Behold your King! Before Him lowly bend!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Truly He taught us to love one another; His law is love and His gospel is peace.
Chains shall He break for He would be our Brother and in His name sin's oppression shall cease.
Sweet hymns of joy in grateful chorus raising, let all within us praise His holy name!
Christ is the Lord, O praise His name forever! His pow'r and glory evermore proclaim!
His pow'r and glory evermore proclaim!

hymns.title: O little town of Bethlehem
hymns.source_file: 552 O little town of Bethlehem_lewis h redner lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O little town of Bethlehem, how still we see thee lie!
Above thy deep and dreamless sleep the silent stars go by;
yet in thy dark streets shineth the everlasting Light;
the hopes and fears of all the years are met in thee tonight.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: For Christ is born of Mary, and gathered all above,
while mortals sleep, the angels keep their watch of wond'ring love.
O morning stars, together proclaim the holy birth!
And praises sing to God the King, and peace to men on earth.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: How silently, how silently, the wondrous gift is giv'n!
So God imparts to human hearts the blessings of His heav'n.
No ear may hear His coming, but in this world of sin,
where meek souls will receive Him still, the dear Christ enters in.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: O holy Child of Bethlehem, descend to us, we pray;
cast out our sin and enter in, be born in us today.
We hear the Christmas angels the great glad tidings tell;
O come to us, abide with us, our Lord Emmanuel!

hymns.title: O morning Star, how fair and bright

lines: O morning Star, how fair and bright thou beamest forth in truth and light, O Sov'reign meek and lowly!

Thou art holy, fair and glorious, all-victorious, rich in blessing, rule and might o'er all possessing.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thou heav'nly Brightness! Light divine! O deep within my heart now shine, and make Thee there an altar!

t'ward Thee longing doth possess me; turn and bless me; here in sadness eye and heart long for Thy gladness!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: What joy to know, when life is past, the Lord we love is first and last, the end and the beginning!
He will one day, O glorious grace, transport us to that happy place beyond all tears and sinning!
Amen! Amen! Come, Lord Jesus! Crown of gladness, we are yearning for the day of Your returning.

on Christmas night all Christians sing to hear the news the angels bring:

lines: Then why should we on earth be sad, since our Redeemer made us glad?

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Once in royal David's city stood a lowly cattle shed,
where a mother laid her Baby in a manger for His bed:
Mary was that mother mild, Jesus Christ the little Child.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He came down to earth from heaven who is God and Lord of all,
and His shelter was a stable, and His cradle was a stall;
with the poor and mean and lowly lived on earth our Saviour holy.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: And through all His wondrous childhood He would honour and obey,
love and watch the lowly maiden, in whose gentle arms He lay:
Christian children all must be mild, obedient, good as He.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: For He is our childhood's pattern, day by day like us He grew;
He was little, weak, and helpless, tears and smiles like us He knew:

lines: And our eyes at last shall see Him, through His own redeeming love,
for that Child so dear and gentle is our Lord in heav'n above;
and He leads His children on to the place where He is gone.

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: Not in that poor lowly stable, with the oxen standing by,

lines: By vows of love together bound, these two on earth are one.
One may their hearts, O Lord, be found till earthly cares are done.
As from the home of earlier years they wander, hand in hand,
passing along, with smiles and tears, the path of Your command,
passing along, with smiles and tears, the path of Your command.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: More than with earthly parents' care, You will their steps attend;
and with the joys or woes they share, Your lovingkindness blend.
O let the beauty of this hour by them be brought to mind,
binding with sweet, attractive pow'r, and urging joy to find,
binding with sweet, attractive pow'r, and urging joy to find.

hymns.title: Give Your grace upon their way
hymns.source_file: 570 Give Your grace upon their way.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Here today, O Lord, two hearts will in love unite;
may they find favour, always, in Your sight.
Bless them,O Lord, we pray; guide them from day to day
and give Your grace upon their way.
In Your love, O Lord, bind them close together now
that they may truly live their holy vow.
Bless them, O Lord, we pray, guide them from day to day
and give Your grace upon their way.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: On their way, O Lord, grant Your blessing from above;
strengthen the joy of faithful hearts in love.
Bless them,O Lord, we pray; guide them from day to day
and give Your grace upon their way.
May Your Godly peace ever in their hearts abide;
guide them, O Lord, in all that they decide.
Bless them, O Lord, we pray, guide them from day to day
and give Your grace upon their way.

hymns.title: God grant you now His loving blessing
hymns.source_file: 571 God grant you now His loving blessing lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God grant you now His loving blessing as you before His altar stand.
He'll grant you light and strength to journey, securely guide you with His hand!
God bless you daily, we implore, be with you now and evermore!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: With courage and determination in love and unity remain.
Let nothing cause your separation and thus you'll happiness attain.
God bless you daily, we implore, be with you now and evermore!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: So good it is to make this promise– to pledge forever heart and mind
until your journey here is ended, and then eternal joy to find.
O God, Thou art and was before, be Thou with them forevermore!

hymns.title: Lord, with fervence do we pray
hymns.source_file: 572 Lord, with fervence do we pray lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord, with fervence do we pray, bless this couple here today.
They their lives devote to Thee so they wholly Thine may be!
Fill their cov'nant with Thy pow'r now at this and ev'ry hour
and let the sunshine of Thy love in their hearts shine from above!
Grant, O Lord, that by Thy grace they their pilgrimage may trace.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Bless the labour of their hands, give them strength for life's demands.
And with courage true to be, unashamed to follow Thee.
And if mis'ry, want or care should upon their hearts once bear,
be Thou to them in ev'ry need, faithful God, a help indeed.
Grant Thou also after pain, joy to fill their hearts again.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Let them one in spirit be, of Thy Spirit fruits to see.
Burdens bearing hand in hand as Thou, Lord, didst once command.
Lead them safely by Thy hand till they reach the better land.
Lord, let them ever watchful be and prepared to live for Thee,
that when they their lives lay down, they may wear the victor's crown!

hymns.title: O happiness
hymns.source_file: 573 O happiness lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O happiness where hand in hand, two hearts in love united stand
and journey through this vale of night, in spirit one, to Zion's height!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: A covenant of grace and love! O may it firm remain;
this covenant in hearts of love its beauty e'er retain!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: A happy home, a heart of love, what Godly blessings from above!
May they each other's burdens bear and both in joy and sorrow share.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: A covenant of grace and love! O may it firm remain;
this covenant in hearts of love its beauty e'er retain!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: If Christ you take to be your Guide and follow Him whate'er betide,
then shall life's bliss to you unfold; with Him there's happiness untold!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: A covenant of grace and love! O may it firm remain;
this covenant in hearts of love its beauty e'er retain!

hymns.title: O perfect love
hymns.source_file: 574 O perfect love lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: O perfect Love, all human thought transcending, lowly we kneel in pray'r before Thy throne,
that theirs may be the love which knows no ending, whom Thou forevermore dost join in one.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O perfect Life, be Thou their full assurance of tender charity and steadfast faith,
of patient hope and quiet, brave endurance, with childlike trust that fears not pain nor death.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Grant them the joy which brightens earthly sorrow; grant them the peace which calms all earthly strife, and to life's day the glorious, unknown morrow that dawns upon eternal love and life.

hymns.title: Wedding bells are ringing
hymns.source_file: 575 Wedding bells are ringing lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Wedding bells are ringing, there is joy today where two hearts in fervent love unite.
Father, here they seek Your blessing on their way, and Your word shall be their guiding light.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Bless this couple now, O Lord, we pray, bless their labour and their love each day.
Guide them on their journey to the Fatherland, that before their Bridegroom they may stand.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Grant them understanding, wisdom from above, that the way to blessing they may see.
May they be inspired by Your Godly love; daily may this love their standard be.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Bless this couple now, O Lord, we pray, bless their labour and their love each day.
Guide them on their journey to the Fatherland, that before their Bridegroom they may stand.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: When in times of trial they in You confide, fill their hearts with courage and with peace.
May Your daily grace for ev'ry need provide and for them Your goodness never cease.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Bless this couple now, O Lord, we pray, bless their labour and their love each day.
Guide them on their journey to the Fatherland, that before their Bridegroom they may stand.

hymns.title: Before the congregation
hymns.source_file: 576 Before the congregation lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Before the congregation Your children come today.
In solemn vow they promise in faith to walk Your way.
Before Your altar standing, they pray for faith and strength
that daily they may practise to gain the goal at length.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Their parents' faithful pleading, their love and constant care
from morn 'till eve surrounded their own in fervent prayer.
A life today does open; a challenge it will be.
Hold fast their hands, dear Father, that clearly they may see.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Oh! Grant them grace and mercy to keep what they have vowed;
with deeds confirm their callling that they have voiced aloud.
In Your name they go onward– their life, Lord, starts in You,
Your Spirit is their Leader that guides them sure and true!

hymns.title: I vow this day, Lord, to be loyal
hymns.source_file: 577 I vow this day, Lord, to be loyal lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I vow this day, Lord, to be loyal, in faith and duty to remain.
Anew I pledge myself to Jesus, His favour will I seek to gain.
Now by Your Spirit would I be guided toward eternity.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Accept the vow of this, Your child, Lord; the solemn oath of faith and trust,
that I, when tried by sin, and tempted, may still uphold the pure and just.
Young though I am, to You I give all of myself in firm belief.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Control my life and be the Ruler; my heart establish, make it true;
my conduct to Your word resigning, to do Your will each day anew.
Joy in Your presence I shall find, serving my Lord with heart and mind.

hymns.title: Seek early in life's morning
hymns.source_file: 578 Seek early in life's morning lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Seek early in life's morning, go in the strength of your youth
to buy for your adorning the pearls of grace and truth.
This heav'nly, blessed treasure hold fast with all your might.
Exchange it for no pleasure and seek the Godly light, and seek the Godly light.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Go while the sun is shining, casting aside all your fear,
with joy and bliss combining, for Christ will soon appear.
The earthly things are fleeting and may from God estrange.
With wealth and world competing, do not God's grace exchange, do not God's grace exchange.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: When earthly sorrows threaten bring unto God all your pain.
Delay not 'till tomorrow the truth in God to gain.
Give God your soul and spirit while still in youthful state;
your heart will find true merit, to God it dedicate, to God it dedicate.

hymns.title: Christ is made the sure foundation
hymns.source_file: 579 Christ is made the sure foundation lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: 7th cent. Latin transl. John M Neale (1818-1866)
metadata.composer: Henry T Smart (1813-1879) harm. Peter Lambert (b. 1964)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Christ is made the sure foundation, Christ, the Head and Cornerstone.
Chosen of the Lord and precious, binding all the church in one;
Holy Zion's help forever, and her confidence alone.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: To this temple where we call Thee, come, O Lord of Hosts, today:
With Thy everloving kindness hear Thy people as they pray,
and Thy fullest benediction shed within its walls alway.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Here vouchsafe to all Thy servants what they ask of Thee to gain;
what they gain from Thee, forever with the blessed to retain
and hereafter in Thy glory evermore with Thee to reign.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Praise and honour to the Father, praise and honour to the Son,
praise and honour to the Spirit, ever three, and ever one;
one in might and one in glory, while unending ages run.

hymns.title: Christ is our Cornerstone
hymns.source_file: 580 Christ is our Cornerstone lyrics.txt

metadata.lyricist_author_translator: Latin, before 9th cent. transl. John Chandler (1806-1876)

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Christ is our Cornerstone, on Him alone we build;
and here with glory great the house of God is filled.
On His great love our hopes we place of present grace and joys above.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O then with hymns of praise these hallowed courts shall ring;
our voices we will raise the pow'r of God to sing;
and thus proclaim in joyful song both loud and long His glorious name.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Here, gracious God, do Thou forevermore draw nigh.
Accept each faithful vow and mark each suppliant sigh;
in bounteous store on all who pray each holy day Thy blessing pour!

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Here may we gain from heav'n the grace which we implore;
and may that grace, once giv'n, be with us evermore,
until that day when all the blest to endless rest are called away!

hymns.title: We dedicate, now Lord, to Thee
hymns.source_file: 581 We dedicate now, Lord, to Thee lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: We dedicate now, Lord, to Thee this house, may it Thy dwelling be, for us a sacred haven.
We'll find here peace and soulish rest and through Thy word be truly blest, while guided home to heaven.
Reign Thou, dwell now, make us worthy here to serve Thee, Lord of glory! Bless this house we do implore Thee!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Lord, let this house of worship be now dedicated unto Thee; to Thee may it be pleasing.
May here be heard Thy living word, Thy grace on us here be conferred within this hall of blessing.
Oneness, pureness our endeavour, may it ever be our striving, thus new strength and peace deriving.

hymns.title: Now, with joy, our song we're singing
hymns.source_file: 582 Now, with joy, our song we're singing lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Now, with joy, our song we're singing, glad to share this day with you.
Birthday greetings to you bringing, strength'ning bonds of love anew.
You're by loyal friends surrounded who will walk God's way with you
and when He fulfills His promise, He will find us here with you,
and when He fulfills His promise, He will find us here with you!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: O how sweet is this assurance, mid the conflict and the strife.
In our sorrows grants endurance, walks beside us through this life.
Soon our journey will be ended, He will come to take us home
and will find us gathered 'round you, calling: "Lord, please take us home!"
And will find us gathered 'round you, calling: "Lord, please take us home!"

hymns.title: What a glorious day of mercy
hymns.source_file: 583 What a glorious day of mercy lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: What a glorious day of mercy has the Lord for you prepared!
All these years, now five and twenty, for each other you've been spared.
God with grace your way attended; unto Him your thanks make known.
Further grasp His grace extended and He'll keep you as His own.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Oh, it is the greatest mercy, this, your lot, by far the best:
Still to follow on God's pathway, still to lean on Jesus' breast!
Those who joy with you are sharing, stand united as of yore,
their petition heav'nward bearing: "God be with you evermore!"

hymns.title: Within these hearts
hymns.source_file: 584 Within these hearts lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Within these hearts, Lord, You have built in past years, five-and-twenty, (numbered fifty)
and in their marriage You instilled Your grace, Your love and mercy.
They bring to You their heartfelt praise, give thanks for many blessed days;
Your faithfulness extolling; Lord, You their life controlling!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: To You are laud and honour due for grace and guidance granted.
With prayer and zeal did they pursue the faith You have implanted.
Our thanks we bring to You, O Lord, and stand united in accord.
Your peace in them abiding, their lives to You confiding.

hymns.title: Blest be the tie that binds
hymns.source_file: 585 Blest be the tie that binds lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Blest be the tie that binds our hearts in Christian love.
The fellowship of kindred minds is like to that above.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Before our Father's throne we raise our ardent prayers.
Our fears, our hopes, our aims are one; so too our joys and cares.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: We share our mutual woes, we share distress and fear;
and often for each other flows the sympathizing tear.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Whenever we must part it brings us heartfelt pain,
but we shall still be joined in heart, and hope to meet again.

hymns.title: God be with you
hymns.source_file: 586 God be with you_tomer lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God be with you till we meet again;
by His counsels guide, uphold you.
with His sheep securely fold you;
God be with you till we meet again.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Till we meet, till we meet,
till we meet at Jesus' feet.
Till we meet, till we meet,
God be with you till we meet again.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: God be with you till we meet again;
neath His wings protecting hide you,
daily manna still provide you;
God be with you till we meet again.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Till we meet, till we meet,
till we meet at Jesus' feet.
Till we meet, till we meet,
God be with you till we meet again.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: God be with you till we meet again;
when life's perils here confound you,
put His arms unfailing round you;
God be with you till we meet again.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Till we meet, till we meet,
till we meet at Jesus' feet.
Till we meet, till we meet,
God be with you till we meet again.

hymns.title: God be with you
hymns.source_file: 587 God be with you_vaughan williams lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: God be with you till we meet again; by His counsels guide, uphold you,
with His sheep securely fold you; God be with you till we meet again.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: God be with you till we meet again; neath His wings, protecting, hide you,
daily manna still provide you; God be with you till we meet again.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: God be with you till we meet again; when life's perils here confound you,
put His arms unfailing round you; God be with you till we meet again.

hymns.title: Hands let's be joining
hymns.source_file: 588 Hands let's be joining lyrics.txt

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Hands let's be joining, the moments are fleeting;
here we but pilgrims and strangers can be.
Brief was our pleasure, soon ended our meeting,
rest there's in heaven, O Jesus, with Thee!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Hands let's be joining in Christ, our Redeemer;
once more be joining, dear loved ones, farewell!

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Hasten, go onward with zeal and conviction
forth to your labour as never before.
Truer, sincerer, with love's inspiration,
fervent your heartbeat for heaven the more.

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Hands let's be joining in Christ, our Redeemer;
once more be joining, dear loved ones, farewell!

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Christ is the Fountain and Source of our pleasure;
they who do serve Him shall always farewell.
Thus in the name of Christ, Jesus our Saviour,
and of His suff'rings, dear brethren, farewell!

sections.label: Refrain
lines: Hands let's be joining in Christ, our Redeemer;
once more be joining, dear loved ones, farewell!
